title: Client Advisor, Casa LOEWE Barcelona
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.
  

  

As **Client Advisor** , you will ensure that our client service expectations are exceeded in a personable, playful, and engaging way, enabling you to deliver your individual and team goals.


### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Achieve individual and store objectives.
* Connect with clients in an engaging emotional way to provide an exceptional and memorable client experience.
* Engage with all clients and develop long lasting relationships.
* Maintain relations with clients through regular communication and connection via email, phone, messages, or personalized notes.
* Master and transmit our brand history and heritage.
* Highlight our product categories through your product knowledge and storytelling.
* Develop and grow your client book, updating client information on the relevant company tools.
* Perform as a team player, participating and collaborating in all activities contributing to the overall objectives of the store.
* Actively participate in visual merchandising in accordance with LOEWE’s visual standards.
* Maintain products in an efficient, clean, secure, and organized manner; front and back of house.
* Support with inventory management and ad hoc back of house tasks.
* Follow the company’s policies and procedures including LOEWE’s standards in terms of grooming and behavior.
### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience in achieving individual goals and contributing to team results.
* Experience within a similar customer centric role.
* Deep interest in Fashion, Art, and Culture.
* Be naturally inclusive and open minded.
* Confident, service orientated, adaptable and empathetic in style and approach.
* Effective communication skills with the sensitivities to build and maintain a client portfolio.
* Results driven with a commercial mindset without compromising on the Team Player attitude.
* Fluent in English and Spanish; any other language will be considered a plus.
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

description:
**About the School \- The British School of Barcelona (Maresme):**  

The British School of Barcelona (BSB) is a great school in a wonderful location. We are an HMC school and were judged by a recent BSO (British Schools Overseas) inspection to be outstanding in every area, including quality of education, safeguarding, pupil welfare and academic outcomes.
  

  

BSB is a large, very popular school for children aged 3 to 18\. Our curriculum is based on the English National Curriculum, and we offer a wide range of GCSEs, A levels, BTEC and the International Baccalaureate Diploma, all alongside a significant enrichment programme.
  

  

Over 2000 pupils from more than 74 nationalities attend the school and over 315 staff work at BSB. We are based in three locations, two just outside the city of Barcelona – in Castelldefels, where we have a Primary, Secondary and Pre\-University campus, and in the cosmopolitan town of Sitges, where we have another Primary campus. BSB City is in the heart of Barcelona itself with a Foundation campus (built September 2021\), and a brand\-new main campus which opened in September 2023\.
  

  

In September 2026 we will be opening another campus, initially for EYFS and Primary\-aged students, north of Barcelona, in the Maresme area.
  

  

The growth of the school has been accompanied by significant investment over recent years, including the building of a state\-of–the art Pre\-University Centre (Nexus), a full\-sized 4G rugby and football pitch, dedicated STEAM facilities and the new BSB City and Maresme campuses.
  

  

Barcelona is a wonderful place to live, combining an amazing city with beaches and mountains nearby. The quality of life is excellent with a mild climate and year\-round sunshine.
  

  

The school now has an exciting opportunity for an experienced **Learning Support Assistant** to join our fantastic team.
  

  

**About Cognita:**  

Cognita is a global leader in independent education. Founded in 2004, we are a growing community of 90 schools in 20 countries \- in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and the Middle East \- serving more than 100,000 students. Each of our schools are proudly unique, however our collective purpose is to create an environment where everyone can, "Thrive in a rapidly evolving world".
  

  

**About the Role:**  

We are seeking both **full\-time and part\-time Learning Support Assistants on a temporary contract** to join our team at **BSB Maresme** campus.
  

  

The ideal candidate will support the education and social development of pupils under the direction of the Headteacher, Director of Student Support, Learning Support Lead and class teachers. Join a team of enthusiastic individuals who appreciate the rigour of the English curriculum but embrace the freedoms offered by an international setting. A commitment to the wider life of the school, and our enrichment programme, is an expectation of the job.
  

  

As a Learning Assistant at BSB, you will form part of the Learning Support Team. You will be required to demonstrate an informed and efficient approach to teaching and learning by adopting relevant strategies to support the work of the teachers and increase achievement of all pupils, including those with special educational needs and disabilities.
  

The appointed Learning Assistant will need a proven excellent track\-record of:
  

* Demonstrating an understanding of how young children best learn.
* Communicating effectively and sensitively with pupils to adapt to their needs and support their learning.
* Contributing to effective assessment and planning by supporting the monitoring, recording and reporting of pupil performance and progress as appropriate to the level of the role.
* Knowing each individual child and supporting teachers to adapt teaching and learning to meet the specific needs of each pupil.
* Maintaining an interactive and inspiring learning environment.
* Ensuring well\-being is at the heart of our provision.
* Having good interpersonal skills and able to work well as part of a team.
* Being committed to on\-going professional development.

  

  

  

**Who We Are Looking For:**  

We require:
  

* English: advanced.
* Qualification in support teaching and/or working with children with special educational needs.
* Minimum 2 years of experience providing support in teaching (desirable)

  

**Benefits at Cognita:**
  

All positions are offered with attractive packages including competitive salaries, places for staff children in BSB, and other local benefits.
  

  

*What we can offer you:*  

* A fantastic team of staff who are committed, supportive and collaborative.
* An opportunity to learn new skills.
* The wider support of BSB including access to high level CPD and future career opportunities.
* The support of the Cognita network including cross\-school collaborative learning partnerships.

  

**How to Apply:**  

Complete this application before the closing date: **9am CEST (UTC\+2\), Wednesday 14th October 2026**.
  

  

**Early applications are encouraged, we reserve the right to interview and appoint prior to closing date for the right applicant.**  

  

Cognita Schools are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practice and pre\-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.
  

  

We are an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity and treating all employees with dignity and respect regardless of background.

We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.


**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------


You'll be the marketing lead for your region (UK, Ireland and BeNeLux), reporting to the Head of Regional Marketing. You decide where the money goes, you run the campaigns, and you're measured on the pipeline you create.


* **Build the plan.** Set your region's marketing strategy with your commercial lead: targets, channels, budget and calendar. Then change it when the market does.
* **Fill the pipeline.** Run full\-funnel campaigns across paid social, search, email, events and partners. Take global campaigns and make them work in your markets. Hand Sales leads they actually want to call.
* **Spend like it's your own money.** You get full control of your budget. Track what works, cut what doesn't, and show the return on every euro.
* **Turn partners into growth.** Build co\-marketing with partners and associations that brings in real leads, not just logos on a slide.
* **Create content hoteliers trust.** Write thought leadership, guides and stories that build credibility in your markets, and work with our web team to get found in search and AI tools.
* **Be the voice in the room.** Represent marketing inside your regional sales, customer and partner teams. Bring what you hear in the market back to the business, and be the face of our brand at events, in the press and online.
* **Work smarter with AI.** Use AI for research, analysis, testing, content and automation, so you move faster and your work gets better.
* **Enable the regional marketing team.** Turn your best campaigns into playbooks others run, and coach fellow regional marketers.

**Your Profile**
----------------

* **5\+ years of B2B marketing experience**, including at least 3 years in regional or field marketing roles with ownership of pipeline targets, not just activity.
* Experience building **multi\-market go\-to\-market plans** across demand generation, paid, partnerships, content, events, and ABM.
* Strong background in **marketing analytics, experimentation, attribution**, and **campaign optimization**. Able to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.
* Hands\-on experience managing a **marketing budget** and articulating ROI in commercial terms: sourced and influenced pipeline, CAC, payback.
* Close collaboration with Sales and SDRs, defining MQL criteria and building handover processes that convert.
* Regular **use of AI tools** in day\-to\-day marketing work, with practical examples to share.
* Excellent project and stakeholder management skills, comfortable working **across regions** and with senior stakeholders, ideally in a matrixed or global company.
* Comfortable thriving in a fast\-moving, complex environment with a **high level of ownership**. Strategic thinking paired with a willingness to constantly test and learn.
* **Willingness to travel regularly** across the region.
* Fluent in English (C2 proficiency).

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Hands\-on **HubSpot** experience: building segments, workflows, lists and campaign attribution reports
* Experience in hotel tech, travel tech or SaaS.
* Extra languages such as Dutch or Spanish.

**What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie**


At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.


Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

* **Remote\-First Model**: Work from (almost!) anywhere. Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co\-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney.
* **One Team, One Vision, One Goal:** We’re in this together! Our Genies are laser\-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9\.3 from our team members!
* **Epic Team Gatherings:** Every year, we bring our global crew together for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.
* **Growth and Development:** We’re all about lifelong learning! Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth.
* **5 Years? 5 Weeks!** Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time to recharge and explore the world.
* **Birthday Celebrations:** It’s your day, so take it off! Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt\-free.
* **Flexible Hours:** We get it—life happens! We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.
* **Wellbeing Matters:** Your mental health is a top priority. Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life.
* **BetterHelp Support:** We also offer **BetterHelp**, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.

title: Senior SEO Content Strategist - B2B Growth
description:

The role
We're not hiring a traditional SEO content strategist. If your pitch is "I grow organic traffic," this isn't the role for you. We're looking for someone who lives at the intersection of old\-school SEO and where content is actually heading: ranking in AI engines, showing up on the platforms people are searching inside of now (think YouTube, Reddit), and using our own first\-party data to build content and tools that drive pipeline, not just impressions.


You'll own our content strategy end to end and report directly to our Head of Marketing. Our Technical SEO Lead handles everything technical, so you don't need to be a technical SEO, you need to be someone who's hungry, scrappy, and genuinely curious about how content and discovery are changing right now. We want someone comfortable building their own tools, and someone who thinks commercially: leads and pipeline first, vanity metrics a distant second.


If you're hungry to figure things out in real time, and already experimenting with AI tools to build and scale content, we want to talk.


What you'll do* Own our content strategy end to end, across blogs, guides, landing pages, emails, case studies, and resources
* Focus on how we rank and appear in AI engines and third\-party platforms (YouTube, Reddit, and beyond), not just traditional search
* Use our first\-party data to shape content decisions and identify what to double down on
* Build your own tools for content creation and lead capture, using AI tools and a scrappy, hands\-on approach rather than waiting on product/dev support
* Dig into analytics to understand what's actually performing and why, then replicate it
* Partner with our Technical SEO Lead on keyword/topic alignment, while owning the content strategy yourself
* Brief and manage designers, writers, and other contributors to bring content to life
* Track and report on leads, pipeline, and AI\-visibility metrics, not just traffic and impressions
* Build both on page and off page SEO including internal linking, link building and third party brand mentions

  

**Requirements**  

  

What you'll bring* 5\+ years of SEO/content experience in B2B with a deep understanding of B2B fundamentals
* A genuinely AI\-first mindset: you're already using tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity in your workflow, and ideally already experimenting with AI\-visibility tools (we use Profound and are adopting Athena)
* Comfort building your own lightweight tools rather than waiting on engineering support
* A commercial mindset — you think in leads and pipeline, not just traffic and rankings
* Strong writing, editing, and communication skills in English
* Comfort working across multiple stakeholders and owning deliverables end to end
* A "figuring it out as we go" mentality — this space is moving fast and nobody has it fully solved yet, we want someone energized by that, not someone with a fixed playbook


Nice to have* Experience creating localized/international content (EMEA/MENA/GCC markets)
* Familiarity with remote work, HR, payroll, or compliance topics

  

**Benefits**  

  

Why Join RemotePass?* Remote\-First Culture: We don't just sell remote work; we live it. Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere.
* Hyper\-Growth: Be part of a company that is consistently recognized for its rapid expansion and innovation.
* Inclusion Matters: We are committed to building a diverse team. We value different perspectives and empower every individual to bring their authentic self to work.

title: Podcast Producer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for an organized, creative and hands\-on **Podcast** **Producer** to lead the end\-to\-end production and delivery of Alea’s two podcasts.


The Podcast Producer will be responsible for the complete operational process, from initial planning and pre\-production through recording, post\-production, approval and final publication. The role will ensure that every episode is produced on time, meets Alea’s quality standards and supports the company’s communications and brand objectives.


Working closely with the **Head of PR \& Communications**, the **Podcast** **Producer** will help define the strategy, positioning, editorial direction and distribution approach for both podcasts. This person will then translate that strategy into a structured production plan and manage its day\-to\-day execution.


This role is ideal for someone who combines editorial judgement, project management and technical production skills and who is comfortable coordinating guests, managing recordings, reviewing edits and overseeing publication across multiple platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\.** **Podcast** **Strategy and Editorial Planning**

* Define the strategy, positioning, objectives and target audience for both podcasts in collaboration with the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Contribute ideas for themes, episode topics, formats, guests and editorial series.
* Develop and manage an editorial calendar and release schedule for both podcasts.
* Ensure podcast topics and guests are aligned with Alea’s brand positioning, communications priorities and business objectives.
* Research relevant industry topics, trends and conversations to identify new editorial opportunities.
* Prepare episode concepts and proposals for review and approval by the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Regularly review the performance and direction of both podcasts and recommend strategic improvements.

### **2\. Pre\-production**

* Manage the complete pre\-production process for every episode.
* Research topics, guests and relevant background information.
* Identify and coordinate potential guests in collaboration with the Head of PR \& Communications and other stakeholders.
* Manage guest invitations, confirmations, calendars and all pre\-recording communications.
* Prepare episode briefs, scripts, interview structures, talking points and run\-of\-show documents.
* Organize recording schedules, locations and required resources.
* Coordinate studios, external production partners or technical suppliers when needed.
* Confirm that recording equipment, software, lighting, sound and other technical requirements are ready before each session.
* Brief hosts, guests and relevant stakeholders before recording.
* Ensure all necessary permissions, consent forms and content approvals are obtained.

### **3\. Recording and Live Production**

* Lead and coordinate each recording session, ensuring the process runs smoothly from start to finish.
* Set up or supervise cameras, microphones, lighting and recording software.
* Perform technical checks before every recording.
* Direct hosts and guests during the session when required.
* Monitor audio and video quality throughout the recording.
* Follow the agreed episode structure while allowing space for natural and engaging conversations.
* Identify strong moments, quotes and potential promotional clips during the recording.
* Resolve operational or technical issues quickly and efficiently.
* Ensure all recorded material is correctly saved, backed up and organized after each session.

### **4\. Post\-production and Quality Control**

* Manage the full post\-production process for every episode.
* Edit or coordinate the editing of audio and video content.
* Review all edits and provide clear feedback to internal or external editors.
* Ensure the final episode has strong pacing, narrative flow and consistent audio and video quality.
* Coordinate the addition of intros, outros, music, graphics, subtitles and other branded elements.
* Identify and prepare the strongest moments for trailers, teasers and promotional clips.
* Ensure every episode follows Alea’s brand guidelines and editorial standards.
* Manage the internal review and approval process with the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Complete a final quality check before publication, including audio, video, titles, descriptions, links, subtitles and visual assets.
* Maintain an organized archive of raw recordings, project files, final episodes and supporting materials.

### **5\. Publication and Distribution**

* Manage the publication of each episode across the relevant podcast and video platforms.
* Upload and publish episodes on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music, Audible, YouTube and any other selected distribution channels.
* Prepare accurate and engaging episode titles, descriptions, show notes, timestamps and supporting copy.
* Coordinate thumbnails, cover images and other visual assets with the Design team.
* Ensure episodes are correctly categorized, tagged and optimized for discoverability.
* Coordinate publication dates and promotional activity with the Head of PR \& Communications and Social Media \& Content Manager.
* Verify that every episode is published correctly and is accessible across all relevant platforms.
* Update or correct published content when necessary.
* Ensure podcast information and episodes are properly featured on alea.com when relevant.

### **6\. Promotional Content Coordination**

* Identify the strongest quotes, insights and moments from each episode for promotional use.
* Create or coordinate trailers, teasers, audiograms and short\-form video clips.
* Provide the Social Media \& Content Manager with the materials, context and key messages needed to promote each episode.
* Collaborate on the preparation of an episode\-specific promotional plan.
* Ensure all promotional assets are delivered before the agreed publication date.
* Coordinate with the Design team on thumbnails, templates, graphics and other branded materials.
* Support the repurposing of podcast episodes into articles, social media posts and other communication formats.

### **7\. Production and Stakeholder Management**

* Own and maintain the production workflow for both podcasts.
* Coordinate hosts, guests, internal teams, studios and external suppliers.
* Create clear timelines and ensure all milestones and publication deadlines are met.
* Keep the Head of PR \& Communications informed about progress, risks, delays and required decisions.
* Manage feedback and approvals efficiently to avoid production bottlenecks.
* Maintain production documentation, episode trackers, guest information and content archives.
* Monitor external production costs and resources when applicable.
* Identify opportunities to make the production process more efficient, scalable and consistent.

### **8\. Performance Analysis and Optimization**

* Track podcast performance across the relevant distribution and video platforms.
* Monitor metrics such as downloads, plays, views, watch time, audience retention, completion rate and subscriber growth.
* Analyse performance by podcast, episode, topic, guest and content format.
* Prepare regular performance reports with key findings and actionable recommendations.
* Report results and insights to the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Use audience and performance data to improve topics, formats, episode duration, production and distribution.
* Monitor podcast trends, competitors and industry benchmarks to identify opportunities for growth.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At least **2–3 years of experience** in podcast, audio, video, broadcast or digital content production.
* Demonstrable experience managing the complete podcast production process, from pre\-production to publication.
* Experience recording and editing professional audio and video content.
* Hands\-on knowledge of microphones, cameras, lighting, recording software and editing tools.
* Experience with podcast hosting and distribution platforms, as well as YouTube Studio.
* Strong editorial judgement and storytelling skills.
* Ability to prepare briefs, scripts, interview structures and production documents.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to manage multiple episodes, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Confident working with senior leadership, hosts, guests and external suppliers.
* Proactive, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership of the full production process.
* Full professional proficiency in English.
* Spanish proficiency is considered an advantage.
* Previous experience in B2B, technology, media or iGaming is desirable.

**What We Offer**
=================

* A competitive salary package based on your experience.
* An impressive benefits package, focused on our culture of integral health that includes medical insurance, gym with personal trainer, sauna and hyperbaric chamber, and fresh fruit every day.
* Tax\-advantageous wage benefit: Meal card, transport package and other measures such as childcare allowance.
* Discount on Veg it (vegan meals) to order your lunch at the office.
* Flexible start and finish times.
* Reduced working hours in August.
* 23 holidays plus 3 extra days at disposal
* Hybrid Work Model.
* English classes
* Parking benefit for those who live outside of Barcelona.
* And what we are very proud of, you will join a young, motivated and powerful team with a great team culture. As it’s not all work, we maintain the team spirit with team building events, parties and workshops where you can enjoy our achievements. When you leave in the afternoon, you can join our paddle tennis games near the office.

title: Lead Product Designer, The Bump
description:
**ABOUT US**



In more than ten countries around the world, The Knot Worldwide champions the power of celebration. Our global family of brands provide best\-in\-class products, services and content to take celebration planning from inspiration to action. At the core of our business is our industry\-leading global online wedding Vendor Marketplace, connecting couples with local wedding professionals and a comprehensive suite of personalized wedding websites, planning tools, invitations, and registry services that make wedding planning easier for couples around the globe. Each year, we connect more than 4\.5 million users with around 900,000 global small businesses through our Vendor Marketplace.


**LIFE AT TKWW**



At The Knot Worldwide, we believe in doing work that matters. Each year, we help millions of couples around the world celebrate life's most meaningful moments, while also helping hundreds of thousands of global small business owners get discovered and scale. Life here means working alongside a team that cares deeply, not just about the work you do, but about the life you live. We prioritize employee well\-being and development through meaningful opportunities for growth, and we celebrate milestones and wins in a big way. After all, celebrations are what we do best.


**ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:**



We are looking for an experienced Lead Product Designer to join our Design team in Barcelona to lead day\-to\-day product design for The Bump, while supporting strategic media initiatives across The Knot Worldwide (TKWW) brand portfolio.



This role is structured so you spend most of your time on The Bump, shaping core consumer product features, content tools, and user journeys across web, iOS, and Android. The remaining time will focus on Global Media Sales (GMS), creating sponsored features and scalable monetization solutions that serve all TKWW brands.



You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Editorial, and GMS stakeholders to understand customer needs, define opportunities, and shape product strategy. Sitting at the intersection of trusted content, digital product tools, and media monetization, this role requires a designer who can balance user value with business outcomes and move fluidly between strategy, systems thinking, and execution.



The Knot Worldwide Design team is a close group of Product Designers, Product Writers, and Researchers who value strong craft, open critique, thoughtful collaboration, and shared ownership of the overall customer experience.

  


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Lead end\-to\-end product design for The Bump across web, iOS, and Android, owning day\-to\-day feature execution while setting the UX/visual quality bar and shaping core product strategy.
* Partner with the Global Media Sales (GMS) team to design sponsored content integrations and monetization touchpoints across the full family of TKWW brands.
* Partner directly alongside our Engineering and Product Management teams to shape direction, align execution priorities, and accelerate delivery timelines.
* Connect content, product functionality, and pathways that help users discover relevant tools on The Bump, while ensuring ad\-tech integrations across TKWW brands maintain customer trust and high usability standards.
* Drive design from problem framing through rapid prototyping, iteration, UX/UI design, and delivery\-ready specs, helping teams validate solutions quickly and move into development with clarity.
* Create scalable, high\-quality design solutions and reusable component patterns, contributing to the broader evolution of TKWW's design systems across all brand properties.
* Bring structure to complex product spaces, using research, user analytics, and post\-launch results to identify growth opportunities and resolve UX debt.
* Leverage AI and modern tools to prototype, compress exploration loops, and elevate the speed and output quality of product development.

  


**SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATES HAVE:**


* 6\+ years of product design experience, with a proven track record of leading complex, high\-impact consumer product areas across strategy, UX, visual design, and execution.
* Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with a portfolio showing polished execution, clear UX architecture, and scalable system patterns.
* Versatility to switch fluidly between core app/web product design (The Bump) and cross\-brand ad\-tech/monetization solutions (GMS across TKWW).
* Advanced systems thinking, with the ability to connect experiences across multi\-brand platforms, dynamic journeys, and commercial touchpoints.
* Strong product judgment, with experience using research, usability testing, and behavioral analytics to inform design choices.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering closely with dev teams and Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Design leadership.
* A bias toward rapid prototyping and leveraging AI to make abstract ideas tangible, explore solutions quickly, and unblock engineering partners.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity, bringing structure to undefined problem spaces, and driving domain\-level alignment independently.
* Experience with consumer mobile apps, content\-rich platforms, ad\-tech, commerce, or multi\-brand ecosystems is a strong plus.

  


**WORK MODEL:**



This role is Together@TKWW\-eligible and based near one of our office hubs. You'll be expected to work in the office **two days a week** as part of our hybrid work model.



\#LI\-Hybrid



\#professional


**AI FLUENCY**

title: Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Copy & Content
description:
**About Darkroom**
==================

**Darkroom** is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Shadow**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**Location:** Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only \- supporting a team in the EST time zone.

**About the role**
==================


We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand\-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high\-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.


You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first\-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.


This is a copy\-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

**You should apply if this sounds like you**
============================================


You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

* 3–5\+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.
* You write excellent short\-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.
* You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected\-device brand is a strong plus.
* You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt\-in copy, welcome series, first\-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.
* You have written loyalty, rewards, and win\-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long\-term value is a core outcome of this role.
* You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.
* You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.
* You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.
* You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high\-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.
* You are detail\-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.
* You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.
* Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

**A day in the life**
=====================

* Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.
* Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.
* Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.
* Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.
* Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.
* Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.
* Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.
* Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
======================================


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

 **Equal Opportunity Statement**


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Senior Manager / Procurement Strategy Consulting / Sourcing & Procurement
description:
**About the Firm**
------------------


We are the \#1 global consulting firm specialized in Sourcing \& Procurement. Our practice partners with CPOs, CFOs, COOs and CSCOs at the world's leading organizations to transform procurement functions into insight\-driven engines for growth, efficiency, resilience, and sustainability. Through our AI\-driven platform SynOps, proprietary market intelligence, and deep category expertise, we deliver end\-to\-end value across direct, indirect, and capex spend at scale. Our two flagship offerings — Spend Optimization and Procurement Reinvention — combine strategic advisory, managed services, and cutting\-edge agentic AI to generate measurable ROI for our clients.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


We are seeking a Senior Manager to join our Sourcing \& Procurement practice. This is a senior client\-facing role that combines deep functional procurement expertise with a strong business development mindset. The successful candidate will lead complex client engagements across Spend Optimization and Procurement Reinvention, develop relationships at C\-level, and actively contribute to the growth of the practice — ideally bringing an existing network in the Resources sector (Utilities, Oil \& Gas).


  

**What You Will Do**


Client Delivery \& Functional Leadership

* Lead end\-to\-end procurement transformation engagements, covering spend analysis, sourcing strategy, category management, supplier performance, and operating model design.
* Deploy Spend Optimization solutions (SG\&A and COGS) and Procurement Reinvention programs, including AI\-first operating model design, process redesign, and ecosystem integration (SAP/Ariba, Coupa, iValua, iCertis).
* Oversee the design and implementation of Supplier 360 and procurement analytics dashboards to enable client visibility and insight\-driven decision\-making.
* Drive value realization through outcome\-based commercial models, with a track record of delivering measurable results (cost savings, supplier reduction, compliance improvement).

 **Business Development \& Client Relationships**

* Build and nurture C\-level relationships (CPO, CFO, COO, CSCO) at existing and target accounts, acting as a trusted advisor and thought partner.
* Proactively identify and qualify new business opportunities, contributing to proposals, RFP responses, and executive presentations.
* Leverage an existing network — particularly in the Resources sector (Utilities, Oil \& Gas) — to generate pipeline and accelerate commercial conversations.
* Develop compelling points of view and credentials that differentiate the firm's offering in the market.

 **People \& Practice Development**

* Manage and mentor multi\-disciplinary project teams, fostering a high\-performance culture and developing junior talent.
* Contribute to internal capability building, including knowledge management, methodology development, and training programs.
* Collaborate with ecosystem partners (SAP, Coupa, iValua, and others) and cross\-functional teams to design integrated solutions.

 **What We Are Looking For**

 **Experience**

* 8–15 years of experience in procurement consulting, with a minimum of 4 years at a top\-tier management consulting or specialist procurement advisory firm.
* Proven track record delivering large\-scale procurement transformation programs: spend optimization, category management, operating model redesign, and/or technology\-enabled procurement.
* Strong industry exposure in Resources (Utilities and/or Oil \& Gas) as a primary focus; additional experience in Consumer Goods, Life Sciences, Industrials, or High Tech is a plus.
* Experience working with C\-level stakeholders and managing complex client relationships across multi\-country or global engagements.
* Demonstrable contribution to business development: pipeline generation, proposal leadership, or client network development.

 **Functional \& Technical Knowledge**

* Deep expertise across the procurement value chain: strategic sourcing, category management, supplier performance, contract management, and procure\-to\-pay.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled procurement tools and platforms (e.g., SynOps, SAP Ariba, Coupa, iValua, iCertis, Spend HQ) and the ability to articulate their ROI to clients.
* Understanding of agentic AI applications in procurement (benchmarking agents, negotiation assistance, intelligent buying channels) and the emerging landscape of AI\-first operating models.
* Knowledge of commercial models: outcome/value\-based deals, fixed fee, hybrid, and FTE\-based structures.
* Proficiency in procurement analytics and data\-driven decision\-making; experience with spend data analysis and dashboarding is a plus.

 **Leadership \& Commercial Attributes**

* Entrepreneurial mindset with a genuine ambition to grow a client portfolio and build lasting relationships — you think like an owner.
* Exceptional executive communication and storytelling skills; able to engage confidently in the boardroom and translate complexity into actionable insight.
* Structured problem\-solving and analytical rigor, with the ability to frame ambiguous situations and drive decisions.
* Strong team leadership: proven ability to inspire, develop, and retain talent in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Fluency in English required; additional European languages (Spanish, German, French) are a strong asset.

 **Ideal Candidate Profile**


The ideal candidate has built their career at the intersection of functional procurement excellence and strategic consulting — ideally with a background at a Big 4, top\-tier management consulting firm, or specialist procurement advisory (e.g., Efficio, Proxima, Accenture, McKinsey, BCG, Kearney). They have operated at Senior Manager or equivalent level, led multi\-million\-dollar engagements, and are now ready to take on increased commercial responsibility.


Equally important is a strong client network — particularly among CPOs, CFOs, and operations leaders in Utilities, Oil \& Gas, or adjacent sectors — and the demonstrated ambition and capability to convert that network into business.

 **What We Offer**

* Market\-leading compensation package: competitive base salary \+ performance bonus \+ long\-term incentives.
* Global platform and international exposure across the firm's priority industries and geographies.
* Access to proprietary AI tools, platforms, and a world\-class ecosystem of technology partners.
* A clear and accelerated path to Director and Managing Director, supported by structured career development.
* A collaborative, high\-performance culture where entrepreneurial drive is actively recognized and rewarded.

1\. Resumen del Puesto
  
Buscamos un Director Técnico de Integración para liderar y consolidar la práctica técnica en España. El candidato asumirá un rol estratégico, posicionándose como el nexo clave entre el negocio, las cuentas estratégicas y la entrega técnica.
  
**Su labor abarcará el ciclo de vida completo de las soluciones:** desde la fase de preventa y consultoría ejecutiva con perfiles C\-Level, pasando por la definición de arquitectura de integración y la supervisión del delivery de múltiples proyectos simultáneos, hasta el liderazgo directo de los equipos técnicos.
  
2\. Responsabilidades Principales
  
Estrategia y Dirección Técnica
  
Definir la visión y los estándares tecnológicos de la práctica de integración en España.
  
**Diseñar e impulsar arquitecturas avanzadas:** orientadas a servicios (SOA), APIs, microservicios, Event\-Driven Architectures y mensajería en entornos híbridos y multi\-cloud.
  
Establecer e implementar modelos de gobierno de APIs, marcos de calidad (ej. CMMI), buenas prácticas y metodologías de diseño.
  
Preventa y Desarrollo de Negocio (Pre\-Sales Consulting)
  
Colaborar directamente con el área comercial en la detección de oportunidades, elaboración de propuestas técnicas y económicas (RFP/RFI) y su defensa ante grandes clientes.
  
Liderar sesiones de consultoría de descubrimiento e interlocución con CIOs, CTOs y directores de IT para transformar necesidades de negocio en arquitecturas viables.
  
Diseñar Pruebas de Concepto (PoC) y arquitecturas de alto nivel (High\-Level Design) para demostrar el valor técnico de las soluciones.
  
Gestión de Proyectos, Clientes y Delivery
  
Supervisar la ejecución y entrega de múltiples proyectos de integración en paralelo, asegurando cumplimiento de tiempos, calidad y rentabilidad.
  
Mantener la relación ejecutiva con stakeholders clave y grandes cuentas, actuando como referente y punto de escalado.
  
Gestionar riesgos, desbloquear desviaciones críticas y coordinar la resolución de incidencias en entornos productivos.
  
  

Liderazgo y Desarrollo de Equipos
  
Dirigir, inspirar y mentorizar a un equipo multidisciplinar formado por Arquitectos de Integración, Devops y Developers.
  
Fomentar planes de desarrollo profesional, la capacitación técnica continua y la asignación eficiente de recursos a las distintas iniciativas.
  
3\. Requisitos del Perfil
  
Experiencia Requerida
  
Más de 15 años de trayectoria en el sector IT, con al menos 8 años en posiciones de dirección técnica, Delivery Manager, Technical Product Owner o Integration Lead en grandes consultoras o clientes corporativos.
  
Sólida experiencia demostrada en preventa tecnológica, licitaciones de gran envergadura y consultoría de valor.
  
Dominio en el diseño e implementación de middlewares de integración, orquestación de servicios y ecosistemas de APIs/microservicios.
  
Conocimientos Técnicos
  
**Middleware Integración:** Dominio de plataformas y herramientas como WSO2, MuleSoft, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus o equivalentes.
  
**Arquitectura Patrones:** Experiencia sólida en REST/SOAP, Microservicios, Event\-Driven Architecture, API Management, ETL/ELT e integración con sistemas legados.
  
**Bases de Datos Cloud:** Manejo de BBDD relacionales y NoSQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Couchbase) y plataformas cloud (Microsoft Azure, AWS o GCP).
  
**Metodologías Herramientas:** Marcos ágiles (Scrum, Kanban), gestión de roadmaps/backlogs y uso experto de Jira, Confluence y Azure DevOps.
  
Competencias Clave e Idiomas
  
Visión de negocio y alta capacidad de negociación técnica y funcional.
  
Capacidad de liderazgo, gestión de talento y trabajo bajo entornos de alta demanda.
  
**Idiomas:** Español nativo o muy fluido e Inglés C1 (imprescindible para entornos internacionales y documentación).

### **Agile movers**


Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-260457 **Date posted** 09/22/2026
Senior Director, Global Commercial Data, AI \& Reporting Excellence


**Reports to:** VP, Global Insights \& Business Excellence (GIBEx), BBU


**Scope:** Global \| Commercial data, AI, digital platforms and performance reporting \| Approximately five direct reports plus matrix delivery teams


Role purpose


The Senior Director sets the enterprise direction for how BBU commercial data, AI and reporting capabilities are designed, governed and scaled. The role owns the business strategy and value of key commercial data products and decision platforms, ensuring that trusted data and responsible AI improve decision quality, speed, productivity and commercial outcomes.


This is a senior business and technology savvy leadership role. The role translates commercial priorities into an AI\-enabled data and digital roadmap; establishes clear product ownership, architecture principles, governance and reusable standards; and partners with Commercial IT, the Commercial Data Office, Finance, Enterprise AI teams, Operations, Insights, Analytics and Forecasting, global brand teams, regions and markets to deliver adoption and measurable value.


The portfolio includes pharmaceutical secondary market data and healthcare professional engagement data, together with the products, semantic definitions, interfaces, analytics and reporting platforms that make these assets usable. The role leads Data Product Owners and Platform Leads and is accountable for talent, delivery quality, investment choices, risk and value realisation.


Key responsibilities


* **Set strategy and investment priorities:** Define the multi\-year vision and roadmap for commercial data, AI, reporting and digital decision platforms, aligned to BBU and GIBEx priorities.
* **Own the business data architecture:** Establish target\-state principles for data domains, products, models, metadata, taxonomy, lineage, interoperability and access. Partner with Commercial IT on the technical architecture and prevent fragmented or duplicative solutions.
* **Lead AI\-enabled work redesign:** Identify where predictive, generative and agentic AI can improve decisions and workflows; prioritise use cases by value, feasibility and risk; and move successful solutions from experiment to governed, scalable products.
* **Ensure responsible AI:** Embed human accountability, validation, explainability, privacy, security, bias controls, monitoring and auditability across the AI lifecycle, in line with applicable policies and regulation.
* **Lead the data\-product portfolio:** Own product vision, outcomes, lifecycle, roadmaps and backlogs for commercial data products and platforms. Apply user discovery and product management to anticipate and solve priority business problems rather than produce outputs on request.
* **Create trusted data:** Establish clear ownership, quality standards, critical data definitions, controls and issue\-resolution routes for pharmaceutical secondary data and HCP engagement data.
* **Modernise reporting and decision support:** Simplify and standardise enterprise KPIs, reporting and executive performance views; increase reuse and self\-service; and retire low\-value or duplicative products.
* **Deliver measurable value:** Define and track adoption, decision impact, productivity, quality, risk and return on investment. Use evidence to stop, redesign or scale work.
* **Orchestrate enterprise delivery:** Align GIBEx, global brands, regions, markets, Commercial IT, the Commercial Data Office, Finance, AI teams and Operations around shared priorities, decision rights, standards and delivery plans.
* **Lead talent and partners:** Build a high\-performing, globally distributed team; develop AI, product, data and commercial capability; manage vendors, budgets, capacity and delivery risk; and create clear accountability across direct and matrix teams.
* **Advise senior leaders:** Translate complex data and technology choices into clear business options, trade\-offs, recommendations and risks for executive decisions.

Essential experience and skills


* Significant senior leadership experience in commercial data, analytics, AI, digital products or data platforms within pharmaceuticals, life sciences or another complex, regulated sector.
* Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise data and AI strategy, with evidence of moving products from concept through deployment, adoption, operation and measurable value.
* Strong working knowledge of modern data architecture, including domain\-based data products, cloud data platforms, integration patterns and APIs, semantic layers, master and reference data, metadata, lineage, identity and access, and structured and unstructured data.
* Strong AI literacy across machine learning, generative AI and agentic workflows, including model and use\-case evaluation, human\-in\-the\-loop design, retrieval approaches, monitoring and responsible AI controls. The role does not require hands\-on model coding but does require credible technical judgement.
* Expertise in data\-product and platform management: customer discovery, product vision, roadmaps, prioritisation, lifecycle ownership, service levels, adoption and value measurement.
* Deep understanding of data governance, quality, privacy, security, regulatory expectations and third\-party risk in a regulated environment.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial data, including secondary sales and market data, claims or real\-world data, and HCP/customer engagement across digital and physical channels.
* Experience simplifying enterprise reporting, defining common KPIs and enabling governed self\-service analytics for senior decision\-makers.
* Proven ability to lead agile, cross\-functional and globally distributed teams and to manage vendors, budgets, dependencies and delivery risk.
* Executive\-level influence and communication: able to frame decisions, challenge assumptions, explain technical trade\-offs simply and secure alignment without direct authority.
* Strong commercial judgement, curiosity and learning agility, with a record of anticipating business needs and converting emerging technology into practical, scalable outcomes.
* Track record of coaching leaders and building scarce AI, data, digital and product capabilities.

Desirable experience


* Postgraduate qualification in data science, computer science, engineering, information systems, business or a related discipline.
* Experience with explainable AI, model risk management, MLOps or LLMOps, knowledge graphs, data mesh or fabric concepts, and AI\-ready data foundations.
* Experience redesigning operating models and workflows to embed AI at scale, including change, adoption and capability\-building.
* Country, regional or global experience in Insights, Analytics, Forecasting, Commercial Excellence or Digital.
* Ability to work globally, including international travel where required.

What success looks like


* Leaders use one trusted, decision\-ready view of commercial performance.
* Priority data and AI products have clear owners, standards, controls, adoption measures and realised business value.
* AI\-enabled workflows are scaled responsibly beyond pilots, with defined human accountability and evidence of improved quality, speed or productivity.
* Data duplication and manual reporting reduce as reusable products, common definitions and governed self\-service increase.
* The team has stronger AI, data architecture, digital product and commercial decision skills, with a sustainable succession pipeline.

In the BioPharmaceuticals Research \& Development, Late\-stage Development, Respiratory \& Immunology function you will work in a truly international working environment, with opportunities to meet and discuss with key external experts, other medical colleagues and experts in basic science, as well as commercial and regulatory functions.

* Participate in the preparation of scientific publications and presentations at scientific meetings and congresses.
