title: Senior Retention Specialist, Copy & Content
description:
**About Darkroom**
==================

**Darkroom** is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Shadow**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**Location:** Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only \- supporting a team in the EST time zone.

**About the role**
==================


We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand\-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high\-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.


You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first\-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.


This is a copy\-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

**You should apply if this sounds like you**
============================================


You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

* 3–5\+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.
* You write excellent short\-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.
* You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected\-device brand is a strong plus.
* You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt\-in copy, welcome series, first\-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.
* You have written loyalty, rewards, and win\-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long\-term value is a core outcome of this role.
* You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.
* You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.
* You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.
* You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high\-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.
* You are detail\-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.
* You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.
* Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

**A day in the life**
=====================

* Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.
* Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.
* Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.
* Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.
* Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.
* Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.
* Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.
* Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
======================================


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

 **Equal Opportunity Statement**


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Director, Worldwide Partner Programs Operations & Governance
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

**The Opportunity**


Nutanix is looking for an operational leader to run the execution engine behind our worldwide Partner Programs and Incentives. This role will ensure that partner programs, incentives, tools, policies, communications, and support processes work reliably for internal teams and partners across the world.  

You will lead the operating rhythm for programs such as Elevate and related incentive motions, from planning and readiness through launch, ongoing administration, issue resolution, measurement, and continuous improvement. You will coordinate closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, Enablement, Revenue Operations, SaaS Engineering, vendors, and the strategic program owners.  

The ideal candidate is comfortable owning the details but does not become trapped in them. You will establish clear processes, assign work to the right owners, monitor service levels, resolve cross\-functional blockers, and improve the system so that recurring issues are eliminated rather than repeatedly escalated.  

  

**What you will do**

  

1\. Own worldwide program operations  

* Run the operating model for Partner Programs and Incentives across resellers, distributors, service providers, alliances, OEMs, and other partner motions.
* Maintain a single operational calendar covering planning, approvals, launches, checkpoints, communications, payments, reporting, and close activities.
* Translate approved program policy and design into executable procedures, workflows, playbooks, training, FAQs, and support materials.
* Establish intake, triage, prioritization, escalation, and resolution processes for program questions and issues.
* Ensure that internal teams and partners receive consistent answers and that operational decisions are documented and repeatable.
* Manage the backlog of operational improvements and ensure actions are closed on time.


  

2\. Run Elevate and incentive execution  

* Coordinate end\-to\-end operational readiness for annual Elevate planning, program launch, tier changes, requirements, benefits, and ongoing updates.
* Operationalize approved rebates, incentives, checkpoints, partner requirements, individual incentives, and partner\-fund processes.
* Coordinate eligibility, enrollment, partner\-level, certification, zone, and program data changes across systems.
* Manage exception processes, including intake, documentation, approval routing, decision communication, and auditability.
* Ensure program changes are reflected accurately in the relevant partner\-facing and internal systems.
* Coordinate quarterly and annual checkpoints, results publication, remediation actions, and follow\-up with owners.
* Maintain operational continuity during fiscal\-year, quarter\-end, tool, policy, and organizational changes.


  

3\. Manage systems, data, and process integrity  

* Own the operational governance of the systems used to execute partner programs and incentives.
* Coordinate updates to Salesforce, Partner Funds Center, enrollment, business\-planning, partner\-portal, payment, and related tools.
* Maintain data\-quality controls for partner levels, zones, certifications, eligibility, program participation, incentive records, and other program attributes.
* Establish change\-control, user\-acceptance testing, release\-readiness, access\-management, and post\-launch validation processes.
* Partner with Systems, Revenue Operations, and vendors to investigate defects, raise tickets, track fixes, and communicate resolution.
* Ensure that system\-of\-record data is accurate, reconciled, and available for reporting and downstream processes.
* Document procedures, ownership, dependencies, controls, and contingency plans for critical workflows.
* Maintain the operational communications plan for partner programs and incentives.
* Convert policy and process changes into clear instructions for internal teams and partners.


  

4\. Own finance, payment, and funding operations  

Further formalize and solidify collaboration between Finance and Partner Programs Operations \& Governance.  

* Finance is accountable for the financial outcome, control environment, accounting treatment, and final financial approval or execution within its remit.
* Partner Programs Operations is accountable for program accuracy, completeness of inputs, workflow orchestration, operational reconciliation, action tracking, and stakeholder communication.
* Neither team should own the other team’s work: Programs should not perform accounting or bypass Finance controls, and Finance should not be expected to manage program eligibility, partner communications, operational trackers, or day\-to\-day exception coordination.
* Establish a documented RACI, service levels, approval thresholds, escalation path, and monthly or quarterly reconciliation cadence between the two teams.


  

Finance owns:  

* Financial policy, accounting treatment, control standards, approval authority, and interpretation of finance requirements.
* Budget ownership, funding authorization, accrual methodology, financial reporting, and formal finance close.
* General\-ledger accounting, journal entries, settlement, payment execution, treasury controls, and statutory or management reporting.
* Final approval of purchase orders, checkbooks, funding changes, contra commitments, and payment releases within Finance’s authority framework.
* Financial reconciliation, audit evidence standards, control testing, and resolution of accounting or payment\-control exceptions.
* Finance systems of record and the official financial position of program spend, commitments, accruals, and remaining funds.
* Finance participation in audit, compliance, vendor payment, and control reviews.


  

Partner Programs Operations \& Governance owns:  

* Translating approved program decisions into operational funding requests, purchase\-order requests, checkbook requests, and payment\-ready documentation.
* Maintaining the program\-level view of approved funding, commitments, transactions, balances, open actions, owners, due dates, risks, and dependencies.
* Validating that incentive and contra requests are complete, eligible, supported by the required approvals, and aligned with current program terms before submission to Finance.
* Coordinating the workflow between Programs, Finance, Legal, vendors, and approvers; tracking requests through approval, processing, payment, and closure.
* Maintaining operational records and reconciling them to Finance reports, investigating discrepancies, and escalating unresolved items with a clear issue statement and proposed action.
* Coordinating checkbook creation, funding changes, payment\-file handoffs, payment\-status follow\-up, and partner or field communications about timing and next steps.
* Managing program\-specific trackers, documentation, decision logs, exception records, and evidence needed for Finance or audit review.
* Identifying recurring defects, delays, or manual work and improving the process, system, controls, or documentation so the issue does not repeat.
* Ensuring that operational owners complete their actions on time and that Finance receives clean, accurate, and decision\-ready inputs.


  

5\. Coordinate Legal, compliance, and contractual operations  

* Coordinate operational follow\-up for compliance items, NIRA\-related activity, contract reviews, templates, addenda, terms and conditions, and letters of authorization.
* Maintain clear routing and approval processes between Programs, Legal, Finance, and business owners.
* Ensure that operational teams use current approved language, templates, policies, and program terms.
* Track open legal and compliance actions to closure and communicate dependencies or risks.
* Maintain an auditable record of approvals, exceptions, effective dates, and changes.


  

6\. Manage vendors and operational partners  

* Own the operating relationship with vendors supporting program administration, incentives, payments, portals, data, and related workflows.
* Run regular vendor reviews focused on service quality, defects, delivery, roadmap, risk, and continuous improvement.
* Track vendor actions, contractual deliverables, system changes, escalations, and transitions to new tools.
* Coordinate testing, communications, training, and cutover plans for vendor or platform changes.
* Ensure that vendor dependencies do not become single points of failure for the business.


  

7\. Lead and develop the Programs Operations team  

* Lead a globally distributed team responsible for partner programs, incentives, enrollment, rebates, distributor programs, alliances and OEM support, renewals, and related operations.
* Set clear role definitions, ownership boundaries, priorities, goals, and operating expectations.
* Run effective one\-on\-ones, team meetings, planning sessions, and development conversations.
* Build succession depth and ensure critical processes have backups and documented coverage.
* Coach team members to resolve issues at the right level and to improve the system rather than repeatedly work around it.
* Balance global consistency with regional context and time\-zone coverage.
* Recognize strong execution while holding the team accountable for quality, responsiveness, control, and completion.


  

**What we are looking for**
Required experience  

* Significant experience in partner\-program operations, incentive operations, sales operations, business operations.
* Experience running global programs across multiple regions, routes to market, and partner types.
* Demonstrated ownership of operational processes from intake and policy interpretation through systems, execution, reporting, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
* Experience coordinating with Finance, Legal, Marketing, Enablement, Systems, Revenue Operations, vendors, and field teams.
* Experience leading teams in a matrixed, global, and fast\-changing environment.
* Strong process\-design, project\-management, prioritization, and change\-management skills.
* Strong judgment with confidential financial, contractual, partner, and operational information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to make complex processes simple and actionable.


  

Preferred experience  

* Experience in enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, SaaS, cybersecurity, data infrastructure, or a related technology market.
* Experience with partner tiering, rebates, MDF/BDF, incentives, deal registration, partner enrollment, onboarding, renewals, or services programs.
* Experience with Salesforce, incentive\-management platforms, partner portals, business\-planning tools, payment platforms, ERP systems, and reporting tools.
* Experience leading a platform implementation, vendor transition, system migration, or operational automation program.
* Experience building service catalogs, SLAs, operational scorecards, process controls, and audit\-ready documentation.

Pay Transparency: The OTE range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between EUR 114,000 and EUR 172,000 per year.


Please note that OTE offered may vary depending on relevant objective factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.

* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**
------------------


ElevenLabs is building the creative suite for the AI generation. Millions of creators and marketers already use our platform to generate speech, music, images, and video, and our social presence needs to match the speed and ambition of the product.


We are looking for a Social Media Manager to own and elevate the social presence across both the ElevenLabs and ElevenCreative brands. You will own ElevenCreative on X and LinkedIn, ElevenLabs on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and our community on Discord.


This is a hands\-on role at the intersection of content strategy, lightweight video editing, and community. You will plan the calendar, capture product moments with our AI creative producers and product teams, and do the recording and editing yourself using tools like Screen Studio, assembling clips, adding text and motion, and adapting each post natively for its platform. You will stay ahead of trends and cultural moments, up\-level the brand voice and the quality bar across channels, track performance, and use the data to keep improving what we publish.


The right person lives on social platforms, understands what makes content work natively on each one, and has strong opinions about how an AI\-native brand should show up. You should be comfortable writing sharp copy, running a content calendar across multiple channels, and thinking strategically about audience growth and brand positioning.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own the social content calendar across X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn for both ElevenCreative and ElevenLabs, plus our community on Discord, from planning through publishing
* Coordinate with AI creative producers and product teams to capture product moments such as screen recordings, motion demos, and feature walkthroughs, and adapt them into social\-ready assets
* Record and edit content yourself using tools like Screen Studio, assembling clips, adding text and motion overlays, and formatting natively for each platform
* Own and grow our Discord community, sparking conversation, surfacing feedback, and keeping it active

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
We have a demand generation and expansion engine that's already running. What we need now is someone who can design the campaign strategies behind it, make the commercial trade\-off decisions that determine where we invest, and take ownership of the outcomes across the full customer lifecycle.



This is a strategic digital marketing role for someone who doesn't just run campaigns — you design them. You decide what we run, why we run it, where we spend, and what we stop doing. You will own the strategic planning and optimization of global digital campaigns — from paid media and nurture programs to ABM plays and customer expansion campaigns — making the calls on channel mix, audience strategy, and budget allocation that determine whether our marketing investment converts into pipeline and revenue.



You will sit within the Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, and working closely with Digital Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Content and Creative. This role strengthens the strategic engine of our demand generation and expansion motion — you're the person who decides what campaigns we build, how we structure them, and where we make trade\-offs to maximize commercial impact across acquisition and growth.



If you're a digital strategist who designs campaign architectures rather than just executing them, makes data\-informed trade\-off decisions with confidence, understands that marketing's job doesn't stop at the closed deal, and wants to be a key contributor in a high\-performing growth team — this is your role.


**What you'll work on**


**Campaign strategy and design**


* Design the strategic framework for global multi\-channel digital campaigns — defining audience strategy, channel mix, sequencing, and budget allocation across paid search, paid social, display, email, and content syndication to hit pipeline and expansion targets
* Make commercial trade\-off decisions on where to invest and where to pull back — you're expected to analyze performance, identify diminishing returns, and reallocate spend and effort based on what's actually driving outcomes
* Define campaign architectures across the full bow\-tie — designing how campaigns work together from awareness and lead generation through to nurture, conversion, and customer expansion, not just launching them one at a time
* Brief the Content and Creative team on what's needed and why — setting clear strategic direction for campaign assets based on audience insight, channel requirements, and commercial goals


**Account\-based marketing strategy and execution**


* Design and execute digital ABM campaign strategies targeting named accounts and account segments — defining the engagement model, channel approach, and success criteria in collaboration with the enterprise and sales teams
* Architect multi\-touch ABM plays that blend paid media, personalized content, email sequences, and retargeting — making deliberate decisions about where to invest across new logo and expansion opportunities
* Stay current on the latest ABM tactics, platforms, and approaches — from intent data providers and programmatic ABM to personalization at scale — and make recommendations on what Duetto should adopt, test, or stop doing
* Define ABM measurement frameworks at the account level — tracking engagement, pipeline influence, and progression rather than just lead volume, and using those insights to reshape strategy


**Nurture, conversion, and expansion strategy**


* Design and optimize nurture strategies across both acquisition and expansion — deciding what workflows we run, how they're structured, and where we need to fix friction across the full bow\-tie
* Define the campaign strategy for customer expansion — designing upsell, cross\-sell, and adoption campaigns that support the commercial goals of the customer success and sales teams, not just repeating acquisition tactics
* Make data\-informed decisions on where to focus conversion optimization effort — prioritizing the stages and segments where improvements will have the greatest commercial impact
* Own the analysis of campaign and channel performance — turning data into strategic recommendations on what to change, scale, or retire across the full lifecycle


**Regional strategy and localization**


* Define how global campaign strategies should be adapted for local markets — making decisions on where to localize messaging, creative, and channel strategy versus where to maintain global consistency
* Provide strategic performance analysis by territory that helps regional teams and leadership understand what digital marketing is delivering — and what needs to change — across both demand generation and expansion


**MarTech and data operations**


* Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the marketing technology stack — making recommendations on how to improve integration between campaign platforms, CRM, and lead routing systems
* Ensure campaign infrastructure supports the strategic ambitions of the growth team — you're the person who sees where the tech is limiting execution and makes the case for fixing it
* Champion clean data practices and campaign hygiene — because the quality of strategic decisions depends on a database you can trust


**AI\-first campaign operations**


* Use AI as a core part of how you design, plan, and optimize campaign strategies — from audience research and competitive analysis to performance modeling and scenario planning
* Bring an AI\-native mindset to campaign strategy — always asking how automation, smarter tooling, and agentic workflows can raise the quality and speed of strategic decision\-making, not just execution
* Contribute to how the Growth Marketing team adopts AI in day\-to\-day work — testing new approaches, sharing what works, and helping build practices that make the whole team faster and sharper
* Treat AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut — the bar for strategic quality, targeting precision, and commercial impact stays high regardless of the tools used


**What we're looking for**


**Experience**


* 5\+ years in digital marketing, growth marketing, or marketing operations — with demonstrable experience designing campaign strategies that have driven measurable pipeline and expansion revenue, not just executing plans built by others
* Demonstrable experience designing and owning digital ABM campaign strategies — defining targeting, engagement models, and measurement frameworks for named accounts or account segments
* Proven ability to make commercial trade\-off decisions across paid media, email, nurture, and content syndication — you know how to read performance data and decide where to invest, scale, or cut
* Experience designing marketing campaigns across both acquisition and customer expansion — you understand the bow\-tie and know how to architect campaigns that drive growth on both sides of it
* Experience with marketing technology platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, and programmatic/ABM tools — you understand the strategic possibilities and limitations of the stack, not just how to operate it
* Background in B2B SaaS preferred — but strong strategic thinking and commercial instinct matter more than sector match


**Skills and capabilities**


* Strong campaign strategist — you design campaign architectures, define audience and channel strategies, and make the decisions that shape what gets built and launched
* Data\-informed decision maker — you don't just report on performance, you interpret it, draw conclusions, and make strategic recommendations that change what the team does next
* Commercially minded — you understand that every campaign decision is a trade\-off and you make those trade\-offs with pipeline and revenue outcomes in mind
* Clear communicator — able to present strategic recommendations, brief creative teams with precision, and articulate the rationale behind campaign decisions to senior stakeholders
* Curious and proactive — you stay ahead of what's changing in digital marketing and bring strategic recommendations to the team without being asked


**How you operate**


* You think about campaigns in terms of pipeline contribution and expansion revenue, not just clicks and impressions
* You're a strategist who ships — you design campaigns with commercial intent and then make sure they get executed at the standard you set
* You're comfortable with complexity — balancing multiple campaign strategies across multiple channels, regions, and commercial objectives at the same time
* You understand the bow\-tie — you see acquisition and expansion as two halves of the same commercial motion and design campaign strategies accordingly
* You embrace AI as part of how you work — using it to think faster and make better strategic decisions, not as a replacement for judgment


**What success looks like in year one**


* Campaign strategies in place across acquisition and expansion that are clearly driving measurable pipeline contribution and revenue
* ABM campaign strategies running against named accounts with defined engagement models and account\-level progression metrics — not just awareness impressions
* Nurture and expansion strategies optimized with measurable improvements in conversion rates across both sides of the bow\-tie — based on trade\-off decisions you made and can evidence
* Clean, strategic campaign reporting that gives leadership and regional teams confidence in where digital marketing is delivering and where investment should shift
* You are a key strategic contributor the Growth Marketing team relies on — trusted by the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, the wider growth team, and the sales function as someone who designs what we do and owns the outcomes


**About Duetto**



Duetto is the Revenue and Profit Operating System for the global hospitality industry — a PE\-backed SaaS business with customers across hotels, casinos, and hospitality groups worldwide. We're building a marketing function that matches our ambition: world\-class, commercially driven, and genuinely category\-defining.

description:

Desde el área de **Privacidad, Protección de Datos e IA** de la Dirección Corporativa de Seguridad, estamos buscando a una persona que nos ayude a definir las medidas y controles necesarios para garantizar la protección de los datos y el uso responsable de nuevas tecnologías como la IA, así como definir las buenas prácticas y políticas necesarias para cumplir con la regulación vigente en materia de Seguridad y Privacidad.

**¿Dónde estamos?**
-------------------



Las Tablas, Madrid.

**¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?**
--------------------------------


* Identificar y analizar los **riesgos de Seguridad y Privacidad** derivados de la legislación y normativa en materia de **Inteligencia Artificial**.
* Colaborar en la definición e implantación de la **estrategia de Seguridad y Privacidad**, así como en garantizar el **uso responsable de la Inteligencia Artificial** y la protección de los datos.
* Ajustar y actualizar dinámicamente la **gobernanza y el uso responsable de la IA**, así como los **controles y guardarraíles**, incluida su integración en herramientas, sistemas y plataformas.
* Evaluar y mitigar los **riesgos de la IA**, como sesgo, discriminación o explicabilidad, en algoritmos y modelos de IA, incluidas soluciones basadas en **LLM/GenAI y agentes autónomos**, a lo largo de todo su ciclo de vida.
* Promover la incorporación de **requisitos y controles de protección de datos y uso responsable de la IA** en los proyectos dentro de su ámbito de responsabilidad.
* Evaluar **nuevas herramientas y capacidades** para su incorporación segura en la organización, determinando la postura de Seguridad y Privacidad ante los riesgos de IA y proponiendo medidas para su mitigación y priorización.
* Participar en proyectos que requieran la **aplicación de la IA a problemas de ciberseguridad**.
* Proponer, elaborar y revisar **normas y procedimientos** alineados con el Plan Director de Seguridad de Mapfre y con la legislación y normativa aplicable en materia de **Protección de Datos e Inteligencia Artificial**.
* Participar en la implantación y evolución del **marco corporativo de IA Responsable**, alineado con el Reglamento Europeo de IA, GDPR y demás normativa aplicable.
* Realizar **evaluaciones de impacto y análisis de riesgo**s relacionados con soluciones de **IA, IA Generativa, plataformas agénticas y agentes autónomos**.
* Mantener **inventarios de casos de uso de IA** y colaborar en los procesos de **clasificación y supervisión de riesgos**.
* Realizar un **seguimiento continuo de tecnologías emergentes** relacionadas con IA Generativa, IA Agéntica, seguridad de IA, gobierno y protección de datos.
* Colaborar con las áreas de **Data e IA, Tecnología, Operaciones e Innovación** para asegurar que los requisitos y controles de Seguridad y Privacidad se diseñan, implantan y actúan con efectividad, impulsando la IA responsable de forma coherente en toda la organización.
* Trabajar en un **entorno global y multidisciplinar**, en contacto con las distintas geografías y áreas globales, para garantizar el **cumplimiento de la legislación y el marco regulatorio vigente**, conforme a los criterios y principios establecidos por la Dirección Corporativa de Seguridad.
* Proponer, implantar, mejorar y coordinar la **medición de indicadores de Protección de Datos e Inteligencia Artificial** con las distintas entidades y países de Mapfre.
**¿Qué necesitamos que sepas?**
-------------------------------


* Más de 4 años de experiencia en **Seguridad y Privacidad, frameworks, políticas, estándares, regulaciones y prácticas/disciplinas de riesgo tecnológico**.
* Más de 1 año de experiencia en **securización de arquitecturas con tecnologías de IA/ML y análisis de datos, gobernanza de datos e IA y gobernanza de tecnologías digitales emergentes**.
* Experiencia de al menos 1 año en **despliegues de proyectos IA en entornos cloud** (Azure, Amazon, Google).

title: Senior User Acquisition Manager
description:
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort\-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

  

We are seeking a data\-driven and strategic **Senior User Acquisition Manager** to lead our Meta Ads efforts across the US region. Reporting to our Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for scaling high\-budget campaigns and optimizing complex funnels to drive enrollment for our high\-value tech programs.

  

Requirements:
  

* 4\+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition, with hands\-on account work at real budgets in expensive markets in the last year or two.
* You have experience with expensive acquisition and long, multi\-step funnels — education, B2B, fintech, high\-ticket services — in the last two to three years, not earlier in your resume.
* Comfort with narrow audiences and thin data, where judgment fills the gap statistics won't, and a clear answer to what "enough delivery to decide" means.
* You know full\-funnel economics — CAC, contribution, cohorts, lead\-to\-call, call\-to\-sale — and read CRM and BI data alongside the ad account.
* Attribution, conversion events, pixels, and tracking QA are things you've owned, not things someone did for you.
* Strong craft: A/B testing offers and creatives, and briefs a production team can run with.
* AI is already how you work — Claude, call\-analysis tools, MCP connectors, choosing the right model, catching hallucinations.
* Full professional English level.

  

Brand:
  

TripleTen  

  

What you will do:
  

* Own the budget and paid strategy for the advanced programs line — roughly $200K/month today, scaling several times over by year\-end.
* Run Meta and Google (YouTube included) as core volume channels; open LinkedIn and run experiments in Reddit and Twitter.
* Own campaign and ad\-set architecture, plus the keep\-or\-kill calls: small batches, a data threshold before deciding, weekly cadence, an honest decision log.
* Brief the content producer and judge the output on metrics — you don't write scripts or build pages, creatives, or dashboards yourself.
* Own traffic quality rather than cost per lead: read sales call transcripts, see who actually shows up, and influence target\-audience share.
* Own attribution and conversion events — pixel and event setup, separate buying infrastructure, and reconciling the ad account against CRM and BI.
* Take each new program in the line into your channels with its own funnel and targets, adding sales rather than redistributing share.

  

What we can offer you:  

  

  

* Competitive compensation.
* Full\-time remote contract with a flexible schedule.
* A close\-knit, international team of thoughtful and driven professionals.
* All software licenses and remote work tools you need to be successful in a remote working environment (Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc).

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

**About the Role:**



We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to own and execute the vision for our data transformation layer. You will be at the heart of our data platform, which processes hundreds of millions of events daily from a wide array of sources, including transactional databases, API logs, CRMs, payment systems, and marketing platforms.



You will join our 100% remote team and work closely with Data Engineers (who manage data ingestion) and Data Scientists and Business Users (who consume your data models). Your primary responsibility will be to use dbt and Trino on our GCP\-based, open\-source data infrastructure to build robust, scalable data models. These models are critical for stakeholders across the company—from finance and operations to the executive team—and are delivered via BI tools, reports, and reverse ETL systems.


**What You'll Do:**


* Own the Transformation Layer: Design, build, and maintain scalable data models using dbt and SQL to support diverse business needs, from monthly financial reporting to near\-real\-time operational metrics.
* Set Technical Standards: Establish and enforce best practices for data modelling, development, testing, and monitoring to ensure data quality, integrity (up to cent\-level precision), and discoverability.
* Enable Stakeholders: Collaborate directly with finance, operations, customer success, and marketing teams to understand their requirements and deliver reliable data products.
* Integrate and Deliver: Create repeatable patterns for integrating our data models with BI tools and reverse ETL processes, enabling consistent metric reporting across the business.
* Ensure Quality: Champion high standards for development, including robust change management, source control, code reviews, and data monitoring as our products and data evolve.


**What You Need (Must\-Haves):**


* 4\+ years of experience in analytics engineering or data engineering with a strong focus on the "T" (transformation) in ELT.
* Proven track record of owning data products end\-to\-end, applying analytics and data engineering best practices to ensure data quality, scalability, and robust data models.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and collaborating with stakeholders to define requirements; able to take ownership with minimal oversight in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience proactively identifying and implementing improvements to data warehouse performance and ETL efficiency.

* + Expert\-level SQL and DBT skills for complex queries and data transformations.

	+ Hands\-on experience with query optimization across OLTP and OLAP systems (e.g., Postgres, Iceberg).

* Experience with data ingestion tools (e.g., Airbyte) and orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).

title: ECommerce Designer
description:
Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms.



Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology\-led eCommerce business with an ambitious growth strategy. Our AI\-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.



As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.



We are looking for a talented and conceptual Mid Weight Designer to bolster our Content team. Reporting to the Content Operations Manager, you will be responsible for supporting them with content optimisation projects, for multiple high\-profile clients, across a range of marketplaces (primarily Amazon). You will also need to be comfortable managing design projects. We are looking for someone who does more than just execute briefs; we need a strategic thinker who considers how Marketplace assets function across different cultures and markets, all while maintaining brand integrity.



You will be naturally motivated and eager to learn. You'll work alongside other designers and copywriters. You'll produce assets for e\-commerce, from concept through to final artwork, as well as contributing to the growth of the Luzern's Content offering. You'll be proactive and well organised, showcasing your capabilities to problem solve design issues working independently and collaboratively, while being adept at handling tight deadlines, across multiple projects, in a fast\-paced start\-up environment.



You will have experience in using Adobe Creative Suite and Figma to produce digital creative assets, strong written and verbal communication skills, as well as the desire to understand brands and accurately represent them on marketplaces. An interest in E\-Commerce \& marketplace industry trends will be beneficial.



You will be an integral part of the team, bringing new ideas and expertise that helps evolve the Content team.


**Tasks**
---------


**What You'll Be Doing**


* Design creative assets for Amazon and other e\-commerce platforms, from concept to final artwork
* Translate client briefs into engaging, on\-brand visual content
* Manage multiple concurrent projects with tight deadlines
* Collaborate with the Content Operations Manager and team to deliver high\-quality, timely work
* Communicate design ideas and feedback clearly to internal stakeholders and clients
* Maintain consistency and attention to detail across all outputs
* Proactively identify issues or dependencies and raise them early
* Stay current with design trends, marketplace standards, and UX best practices
* Provide feedback and guidance to junior designers or third party partners
* Conduct or support training sessions in Adobe Creative Suite for the team
* Define overall content strategies for our clients and provide feedback on designs and copy created

**Requirements**
----------------


**Required Skills \& Experience**


* Minimum 2 years' hands\-on experience designing for Amazon (e.g. A\+ content, Storefronts, PDP imagery)
* Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite — Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign (3\+ years required)
* Experience producing content for digital or e\-commerce platforms
* Fluent English, written and spoken, is essential
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects
* Excellent time management and prioritisation skills
* High attention to visual detail, layout, and brand alignment
* Proactive mindset and strong problem\-solving abilities
* Ability to work well both in a team and independently
* Collaborative team player, yet self\-sufficient in execution
* Experience in optimizing content based on performance metrics and A/B test results
* Knowledge of design principles, typography, and color theory


**Advantages but not essential**


* Portfolio showcasing relevant Amazon and e\-commerce design work
* Amazon Content experience (1 year preferred)
* Design related qualification
* Experience designing with generative AI

**Benefits**
------------


**What We Offer**


* **Competitive Compensation:** Attractive salary package with benefits.
* **Work\-Life Balance:** Competitive annual leave and flexible working arrangements.
* **Growth Opportunities**: Access to learning and development programs to enhance your skills.
* **Culture and Environment**: A fun, inclusive, and collaborative workplace.
* **Wellbeing Support:** Access to an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

title: Director of Live Roadmap & Release Operations | MONOPOLY GO!
IT Manager
description:
**About the role**


We’re opening a delivery centre in Valencia. We are looking for an IT Manager to take operational ownership of the projects delivered there and to work as the direct deputy of the person running the site.


This is a launch role. The centre is being set up now, the team is being hired now, and the way it works has not been decided yet. Our site lead stays close to the clients and to business development. You take the operational side: framing the projects, running delivery, coordinating the teams, and helping build the structure as it grows. You will be introduced to clients as his counterpart, so the role is visible from day one. The scope is deliberately broad. It sits across project management, product ownership and business analysis, and the balance shifts from one project to the next. Generative AI is a real part of how they works.


The role does not require deep technical AI expertise, no agent development, no RAG, no MCP. It requires genuine curiosity and handson practice with AI tools, enough to hold a conversation with the engineering teams, spot the use cases worth pursuing, and bring them into the product roadmap.


Contract type Permanent or freelance to start, depending on what suits you.


If starting freelance, permanent contract required after a few months.


**Your responsibilities**


1\. **Project framing** Gather and formalize business requirements with stakeholders. Define scope, deliverables, milestones and success criteria. Write the requirement documents, functional specifications and technical specifications.


2\. **Product roadmap** Build and prioritize the product roadmap against business value and technical constraints. Arbitrate between business needs, technical reality and deadlines. Own the timeline and keep stakeholders informed.


3\. **Technical delivery** Write user stories, specifications and acceptance criteria. Prioritise and manage the backlog. Validate deliverables with both the technical and the business side. Coordinate across teams: development, design, data and external providers.


4\. **Budget Estimate** and track project effort and budget. Report regularly to management and sponsors. Optimize the balance between internal resources and external providers.


5\. **Risk and trade\-offs** Identify and manage project risks. Arbitrate between technical constraints and business objectives. Escalate blockers to the right level at the right time.


6\. **Governance** Run project committees and agile ceremonies, from sprint reviews through to planning sessions. Prepare progress reporting materials. Report to sponsors and management.


7\. **Stakeholder management** Act as the interface between the creative, technical, business and client sides. Adapt your communication to each audience and manage expectations. Hold the position of facilitator and arbitrator between parties.


8\. **Team coordination** Lead or coordinate technical teams, internal and external. Distribute workload, follow performance, keep the team engaged.


9\. **Quality and acceptance** Define acceptance criteria. Validate that deliverables meet them before they go to production.


10\. **Release and post\-launch** Coordinate deployments and production releases. Track performance indicators after launch.


11\. **Methodology** Work in Agile and Scrum, or in a V\-cycle where the context calls for it. Adapt the methodological framework to the maturity of the organisation you are working with.


12\. **Bringing AI into the work** Keep an active watch on generative AI tools and how they are actually being used. Identify where AI genuinely saves time in the product and project process, whether that is drafting specifications, generating summaries or automating repetitive work. Hold a credible conversation with the engineering teams on AI topics without needing to implement them yourself

**Your profile**


Education Bachelor's or Master's level in engineering, project management, computer science or equivalent.


Experience 5 to 15 years in IT project management, product ownership or business analysis, ideally a mix of the three.


**Languages**


* French is required. Several of our clients work in French and you’re working closely with the president and director.
* English is required. The engineering team works in English.
* Spanish is not required. Location
* Based in Valencia, or ready to relocate there. This role is not open to full remote. Proximity matters more here than in any other role in the team, because the job is built around working side by side with the site lead.
* Trips to Paris every month needed to visit the rest of the team there.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people \- helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.


What started in Poland is now an international, cloud\-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.


For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.


Working in a rapidly growing, ever\-changing scale\-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.


The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:
As a Director of Engineering reporting to the Chief Technology Officer in our Provider Domain, your purpose will be to own the technical strategy and delivery for the systems hundreds of thousands of independent businesses run on every day. You will:

* Own end\-to\-end delivery across 4–5 cross\-functional teams, leading through Engineering Managers and Staff\+ Engineers in a deliberately flat structure with no layers in between.
* Set the engineering standard for the domain — building the frameworks for architecture decisions, technical proposals and how teams work.
* Lead our AI transformation of the engineering lifecycle, and define the measures that prove it worked.
* Partner with Product to turn commercial strategy into engineering strategy, and back it with experimentation and data.
* Build a team of exceptional density, coaching leaders who can operate autonomously.

  

**Requirements**  

  

Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…* To think like a product owner, not a ticket\-deliverer — you understand unit economics, funnels and growth mechanics, and the commercial impact of what your teams ship.
* Experience personally establishing engineering rigor: architecture decision records, technical proposals and standardised ways of working that teams actually adopted.
* Practical experience embedding AI tooling into the day\-to\-day engineering lifecycle — and a clear view on how to measure the impact and protect code quality.
* To have led multiple squads through Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers in a high\-growth scale\-up or high\-transaction marketplace or SaaS business, while staying close to the work.
* At a minimum we require conversational level English language skills. Why? English is our company language and is used for any business\-wide communications, so we need you to be able to speak English to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.


It will also help you to have…* Experience with two\-sided marketplaces or booking platforms.
* Exposure to growth engineering or growth experimentation.
* B2B SaaS experience at scale.

  

**Benefits**  

* We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote\-first.
* Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote \- either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.
* Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists.

 **How AI helps us find great people**


Think of our AI tool as a really smart assistant for our recruitment team. Its job? To help us move faster, stay consistent, and make sure no great candidates are overlooked. Every application goes through the same AI review to help us spot skills that match the role \- but don't worry, AI never makes the decisions. Real people do. Our recruiters and hiring managers handle every final call. And we regularly review how the tool is used to keep things fair, ethical, and compliant with data protection laws. Curious about how it works? You can always ask how AI was used in your application \- it won't affect your chances in any way.

**Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:**


We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at belonging@booksy.com, so we can best support you.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English to ensure it is successfully reviewed.

title: Process Mining Consultant
description:
**Company Description** **Talan – Positive Innovation**


Talan is an international consulting group specializing in innovation and business transformation through technology. With over 7,200 consultants in 21 countries and a turnover of €850M, we are committed to delivering impactful, future\-ready solutions.

**Talan at a Glance**


Headquartered in Paris and operating globally, Talan combines technology, innovation, and empowerment to deliver measurable results for our clients. Over the past 22 years, we’ve built a strong presence in the IT and consulting landscape, and we’re on track to reach €1 billion in revenue this year.

**Our Core Areas of Expertise**

* **Data \& Technologies:** We design and implement large\-scale, end\-to\-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.
* **Cloud \& Application Services:** We integrate leading platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, and IBM Maximo, helping clients transition to the cloud and improve operational efficiency.
* **Management \& Innovation Consulting:** We lead business and digital transformation initiatives through project and change management best practices (PM, PMO, Agile, Scrum, Product Ownership), and support domains such as Supply Chain, Cybersecurity, and ESG/Low\-Carbon strategies.

**We work with major global clients across diverse sectors, including Transport \& Logistics, Financial Services, Energy \& Utilities, Retail, and Media \& Telecommunications.**

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for a **Process Mining Consultant** to join a business process analysis and improvement project within an international corporate environment. The successful candidate will work with transactional data from SAP systems and other sources to reconstruct how processes are actually executed, generate process statistics and KPIs, and identify measurable improvement opportunities.


The objective of this role is to provide end\-to\-end visibility into processes such as **Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing**, translating analytical findings into actionable recommendations for business teams.


Responsibilities

* Extract, model, and prepare event logs from SAP and other source systems.
* Build and configure analyses in **Celonis** and/or **SAP Signavio Process Intelligence**.
* Reconstruct As\-Is processes and identify process variants, deviations, and rework.
* Calculate and monitor process KPIs and statistics, including throughput time, cycle time, waiting time, rework rate, automation rate, and conformance.
* Identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and root causes, quantifying their operational and financial impact.
* Design dashboards and visualizations to support decision\-making.
* Present findings and improvement plans to business and IT stakeholders.
* Measure the impact of implemented actions and perform continuous follow\-up.
* Collaborate with SAP functional teams, data engineering teams, and process owners.

  

**Qualifications**  

Mandatory Requirements

* 3\-5\+ years of experience in **Process Mining**, process analysis, or process intelligence.
* Hands\-on experience building analyses in **Celonis** and/or **SAP Signavio Process Intelligence** (not limited to consuming existing dashboards).
* Strong SQL skills and experience in data modeling and data processing.
* Experience working with data from **SAP ECC** and/or **SAP S/4HANA**.
* Knowledge of at least one of the following end\-to\-end processes: **Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Supply Chain, or Manufacturing**.
* Ability to define KPIs and translate data analysis into business recommendations.
* Professional level of English to work in an international environment.


Nice\-to\-Have Requirements

* Knowledge of SAP modules and tables, including **MM, SD, FI, PP, and WM**.
* **Celonis PQL** and/or **SAP Signavio Process Intelligence** certification.
* Experience with **Python**, ETL tools, or **Power BI**.
* Knowledge of **BPMN**, **Lean Six Sigma**, or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Previous experience in **FMCG**, food industry, or industrial environments.
* Knowledge of **SAP Activate** or **S/4HANA transformation programs**.

  

**Additional Information** **What do we offer you?**

* B2B or employment contract
* **Remote within Spain Time zone.**
* Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

**If you are passionate about data, development \& tech, we want to meet you !**

title: ML Engineer
description:
At Aristocrat, we are advancing gaming technology with modern, powerful solutions. Our mission is to bring happiness to life through play. We value collaboration, creativity, and a strong passion for excellence. These roles primarily support the Machine Learning area of our Product Madness business line — a tech company specialised in social casino mobile games. We are looking for an ML Engineer to join our MLOps team and strengthen its modeling core. You will own machine learning models end to end, from data and experimentation to production, and help us build the monitoring and experimentation culture that keeps them reliable and aligned with the business over time. You will make a real difference in our products and players' experiences.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design, train, evaluate and retrain machine learning models — with emphasis on recommender systems — that support game features, player experience, and operational efficiency.
* Own the design of our model performance monitoring: define what to track (drift, data quality, degradation), thresholds, and what “the model is still healthy” means in business terms.
* Help establish a solid experimentation culture: model versioning and experiment tracking with tools such as MLflow or Weights \& Biases, so experiments are reproducible and model versions are easy to compare and promote.
* Help establish a model governance culture: define how models are promoted to production and lay the foundations of the communication contract between the MLOps team and Data Science.
* Create templates and cookiecutter scaffolding to standardise how Data Science structures, hands off, and communicates its models and experiments.
* Build robust training and feature\-engineering pipelines, and write clean, production\-ready Python and SQL.
* Explore and contribute to early\-stage projects involving LLMs, RAG and agentic AI where they bring value — as a complement to the role, not its core.
* Develop simple interfaces (e.g., Streamlit) to expose ML capabilities to non\-technical users when useful.
* Collaborate with teams across product, data, and engineering, and communicate results, limitations, and recommendations clearly across technical and business audiences.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 4\+ years of experience applying machine learning to real\-world problems, from data to deployment.
* Proven experience with recommender systems (collaborative filtering, ranking, or similar) applied to real products.
* Strong Python skills and hands\-on experience with ML libraries (scikit\-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow, XGBoost or similar).
* Solid SQL expertise and experience working with large data warehouses.
* Hands\-on experience with experiment tracking and/or model registry tools (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, or equivalent).
* Experience designing or contributing to model monitoring / performance tracking in production.
* Comfort working with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure), Docker, and Airflow.
* A strong analytical foundation, with a background in a quantitative field (mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering) or equivalent experience.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses.
* Hands\-on experience building applications with Generative AI (LLMs), including API integration.
* Interest or early experience in RAG systems — whether through prototypes, side projects, or professional work.
* Interest or familiarity with agentic AI concepts or frameworks (e.g., LangChain agents, CrewAI).
* Ability to build simple user interfaces (e.g., Streamlit) to expose ML models to wider teams.

**Why Aristocrat?**
-------------------


Aristocrat is a world leader in gaming content and technology, and a top\-tier publisher of free\-to\-play mobile games. Aristocrat has three operating business units, spanning regulated land\-based gaming (Aristocrat Gaming), social casino (Product Madness), and regulated online real\-money gaming (Aristocrat Interactive).
