title: Associate Director, Clinical AI
description:
Posted date Sep. 21, 2026
Contract type Full time
Job ID R\-260355
  
**Why choose AstraZeneca Spain?**
---------------------------------


AstraZeneca Spain is a rising force in our global business. With headquarters in Madrid and our global hub in Barcelona, we’ve become an important international centre of excellence in the fight against critical disease. Boasting vibrant universities and business schools, the Barcelona ecosystem is a place where scientists can thrive. We attract a diverse workforce from across the globe, shining a beacon for innovation in a country that’s committed to clinical development.


We invite you to bring your talents to Barcelona where our respiratory medicine R\&D and Global Marketing centre offers opportunities in R\&D, IT, Commercial and HR. Or join us in Madrid and shape our growth in our BUs (Respiratory, Oncology \& CVRM ), and a range of Corporate functions. Additionally, you can find sales roles throughout the country. Together, we’re contributing to a world\-leading pipeline of therapeutics and delivering life\-changing medicines to patients.


**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------


Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca Spain, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. Alongside technical expertise, colleagues have the resilience, energy and collaborative mindset to change lanes, work with different teams and start projects from scratch.


Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting\-edge technology. Whether you join us in Madrid or Barcelona, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.


**Success Profile**
-------------------


Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth\-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.


### **Diverse collaborators**


This is a speak\-up culture that values collaboration. You’ll proactively bring your unique perspectives, experiences and skills to the table and seek the same from others. With our international team composition and the need for fast\-paced collaboration, you’ll always be building new connections with colleagues.


### **Cutting\-edge innovators**


When you join us, you’ll be part of a team that embraces digital technology and data to transform the way we work and the work we do. Every day, you’ll help make history, empowered to ignite your creativity and build something enduring.


### **Resilient trailblazers**


Here, the answers aren’t always available. So, you’ll need to bring a fearless, self\-starter mindset to navigate uncharted territories. You’ll harness your ceaseless energy to discover and make the necessary connections with colleagues to shape the future and achieve maximum impact.


### **Agile movers**


Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-260355 **Date posted** 09/21/2026
**About AstraZeneca and AISI**


At AstraZeneca, technology and science meet to change what is possible for patients. We are building a connected, end\-to\-end Enterprise AI engine — uniting data foundations, AI technology, process reinvention, and business\-facing AI to accelerate results across the whole value chain. Success depends on being exceptional connectors: you will actively leverage existing capabilities, celebrate and promote reuse, export breakthrough ideas across geographies and functions, and obsess over scaling impact rather than building in isolation.


AI Science \& Innovation (AISI) sits at the centre of AstraZeneca's R\&D AI transformation. Our remit is to build, buy, and deliver the AI models and agents that change pipeline outcomes, across discovery, translational science, biomarkers, and clinical development.


Within AISI, the BioPharma Clinical Development AI team is building world\-class AI capability to accelerate the design, conduct, and analysis of clinical trials across our BioPharmaceuticals pipeline — spanning both early and late phase programmes. We partner closely with clinical development, regulatory, and biometrics teams to bring better treatments to patients faster, while adhering to the highest evidentiary standards.


**The Opportunity**


Bringing new treatments to patients demands scientific excellence at every stage of development. In the AI for Clinical Development, BioPharma AIR\&D team, we focus on one of the most data\-rich and decision\-intensive parts of that journey: clinical development. Trial design, patient selection, dose optimisation, biomarker strategy, and safety evaluation each represent genuine opportunities where AI and machine learning can add rigour, speed, and precision — not as a replacement for clinical and statistical expertise, but as a powerful complement to it. We hold ourselves to measurable standards of improvement, and we build methods that can be evaluated, reproduced, and trusted in regulatory settings.


You will work across the enterprise to define and deliver on AstraZeneca's most pressing clinical development questions — collaborating in cross\-functional teams spanning the key BioPharmaceuticals disease areas of cardiovascular, renal, metabolic disease, respiratory, and immunology. You and the team will apply new methods to measurably advance the late\-stage drug pipeline, and you will help invent reusable approaches that scale across programmes and geographies.


AI for clinical development is a field in motion. Foundation models, agentic systems, and causal AI are advancing rapidly, and the regulatory and methodological frameworks around them are evolving in parallel. As an Associate Director, Data Scientist in the AI for Clinical Development team, you will be hands\-on at the frontier — developing, evaluating, and deploying AI methods that directly inform clinical trial design and decision\-making across early and late phase programmes. Every model you build will eventually touch a trial that decides whether a patient gets a better therapy. That is the bar we hold ourselves to.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Develop, evaluate, and deploy reusable AI and machine learning methods for clinical trial settings — including innovative trial design support, dose optimisation, biomarker discovery, digital twins and predictive modelling for early and late phase decisions, and safety and efficacy signal detection.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of data science projects, from problem framing and methodology selection through to implementation, validation, and adoption within study teams.
* Partner with Clinical Development, Study Teams, Biometrics, and Regulatory colleagues to embed AI and analytical strategy into study design and decision\-making workflows.
* Build reusable, well\-documented data products — including pipelines, packages, and applications — with a software engineering mindset, ensuring quality, reproducibility, and maintainability across the enterprise.
* Apply and evaluate cutting\-edge methodologies, including foundation models, agentic AI systems, generative patient models, longitudinal and time\-series modelling, Bayesian inference, and causal inference, proposing fit\-for\-purpose approaches with clear evaluation criteria.
* Drive data\-centric AI practices: acquire, curate, and quality\-control datasets for model training, post\-training, benchmarking, and evaluation in clinical and regulatory settings.
* Contribute to the development of AI evaluation and benchmarking frameworks suitable for clinical and regulatory settings.
* Engage actively with internal data science communities and external scientific forums; contribute to publications and conference presentations as a recognised scientific contributor.
* Provide coaching and technical guidance to Senior Data Scientists and peer colleagues, promoting best practice and a culture of scientific rigour.

**Essential Requirements**


* PhD preferred; MSc with an exceptional computational track record considered. Disciplines: Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, or a closely related quantitative field.
* 2–5 years of post\-PhD (or equivalent) experience in AI and machine learning method development, with demonstrated impact in clinical, biomedical, or drug development settings (e.g. models delivered, first\-author publications, open\-source contributions, SaMD filings).
* Deep experience, knowledge, and understanding of one or more fields of biology, with hands\-on experience working with biological data such as molecular (DNA, RNA, protein), imaging (radiology, microscopy), or clinical text (EHR, clinical notes).
* Deep technical expertise in modern AI methodologies, including one or more of: foundation model training and fine\-tuning; Bayesian inference; temporal and longitudinal modelling; multimodal integration; model calibration and domain adaptation; data\-centric AI; model interpretability; model post\-training and alignment.
* Exceptional software development skills in Python, leveraging frontier coding agent frameworks; experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch) and modern LLM tooling.
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying robust, reusable analytical solutions, including familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Proven track record of translating complex methodologies into actionable insights and embedding solutions within cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical findings clearly to clinical, regulatory, and scientific audiences.

**Desirable Skills and Experience**


* Experience in early or late phase pharmaceutical or clinical development, including clinical trial design, biomarker discovery, companion diagnostics, dosing, safety, endpoints, or regulatory processes.
* Experience with clinical AI evaluation and benchmarking in prospective or submission\-relevant settings.
* Knowledge of uncertainty quantification and model interpretability methods.
* Experience with MLOps or LLMOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with multimodal data integration across molecular, imaging, and clinical modalities.
* Peer\-reviewed publications in clinical AI, computational drug development, or machine learning venues.
* Knowledge of computing hardware and its impact on model training and inference.
* Experience working in complex global organisations.

**Soft Skills**


* Strong proficiency in augmenting — but not supplanting — daily knowledge work with agentic AI tools.
* Proactively up\-to\-date with the latest AI research; tries out new tools and methods of interest without waiting to be directed.
* Team\-oriented mindset: does what is best for the team and the programme, not just the individual project.
* Ability to deliver high\-quality contributions independently and at pace.
* Comfort with ambiguity and an instinct to learn in public, prototype early, and fail forward.

**Why AstraZeneca?**


Here, technology and science meet to change what is possible for patients. You will join a company investing boldly in AI and data to become truly data\-led, where unexpected teams come together to address problems that have never been solved before. We empower scientists to experiment, prototype early, fail forward, and partner credibly across communities — ML, clinical, biostatistics, regulatory.


We value learning agility and technical excellence equally. The strongest contributors here are those who learn fast, are comfortable with ambiguity, and obsess over real\-world impact rather than building in isolation. Your work will directly influence trials that shape whether patients receive better therapies.


We balance the expectation of being in the office — on average at least three days per week — while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.


When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.


**So, What's Next?**


Are you ready to build AI that matters — at the intersection of machine learning, clinical science, and real patient impact? Submit your CV and cover letter and let us explore how your expertise can help AstraZeneca accelerate the next wave of breakthrough medicines.


Find out more at: https://careers.astrazeneca.com/...

=============================================


**Senior UX/UI Designer \- Digital Products (m/f/d)**
=====================================================


We are looking for people who are passionate about technology and are excited to create the best experience for our customers. People who want to make an impact. We are looking for people like you. **Let's Go!**
### **Your tasks**


As a (Senior) UX/UI Designer – Digital Products, you design intuitive, effective and visually clear experiences across our digital ecosystem (web, app and internal applications). You apply a Lean UX mindset – working iteratively, testing assumptions early and focusing on measurable outcomes rather than heavy documentation.


You collaborate closely with Product, Engineering and Data/AI to define problems, test hypotheses and ship solutions grounded in data, user research and continuous feedback – for both human users and AI/synthetic users (e.g. automated agents or AI\-powered systems).


Depending on your experience, you will either grow into or already take on a senior role with greater ownership, stakeholder alignment and mentoring responsibilities.


* Own and drive the end\-to\-end UX and UI design process for selected digital products and features (from discovery to delivery)
* Apply Lean UX principles:
	+ Work in small, iterative steps
	+ Use light\-weight artefacts (sketches, prototypes)
	+ Validate assumptions quickly with users and data
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data/AI and Business to:
	+ Understand user needs, pain points and business goals
	+ Define problem statements, hypotheses and success metrics
	+ Prioritise and plan design work within the product roadmap
* Design user journeys, flows and interactions across touchpoints (web, app, tools) to ensure a coherent, frictionless experience
* Create wireframes, interaction concepts and low\- to high\-fidelity prototypes; deliver final UI aligned with our brand, design system and accessibility standards

title: Senior UX Designer (Space Engineers Franchise)
description:
At Keen Software House, we develop large\-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.


**We are looking for a Senior UX Designer with professional experience in the video game industry to join our international team working across Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2\.**



Space Engineers is a complex sandbox game built around engineering, construction, exploration, survival, and player creativity. That complexity is part of what makes the game unique \- but it also creates significant UX challenges.



We are looking for someone who can take real ownership of how players interact with our systems, identify usability problems, and turn complex mechanics and information into clear and intuitive player experiences.



Because we are a relatively small team, we are looking for a hands\-on and versatile UX Designer who can contribute beyond UX theory, wireframes, and documentation. Strong UX expertise is the foundation of the role, but ideally you also bring visual/UI design skills or, alternatively, experience with technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation. Visual/UI design is particularly valuable for us given the current composition of the team.



You will work closely with Game Design, Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, helping shape both existing and new features from early concepts through to implementation.



We expect you to act as a proactive UX partner \- identify friction, challenge existing solutions when needed, test assumptions, and help us establish stronger UX principles across both games.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely within Europe (CET \+/\- 2 hours).**



If you enjoy challenging work, autonomy, impact, and responsibility, come and join us

  


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **5\+ years of professional experience as a UX Designer, Game UX Designer, or similar role, with significant experience working in the video game industry on PC and/or console games**
* Proven experience designing UX for shipped video games, ideally across multiple features or systems
* Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating your UX process, including problem definition, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, iteration, and final solutions
* Hands\-on approach to UX design, **with experience in at least one adjacent discipline that allows you to contribute beyond UX documentation – ideally UI/visual design, or alternatively technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation**
* Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, user flows, usability principles, navigation systems, and information hierarchy
* Experience working on sandbox, simulation, strategy, management, or other systems\-heavy games
* Strong experience designing UX for complex and interconnected game systems, such as inventories, building systems, crafting, progression, control schemes, or similar mechanics
* Ability to make complex mechanics and information understandable and intuitive without removing their depth
* Strong wireframing and prototyping skills using Figma or equivalent tools
* Experience creating and evolving UX/UI design systems, interaction patterns, and reusable component libraries
* Experience designing UX for both mouse \& keyboard and controller\-based interaction
* Experience validating UX solutions through usability testing, playtesting, player research, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, or similar methods
* Knowledge of accessibility principles in game UX
* Strong design judgment – able to identify usability problems and their root causes, propose practical solutions, and explain design decisions using player needs, evidence, and clear reasoning
* Ability to work effectively with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, understand technical and production constraints, and incorporate them into UX solutions
* Proactive and self\-driven, with the ability to work independently, iterate quickly, receive feedback, and adapt solutions when needed
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.


**Nice to have**
----------------


* Strong visual/UI design skills, including typography, layout, iconography, visual hierarchy, and the ability to take UX concepts through to polished, production\-ready interface designs
* Experience creating or adapting UI assets and working within an established visual language or art direction
* Experience implementing or integrating UI directly in a game engine or proprietary engine
* Experience combining UX design with UI/visual design and/or technical implementation within the same role
* Experience working on live games and improving established systems without disrupting existing player workflows or expectations
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation, engineering, or other technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Production Director and be part of a Game design team
* Take ownership of UX across **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**, covering both existing systems and new features
* Identify player friction and usability problems, understand their root causes, and propose practical improvements
* Work with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA from the early stages of feature development to shape solutions that balance player needs, game design intent, visual clarity, technical feasibility, and production constraints
* Translate complex mechanics, systems, and requirements into clear and intuitive player experiences


**Define and improve:**


* + player flows and navigation
	+ information architecture and interaction patterns
	+ menus, HUD, and in\-game interactions
	+ system feedback
	+ onboarding and discoverability
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and UX specifications, exploring and validating solutions early before significant development time is invested
* Take solutions beyond UX documentation where appropriate to your skill set – whether through polished UI/visual design, high\-fidelity prototyping, or contributing to UI integration and implementation
* Use playtesting, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, and other available evidence to validate solutions and guide iteration
* Follow UX solutions through development, review implementation, and help ensure the intended player experience is preserved in the final product
* Establish and evolve consistent UX principles, interaction patterns, and design systems across both games
* Clearly communicate UX problems, design decisions, and trade\-offs to stakeholders using evidence, player needs, and clear reasoning
* Balance usability with game depth, technical limitations, development cost, existing player expectations, and long\-term maintainability
* Help improve UX practices across the wider development team and ensure UX is considered throughout development rather than treated as a final review step

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Player\-first thinking without oversimplification** – make complex systems understandable while preserving the depth that makes Space Engineers unique
* **Hands\-on, versatile design** – UX should not stop at diagrams or recommendations; be comfortable turning ideas into tangible solutions and contributing beyond a narrowly defined UX role when needed
* **Problem solving over screen production** – understand the underlying player problem before designing the interface
* **Systems thinking** – understand how individual interactions connect to the broader player experience
* **Strong judgment and prioritisation** – recognise where UX problems have the greatest impact, understand trade\-offs, and focus effort where it matters most
* **Clarity over cleverness** – favour solutions that players can understand naturally, without unnecessary complexity
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, test assumptions, take feedback well, and change direction when a better solution emerges
* **Ownership and proactivity** – do not wait for perfectly defined UX problems; identify what needs to be solved and help drive it forward
* **Evidence over opinion** – use player behaviour, usability principles, testing, and clear reasoning rather than personal preference
* **Clear and direct communication** – explain UX problems, decisions, and trade\-offs clearly and challenge ideas constructively

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions


**Time off \& wellbeing**


* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)

description:
**Description:**
----------------


**Company Description :**

**About Marlink**


Wherever our customers are in the world, we help them digitalise and optimise their remote business processes using advanced hybrid network solutions and digital technologies.


Our teams work together across the globe, using constant innovation, expertise and applied technology to bring systems and people together with a future focus. We push boundaries. We combine unrivalled resources and expertise in field engineering with advanced digital technologies such as cyber security, IT, and cloud enablement.


Today, we employ 1500 people in over 30 countries, with customers in the maritime, energy, and humanitarian sectors. We believe in creating a culture where you can develop and thrive. Our commitment to excellence drives our success.

 **About OmniAccess**


OmniAccess is a leading managed service provider of premium connectivity, networking and cyber solutions. From our headquarter in Palma de Mallorca we cater services for superyachts, boutique cruise and research vessels, with a very strong commitment to service quality \& availability. As part of our integral end\-to end solutions, we design, implement and support onboard IT networks, bandwidth management tools and cyber security services, all aimed at providing our clients with premium digital solutions and the best possible user experience.


In 2018, OmniAccess joined forces with the Marlink Group. Marlink is a managed service provider and global leader in remote ICT solutions with annual revenues surpassing $800 million and 1,500 employees operating in more than 30 countries.


Wherever our customers are in the world, we deliver them possibilities to work smarter and to operate more effectively, more safely, more sustainably \- without the limitations of technology.


With our possibility platform, we enable a comprehensive suite of end\-to\-end managed solutions (Connectivity, Network, Cyber Security, Cloud \& IT, IoT \& Apps), supported by professional services, unmatched global operations and delivery capabilities and local support teams.


As a global company with a local focus, we help make tomorrow’s possibilities today’s realities.


This strategic partnership has enabled us to expand our reach and capabilities, offering our clients an even broader range of innovative digital solutions and unparalleled support.


At OmniAccess, our vision is bold and clear: to deliver possibilities anywhere, empower innovation everywhere, and shape the future of maritime digital solutions.

 **Role Purpose:**


Marlink Group is seeking a dynamic Product Architect: Network \& Platform to shape and deliver the Network and Platform domains of the Possibility Portfolio. The scope spans Marlink's Edge infrastructure (CPE) and orchestration framework, and the network services that run on it — SD\-WAN, LAN/Wi\-Fi, bandwidth optimisation, QoS/QoE, and Network Access — across maritime and enterprise environments.


This is a hybrid role between product management and engineering. It is the bridge between business expectations and technical feasibility, and it works in both directions: shaping the products in the category into clear, sellable propositions, and driving their technical execution — requirements, coordination of teams, and proofs of concept.


The role is customer\-centric at its core. It starts from what customers need and how they buy and use our services, keeps that perspective present in every architecture and roadmap decision, and stays close to BUs and customers to make sure what we build is what the market values.

 **Key Responsibilities:**


1\. Commercial Productization

* Shape the products in the Network \& Platform category into clearly defined, sellable propositions — scope, tiers, packaging, and differentiation.
* Work with Pricing, Commercial and BU teams to turn cost and capability drivers into viable pricing and margin structures.
* Provide the technical substance behind go\-to\-market materials — value propositions, capability descriptions, and positioning.
* Support BU pre\-sales and solution reviews, and feed recurring customer requirements back into the roadmap.

  

2\. Requirements \& Feasibility

* Turn product requirements into precise technical specifications — the quality gate between product intent and engineering execution.
* Validate feasibility of roadmap commitments with Group Engineering before sign\-off.
* Translate engineering constraints and trade\-offs into product implications for the Head of Product and governance forums.

  

3\. Reference Architecture

* Own and maintain the Network \& Platform reference architecture — CPE, orchestration and service onboarding; SD\-WAN, LAN/Wi\-Fi, WAN optimisation, QoS/QoE and Network Access — co\-defined with Group Engineering.
* Define the integration requirements that let Connectivity, Cloud \& IT, Cyber and IoT services deploy consistently through the platform.
* Maintain architecture documentation, design standards and capability catalogues as shared Group standards.

  

4\. Technical Execution \& Team Coordination

* Drive product initiatives from requirement to release, coordinating across Group Engineering, IT, Cybersecurity and BU technical teams.
* Sequence dependencies between network and platform workstreams; surface conflicts and trade\-offs early.
* Act as the technical reference point during implementation, resolving ambiguity and arbitrating design decisions against product intent.
* Track delivery against roadmap commitments and report status and risks into governance.

  

5\. Governance \& BU Engagement

* Set architecture standards and ensure BU implementations conform to Possibility Portfolio guardrails.
* Engage BU product and technical teams regularly to capture local and customer requirements and feed them into the global roadmap.

  

6\. Innovation \& Proof of Concept

* Track emerging technologies — edge computing, virtualisation, AI\-driven operations and SD\-WAN, SASE, intent\-based networking — and market and customer trends relevant to the portfolio.
* Run proof\-of\-concept initiatives with Engineering to validate new capabilities, technically and commercially, before roadmap commitment.
* Define what each PoC must prove and convert the outcome into a clear recommendation: proceed, adapt, or stop.

 **Success Outcomes:**

* Products in the category are clearly defined, commercially coherent and ready to sell.
* Roadmap commitments are consistently feasibility\-validated before sign\-off.
* Engineering receives unambiguous, well\-structured requirements.
* Initiatives move from requirement to release with dependencies managed and without avoidable rework.
* The reference architecture is the recognised standard across Group Engineering and BU teams, with reduced variance across Business Units.
* New capabilities are validated through structured PoCs before commitment.

  


**Requirements:**
-----------------


**Skills \& Experience:**

**The Hybrid Profile**

* Track record at the boundary of product and engineering — a PM with deep architecture exposure, a Solutions Architect who moved into product, or a Network/Technical Lead with commercial instincts.
* Able to write a product requirement, review a design, and defend a commercial construct with equal rigour.
* Customer\-oriented: understands customer needs and translates them into product and architecture decisions.
* Comfortable engaging commercial, portfolio and engineering stakeholders in the same working day, and coordinating teams without direct authority.

 **Technical Depth**

* Solid understanding of SD\-WAN, LAN/Wi\-Fi, QoS/QoE, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF) and multi\-access WAN architectures.
* Solid understanding of edge computing, CPE, virtualisation, container orchestration and service lifecycle automation.
* Knowledge of SASE, SSE and ZTNA as applied to managed network services and security at the edge.
* Familiarity with satellite communications (VSAT, LEO) and their network integration considerations.
* Working knowledge of TM Forum frameworks (eTOM, SID, Open APIs).
* Working knowledge of how AI/ML integrates into edge and network products — deployment patterns, inference at the edge vs. cloud, cost/latency trade\-offs, and observability.

 **Commercial Capability**

* Experience productizing technical capability into sellable managed services — scope, tiering, packaging, positioning.
* Understands the cost and margin drivers of managed services and works constructively with Pricing and Commercial functions.
* Articulates technical differentiation in terms customers and commercial audiences act on.

 **Industry \& Context**

* Background in MSP, telecommunications, network services, managed connectivity, cloud or digital infrastructure.
* Exposure to maritime, mobility, energy or remote enterprise operations is strongly preferred.
* Experience in matrix organisations, influencing BU and cross\-functional teams without direct authority.

 **Why join us:**

  

* Full\-time, permanent position with competitive salary

title: Senior CRM Lifecycle + Journeys Manager
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**



Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer\-to\-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.



What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross\-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.


**OUR CULTURE**



Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.


* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long\-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade\-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member \- no matter their level \- has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.


If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug\-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**THE ROLE**



The **Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle \+ Journeys** owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in\-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win\-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.



This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.



Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity\-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged\-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.



You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.


**Responsibilities**


* Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026\), DE (October 2026\), and FR (November 2026\): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post\-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win\-back, replenishment, care instructions.
* Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end\-to\-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept\-to\-deployment time within 90 days.
* Partner with the Data team to run the triggered\-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.
* Build channel\-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market.
* Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged\-in routing for non\-consenting users.
* Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN\-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.
* Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity\-resolution accuracy.


**Qualifications**


**Required:**

* 6\+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).
* Hands\-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.
* Hands\-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.
* Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.
* SQL proficient. Can self\-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.
* A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).
* Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.
* Detail\-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt\-in state, suppression rules).
* Strong cross\-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.


**Preferred:**


* Multi\-market lifecycle experience (UK \+ DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app\-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR.

**WHY QUINCE?**



Joining Quince means being part of a mission\-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY \& HIRING INTEGRITY**

### **Position**

Being part of LOEWE means learning every day alongside passionate teams in a fast\-paced, ambitious and creative environment.


As **Hardware Industrialization Specialist** , you will drive the end\-to\-end industrialization of new hardware components from design validation through series production, ensuring optimal balance between aesthetic excellence, strict timelines, cost efficiency, and technical reliability.  



### **Job responsibilities**

* Drive time\-to\-production targets and manage launch schedules
* Review and validate aesthetics with Design in alignment with industrialization constraints
* Manage testing processes (request, follow\-up, and validation) alongside suppliers and quality teams
* Conduct price negotiations, capacity analysis, and tooling/mould investments for production
* Optimize manufacturing methods for each launch to drive cost improvements
* Oversee pre\-series control, final approvals, master management, and PLM documentation
* Ensure system price updates and manage production risk analysis
* Provide technical expertise for root cause analysis and quality issue resolution
* Define, improve, and deploy technical standards across projects
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and countertyping analysis
* Build and maintain relationships with industry experts, staying abreast of new technologies, laboratories, and manufacturing advancements
### **Profile**

* 3 to 4 years of experience in a similar role managing development and/or purchasing for leather goods accessories, jewelry, or trimmings
* Degree in Industrial Engineering or Materials Engineering
* Strong negotiation and communication skills
* Proficiency in 3D modeling, rendering, and animation is a plus
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel), familiarity with AI tools, and fluency in various ERP systems
* Knowledge of PLM (Centric) software is a plus
* English proficiency (C1 or C2\) is mandatory; French, Chinese, or Italian is a plus
* Flexibility to travel to Europe and Asia
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Senior Coordinator, PASS Housing
description:

At CEA CAPA, we believe studying and interning abroad is a transformative experience. By immersing themselves in new cultures, our students gain valuable skills and perspectives that shape their futures.

Position Summary  

The Senior Coordinator, Housing and Student Services plays a key operational role in the delivery of student housing and student services in Madrid. The role combines hands\-on student support with responsibility for coordinating the day\-to\-day work of the Housing team, organizing workflows and priorities, overseeing housing operations, and supporting the PASS Director with budget management and semester planning. The Senior Coordinator serves as a senior point of reference for housing\-related matters, helps ensure consistent service standards, and coordinates effectively with students, colleagues, landlords, residences, vendors, and other external partners.
The role supports students throughout their programs, from logistics to cultural integration, ensuring a seamless and enriching experience. It also involves administrative tasks such as managing program materials and handling student accommodation issues.  

Responsibilities  

* Serve as a senior point of contact for students, providing guidance, information, resources, and support throughout their program.
* Coordinate the day\-to\-day work of the Housing team, organizing workloads, priorities, schedules, coverage, and operational deadlines.
* Support, guide, and coordinate team members, ensuring clear allocation of responsibilities, effective communication, and consistent service delivery.
* Oversee core student housing operations, including placements, arrivals, departures, room changes, maintenance, inspections, inventories, and accommodation\-related incidents.

* Support the Center Director / PASS Director in managing the Housing budget, monitoring expenditure, reviewing invoices and costs, and maintaining accurate financial records.
* Prepare and maintain semester housing budget forecasts, anticipated occupancy and capacity needs, and projected operational expenses, identifying potential variances and cost pressures in advance.
* Track housing capacity, availability, and utilization to support semester planning and informed accommodation decisions.

* Identify opportunities to improve housing processes, service quality, operational efficiency, vendor performance, and cost effectiveness.

* Coordinate and support student arrivals, orientations, departures, activities, and other PASS operations as required.
* Collaborate closely with Student Services, Academics, Health \& Safety, Custom Programs, Global Operations, and other internal teams to ensure coordinated student support.
* Participate in regular staff and planning meetings and provide operational updates, risks, budget information, and recommendations to the PASS Director.
* Support the onboarding, training, and day\-to\-day development of Housing team members and contribute to maintaining clear procedures and shared working standards.
* Be part of the emergency phone rotation and support the response to urgent student and housing situations in accordance with CEA CAPA procedures.
* Provide operational coverage and decision\-making support in the Housing area when required, particularly during peak periods, arrivals, departures, and staff absences.

  

Person Specification* Resilient and adaptable.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate people, competing priorities, schedules, and deadlines.
* Demonstrated leadership and team coordination skills, with the ability to guide colleagues and promote accountability and collaboration.
* Strong budget management, financial tracking, forecasting, and cost\-control skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong relationship\-management and negotiation skills with internal and external stakeholders.
* Able to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and contribute effectively to a wider team.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and a practical, flexible, and creative approach to operational challenges.
* High attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records and follow through on complex operational matters.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and other digital tools.
  

Qualifications and Experience* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Fluency in English and Spanish.
* Significant experience working with students, particularly international students.
* Demonstrated experience in student housing, accommodation operations, property coordination, or a closely related area.
* Experience coordinating or supervising team members, workflows, or operational projects.
* Experience managing budgets, monitoring expenditure, and preparing forecasts or financial projections.
* Experience working with external vendors, landlords, service providers, and other operational partners.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse identities and backgrounds.
* Experience living or working abroad, with strong knowledge of the local culture, housing environment, business practices, and academic context.
* Knowledge of the U.S. higher education system is desirable.
* Authorization to work in the location of the role.

It is not exhaustive, and the role holder may be required to perform additional tasks and duties as directed by leadership. *

* Demonstrated **people\-management experience** , including leading and developing technical teams across different locations and time zones.
* Experience working in a **global manufacturing, automotive, energy or similar industrial environment** .

* Strong change\-management and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to challenge existing approaches and drive implementation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Fluent English.
* **Based in Madrid, Spain** , with willingness to travel globally to suppliers, manufacturing locations and project sites as required.

  

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

The successful candidate will help us build a stronger, more scalable Global Packaging Engineering organization, moving Packaging further upstream into product development while improving standardization, returnable solutions, quality, sustainability, and total landed cost across NextPower's global operations.  



  

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to shape how Packaging Engineering supports NextPower's continued growth, new products and business verticals.


At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility\-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data\-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.

description:
**Client Director – Private Client \& Wealth structures**

**Solance** is a tech enabled Electronic Money Institution built for businesses with complex corporate structures or operating in sectors that traditional banks generally don’t service: family offices, internationally operating companies, corporate service providers and the clients they service. We are in the final stretch of obtaining authorisation in Ireland, one of the most reputable banking jurisdictions in Europe, and we are only getting started.

**Solance Private Clients** is one of our niches, built specifically for family offices and the parties that work closely with them. We begin with where we are strongest: payments and cards, giving clients a reliable financial partner for their day\-to\-day business. But that’s only the start. From there, we become the single point of contact for everything else a private client and their advisers need, from borrowing solutions and estate planning to investment advisory and wealth management. We do not provide those services ourselves. But we do solve them, drawing on a vast network of (private) banks, wealth managers, tax advisors and trusted partners who can facilitate almost any request a client brings. For every client need we will find the right party to accommodate such need.


**Your role, in plain terms**


This is a pure sales/BD seat. As Client Director for Solance you open doors, build trust, and turn relationships into a real pipeline. You will work the market you already know: the CSPs, the fiduciaries, the (multi) family offices, the wealth managers and the advisers who orbit private wealth. You bring them to Solance, and you own the relationship from there. Think of it as your own shop within Solance. You own the niche, you shape the brand of the Private Client business, and you run it with the freedom of a founder and with a tech\-enabled licensed EMI behind you. Nobody hands you a script or confines you to a certain territory. You determine where the business is and you go and build it.

**Who we are looking for:**

* You are about eight to ten years into your career, you have spent most of it in the world that revolves around private wealth: CSPs, international tax advisory, fiduciary firms, private banking, or any position where your days were spent across the table from private clients and their advisors.
* Ideally you have worked at more than one firm, so you understand how the PC industry really works, and you have a network that runs across that industry.
* People with a background in PC advisory and corporate services know two things you cannot teach overnight: a network, and the lingo.
* You already know a lot of CSPs, the introducers and the advisers.
* You understand what it takes to work with private banks and wealth managers, how and why corporate structures are actually created, what substance really means in practice, and how to talk to clients who expect to be taken seriously. That head\-start is exactly what Solance is built on.
* You add value to your clients.
* You are credible, discreet, and easy to trust in a room full of advisers and/or principals.
* You have energy, you get things done.
* You know where the business is, and you go and get it.

We need a builder, not a maintainer. Someone who runs, who is genuinely hungry, who gets a kick out of chasing a deal and closing it.  
* 

  

  

**Requirements**  

* Eight to ten years’ experience in a Private Client environment (CSP, advisory, banking), ideally across more than one firm.
* A genuine specialisation in, or strong exposure to, private clients and wealth.
* An active network of CSPs, fiduciaries, introducers, advisers and bankers.
* Skilled in structuring, substance and how international private wealth is organised.
* A builder's mentality: hungry, self\-starting, eager to run your own shop.
* International, and preferably multilingual. (English is a must)

**What is in it for you**


You will work very close with the CEO of Solance, not three layers down. You get real ownership of your client book, room to grow a team as your sales justify it, and the freedom to build the Private Client business, and its brand, from the ground up as if it were your own company. This comes with a competitive package, bonuses tied to what you actually bring in, and the chance to become a recognised name in a market you already care about. It is a builder's seat above all.

**Where you come from**

* We already have a good network in Luxembourg, Switzerland and Malta, if that’s your world, we’d love to hear from you too. But we are mostly interested in someone who opens new ground: The Netherlands, Cyprus, Iberia, the Nordics, wherever your relationships run deepest.
* Languages and a genuinely international footprint are a real advantage.
* Where you are based does not matter to us. You will be on the road constantly, in front of clients and partners wherever the business is, so base yourself wherever suits you. What matters is your reach, your network and your appetite for travel. That said, we do want you in our Dublin office on a regular basis, to stay close to the team and to feed what you are hearing from clients back into the business.
* You will be our ears in the market, and the product gets better because of what you bring home.

**Let us talk**


If this reads like you, get in touch. And if it reads like someone you rate, send them our way, or send us the introduction.

title: Head of SEO & AI Search
description:
Groupon connects 42 million customers with local experiences \- restaurants, events, wellness and travel \- and the million\-plus merchants who deliver them. Our mission is to get people offline and into the real world at prices that make it possible. We're an AI\-native company in the middle of a platform transformation, moving from a deals marketplace to an experience discovery platform that works for customers and merchants at the same time.

**Head of SEO \& AI Search**
----------------------------



AI Overviews now appear on the large majority of the local queries we track in North America. ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini recommend places by name, and agents are starting to search, compare and transact without ever loading a page. Groupon's Local estate runs to a six\-figure number of live indexable pages in North America after pruning, sitting inside an addressable space of roughly 1,000 cities and 50\+ categories, and only a minority of them earn. The wider domain is bigger than Local alone, and the role is global, the majority of organic revenue is North America, the rest is the UK, Germany, France, Spain, Italy and Australia. Organic revenue is growing year on year and the demand, presence and capture instrumentation already runs, so this is neither a rescue case nor a discovery quarter. The prune is largely behind us. What is missing is the next decision, city by city and category by category: which local pages Groupon funds, which it rebuilds, which it consolidates and which it stops publishing. Structure, craft content and technical hygiene serve that decision. You own it as a hands\-on operator and a sharp analyst, mostly operator, and the next twelve months decide whether these pages become the structure users, Google and agents reach for.


### **Who you'll work with**



You'll report to Josef Buryan, Chief Marketing Officer, who owns Marketing end to end. You lead an SEO team of four to five (AI content, technical SEO, SEO data science, core SEO) plus a shared engineering squad on the web platform working from your backlog. You partner weekly with Product, Engineering, Data, Paid Search and Brand, and you hold Supply to inventory density per city and category with the evidence to back it. You report monthly to the CEO and CFO in the "battlefield view " \- a battlefield being one city\-and\-category market on the domain, sized by its demand, our presence, the comparable competitor's presence, a realistic target and the conversion that decides whether investment pays. This seat is visible at the top of the company from the first month, and the CEO will challenge a number on your page. Expect a shared eng squad and no incremental headcount, weekly 5/15s in text not decks, and cross\-functional teams that need structure and pushing to move. Diagnosis without shipped work does not survive here.


### **What you'll be doing**


* Deciding the Local estate: which cities get coverage, which categories get a dedicated page, which of the four Local page types (city root, city things\-to\-do, category\-in\-city, deal) owns each intent, what supply threshold makes a page viable, and what gets rebuilt, consolidated or removed \- with the volume affected, the expected click loss, the expected upside and the revenue effect stated up front
* Designing the GEO x Category architecture and internal linking structure that carries that decision, so the city to category to deal path is explicit, reachable within three to four clicks, with no orphaned pages and no diluted authority \- first version of the structure and the build order inside two weeks, then shipped against it
* Owning the SEO engineering backlog as business owner so the funded pages actually get rebuilt: writing acceptance criteria, holding backlog reviews, blocking releases that break the standards you set \- a page\-weight budget on transferred bytes before interaction, an uncompressed\-HTML gate at deploy under the 2 MB Googlebot limit, one media player click\-to\-play, response time \- and escalating when platform ships without SEO sign\-off
* Governing third\-party scripts on every page type (inventory, owner, purpose, keep or kill) and owning crawler and rendering policy across all markets, including AI crawler policy as a conscious decision rather than a default
* Running the content factory that rebuilds them, as a GenAI production system \- structured inputs, research, reusable skills, human checkpoints, QA \- behind a page template, an editorial line and a quality gate; stopping publish until the craft bar exists and fixing or removing what does not meet it
* Building content so it travels: pages and assets that Display, SEM, Influencers and Social can reuse. One production cost, four channels
* Driving GEO and AI search at city and category level so the funded pages are the ones that get cited: AI Overviews presence, machine\-discovery endpoints, structured deal data, connectors to Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini, and Reddit and LinkedIn where they move citations \- measured geolocated rather than nationally
* Reading the battlefield instrumentation that already exists, knowing where it is strong and where it is thin, and deciding from it; rebuilding it is not the first project
* Leading the team and the shared eng partnership day to day: hire and exit, hold reports to weekly output, keep the backlog full and specified, and produce the monthly battlefield MBR the CEO and CFO can act on
* Defaulting to AI agents for audits, content production, monitoring and reporting, and showing the ROI of what you built versus what you consume

### **What success looks like**



Day 7: You have oriented on the battlefield view, the current index and craft gaps, and the eng backlog. You have set direction from the data at hand and written the first tickets, not a research plan for month three.



Day 14: GEO x Category and internal linking one\-pager delivered: what exists, the main hubs, what is missing, the build order. Plus the first Local allocation call \- the cities and categories funded first, and the first to stop. First acceptance criteria for platform hygiene (page weight, HTML size, scripts) drafted for engineering.



Day 21: Content template, editorial line and production skill live; first pages published to the craft bar or bad pages stopped. You are running the weekly 5/15 to standard and holding eng review without hand\-holding on ticket quality.



Day 60: Team assessment complete; open SEO role hired or in final stage; every report's weekly update to standard. First battlefield pages live for at least one city and one category against a target, with a scale plan. You own the monthly MBR shape in the battlefield view without rewriting it from scratch each time.


### **What this role demands**



You can demonstrably:


* State an index and investment policy for a six\-figure Local estate \- what stays, what goes, what gets rebuilt \- and defend it with numbers, assumptions and the first ticket you would write
* Ship from incomplete data on a messy programmatic or marketplace site: name brief\-to\-live work with dates and numbers moved, not a six\-month framework before the first ticket
* Brief engineers without a translator: write acceptance criteria, hold backlog reviews, and escalate when page weight, HTML size against the 2 MB Googlebot limit, scripts or crawler policy break the standard
* Own SEO on a large multi\-market website, at the order of 500k\+ programmatic pages \- that is the scale you have operated at, and our domain is larger than the Local estate alone \- including marketplace or local\-commerce dynamics: supply density per city and category, local pack behaviour, cannibalisation between near\-identical pages, prune and consolidate
* Run GEO and AI search hands\-on at city and category level with a measurement method, not in general terms and not from a conference stage
* Measure Local honestly: geolocated SERP measurement rather than national rank tracking, awareness that search console aggregation hides city\-level divergence and that page\-type aggregation masks cannibalisation
* Design and evaluate a GenAI content production system: structured inputs, research, reusable skills, human checkpoints, QA
* Operate AI\-native day to day: walk through your tools, agents and skills, what you personally run every week, and what it replaced
* Hire, develop and exit SEO talent, and hold a shared engineering partnership as the business owner of the backlog
* Absorb a crawl audit or a battlefield dataset, find the three things that matter and state a decision in minutes, explaining why rather than what
* Write a one\-page business view (size, capture, competitor, target, three decisions) in English text on the day asked, hold the structure when one number is challenged, and keep pushing cross\-functional teams when they stall

### **How we operate**



We hire for how people work, not just what they can do. The Operating Principles most relevant to this role:


* **Extreme Ownership:** You own the Local index decision, page weight, scripts, crawler policy and content quality as the business owner even when engineering, product or supply made the change. "They shipped without telling us" is an escalation failure, not a status update.
* **Speed Over Comfort:** A defensible v1 in days, then iteration. You do not hold the team for certainty, and "meaningful results in six months" is the wrong rhythm for this seat.
* **Impact Obsessed:** You prioritise by revenue at stake times winnability per battlefield, report in revenue and clicks not rankings, and kill low\-value work.

* Above\-Brand Strategy Co\-Leadership: Co\-develop and maintain the Above\-Brand Strategy and long\-term healthcare system vision for Spain with oncology leadership; deliver initiatives that strengthen our positioning; ensure Transforming Care supports strategic priorities and pathway transformation; build advocacy platforms with scientific engagement and strategic partners; monitor healthcare policy, innovation, and system transformation trends to inform planning; establish KPIs to track impact across system outcomes and leadership priorities.

* Proven crossfunctional, multistakeholder leadership at national/regional levels
* Strong change management, stakeholder engagement, risk mitigation, policy engagement, and governance design
* Ability to set multiyear strategy and operating models; make resourcing tradeoffs and establish governance and pathway standards
* Negotiate and manage frameworks with authorities, societies, provider networks, and labs; represent confidently in national forums
* Datadriven approach
* Languages: Spanish, English Fluent

5\. Desirable Skills/Experience:
* Healthcare and/or Oncology experience across e.g. clinical practice, scientific knowledge, precision diagnostics, and pathway optimization
* Market Access experience/knowledge and exposure to public/government affairs
* Experience with digital health, data interoperability, and AI enabled operating models in care pathway transformation

But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

You'll run a network the size of a department with a team of two. AI does what a team of ten used to: it builds the outreach lists, screens agencies and creators, scores every partner's performance and drafts the reporting. Data, Finance and Legal do their parts. You decide what the machine does and make the calls it can't. This is a role for someone who already works this way.

  



Please note that this is a **Full\-time Contractor (12 months)** role.


**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------


* **Find and sign partners.** Agencies and creators in every market that matters, working toward 50 agencies and 500,000 creators. You know where the good ones are and how to reach them.
* **Get the agreements done.** Terms, exclusivity, data access, rights and payment: in writing, on Picsart's terms, with Finance and Legal behind you.
* **Get campaigns published.** Live on time, in every market, at the volume agreed. Every post carries its link, its code and its creator, so nothing goes out untracked.
* **Track what each partner drives.** Signups, first generations, credits used, paying users and big spenders, in dashboards the Data team builds to your spec.
* **Decide who continues.** Recommend which partnerships to grow, hold or end based on what they convert, not what they view. Scale what repeats; cut what was lucky.
* **Grow revenue and usage.** 100x the revenue and AI credit use coming from the influencer and affiliate programs. Pay for results, never for views, and put the money behind what converts.

* **Sell the network to partners.** AI model partners and brands already pay to run campaigns with our creators. Bring in more of that money so it covers a growing share of what the network costs.

* **Partnerships you've run at scale.** Creator, affiliate, UGC or influencer.

* Review application inventories and import, adapt or repackage country\-specific applications using agreed packaging standards and repositories, validating content distribution and hardware compatibility.

description:

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About the role**


Join us as our Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL) for Solid Tumors. In this role, you will provide field\-based medical support in your country to help advance Takeda’s goals and strengthen the company’s medical and scientific credibility.


You will serve as a field\-based source of scientific and clinical expertise for external stakeholders and internal colleagues, including Sales and Market Access. You will work autonomously in the field while contributing to central Medical Affairs priorities and collaborating across a matrix organization.

*Please note this is a 1 year contract for a temporary leave coverage with earliest start date November 2026\.*

 **How you will contribute**


Reporting to the MSL Manager, you will build and maintain trusted, long\-term peer\-to\-peer relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs), opinion leaders, and other relevant external stakeholders.

* **Provide accurate, balanced scientific exchange:** Continuously review and critically assess scientific literature, preparing summaries when appropriate. Use your disease\-area and product knowledge to respond to unsolicited HCP enquiries with accurate, non\-promotional medical and technical information about licensed and unlicensed indications, in line with applicable requirements. Deliver clinical presentations and medical information as needed.
* **Build stakeholder partnerships:** Proactively identify and develop long\-term peer\-to\-peer relationships with opinion leaders and other relevant stakeholders. Understand and segment stakeholder needs, then implement targeted approaches to communicate medical data effectively.
* **Support internal colleagues:** Act as a field\-based scientific and clinical reference for Sales, Market Access, and other internal stakeholders through training and ad hoc support, aligned with Takeda project teams.
* **Contribute to clinical studies:** Support ongoing and future Company\-Sponsored Studies when requested by Global Development Operations. Activities may include locally reviewing proposed CRO site lists, attending Global or Regional Investigator Meetings, conducting motivational site visits, and sharing site and investigator feedback with Clinical Operations. Keep relevant local functions informed of progress in site involvement in a timely manner.
* **Enable research and evidence generation:** Facilitate unsolicited HCP proposals for investigator\-initiated sponsored research by engaging with Global External Research on IISR proposals and Medical Affairs Company Studies (MACS). Support national disease registries and real\-world evidence (RWE) projects in relevant disease areas.
* **Contribute to medical strategy and activities:** Capture and share field insights compliantly with relevant business functions to inform medical and scientific strategy and business development. Participate in developing and implementing medical activities, such as advisory boards, medical education, and peer\-to\-peer training. Understand key leverage points across the patient journey.
* **Maintain quality and compliance:** Develop and implement an annual quality plan within your area of responsibility. Follow applicable corporate, compliance, ethical, and legal standards; uphold Patient\-Trust\-Reputation\-Business (PTRB) principles; and demonstrate Takeda\-ism values as a role model who promotes integrity and a speak\-up culture. Report any adverse reaction to Pharmacovigilance as soon as you become aware of it, following internal procedures.

 **What you bring to Takeda**

* University degree in science or pharmacy. A PhD or master’s degree in biological or medical science, or a medical qualification, is desirable.
* Experience in relevant therapeutic areas and in matrix environments; pharmaceutical\-industry experience is desirable.
* MSL or equivalent Medical Affairs experience, experience with clinical trials, and a solid understanding of clinical\-trial data and study design are desirable.
* Experience engaging with scientific and clinical experts at all levels, both individually and in groups, is desirable.
* Experience delivering clinical\-data and disease\-area training to medical and non\-medical colleagues is desirable.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* In\-depth knowledge of applicable GxP regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, and national codes of practice.
* Fluency in written and spoken English.
* Ability to communicate complex clinical data clearly and concisely, including its statistical and clinical relevance, and to engage effectively with external stakeholders.
* Ability to work autonomously in the field while contributing to central Medical Affairs; manage project milestones and deliver work on time; assimilate information quickly; and influence senior stakeholders.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, a proactive approach to personal and team performance, and the highest ethical standards.
* Understanding of the audit process, including its design, conduct, and reporting. Familiarity with clinical\-trial processes and research infrastructure is desirable.
* Strong interest in developing technical, clinical, medical, and scientific knowledge.
* Commitment to developing proficiency with role\-relevant digital tools and platforms—including AI, CRM systems, portals, and Power BI—to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Ability to use facts, metrics, and data to inform decisions and strategic planning, with an understanding of relevant data sources, management, and analysis.
* Adaptability to change, evolving business models, shifting priorities, and digital ways of working; a results\-oriented mindset; and the ability to plan and deliver in ambiguous situations.
* Collaborative approach to problem\-solving and innovation, with the ability to improve efficiency and scalability by applying successful approaches across the company.
* Ownership of personal development and lifelong learning, including staying current with market trends, digital technologies, and pharmaceutical\-industry best practices.
* Manual dexterity to operate office equipment, including computers and phones.
* Ability to travel by car or plane for meetings, audits, and training; a valid, clean driver’s license is required.

	+
