At JLL, we're reimagining how the world's most complex real estate environments are secured, operated, and experienced. As our Senior Identity Security Architect, you'll be shaping the strategy that defines how 100,000\+ employees, clients, and partners authenticate, access, and interact with JLL's global technology ecosystem. This is a high\-impact architecture role. You will be responsible for setting direction, establishing standards, and partnering with engineering and product teams to ensure that identity security is designed correctly from the ground up. From zero trust frameworks to privileged access governance to customer identity in JLL’s digital products, your architectural decisions will directly shape JLL’s security posture at enterprise scale.
  
If you’re a strategic thinker with deep identity expertise who thrives in a large, dynamic environment and wants their work to have real, visible impact, we want to hear from you.
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  
Identity Strategy \& Architecture
  
Define and own JLL's enterprise identity security architecture spanning IdP services (Okta or Entra preferred), Active Directory, M365, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), and third\-party SaaS.
  
Ensuring a coherent, scalable, and secure design across the global technology estate.
  
Establish and maintain identity security policy and standards across users, non\-person accounts, and on\-premises, cloud, and SaaS platforms, in partnership with key identity stakeholders.
  
Partner with Identity Security, Engineering, and operations teams to develop to translate standards and patterns into actionable engineering and operational direction.
  
Lead JLL's zero trust strategy for user and third\-party access in close partnership with the network security organization, driving architectural decisions that eliminate implicit trust across the environment.
  
Shape the architectural vision for Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) within JLL's externally\-facing digital products, ensuring secure and seamless experiences for clients and partners.
  
Extend identity security architecture beyond the human user scope and into NHI landscapes for machine identity and service accounts including creation of AI, API, and other modern auth patterns and standards.
  
Identity Governance \& Administration
  
Architecture coverage for JLL's identity governance and administration strategy across different identity platforms, assisting in defining entitlement models, access certification and review cadence, and joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle standards and management.
  
Assist in defining segregation\-of\-duties and least\-privilege policy for toxic\-combination detection, and partner with application and platform owners to translate that policy into enforceable entitlement structures and operating models.
  
Privileged Access Governance
  
Architect JLL's Privileged Access Management strategy, defining controls for privileged accounts that minimize abuse potential and enable robust detection of insider and external threats.
  
Provide strategic direction to engineering teams operating JLL's PAM tooling (CyberArk preferred), ensuring the platform evolves to meet emerging threat and business requirements.
  
Collaborate with cyber threat management and insider threat teams to embed identity\-aware detection and response capabilities across the enterprise.
  
Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Influence
  
Partner with Active Directory, authentication, and cloud engineering teams to translate security architecture into enforceable controls and compliant implementations.
  
Serve as the identity security subject matter expert on major programs, technology transformations, and acquisitions. Bring architectural clarity to complex, multi\-stakeholder initiatives.
  
Lead security architecture reviews and design governance processes; mentor junior architects and security professionals across the team.
  
Communicate advanced security architecture strategies and design rationale clearly to diverse audiences from engineering teams to senior business stakeholders.
  
Mentorship \& Team Leadership
  
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior security engineers, developers, and architects on application security principles, secure coding practices, and architectural standards.
  
Lead cross\-functional security initiatives, driving collaborative approaches to security integration across development and architecture teams.
  
Support secure development training and awareness programs to build security competency across engineering organizations.
  
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  
Technical Knowledge
  
Hands\-on architectural experience with enterprise IdP platforms (Okta strongly preferred) and Privileged Access Management solutions (CyberArk strongly preferred).
  
Experience securing identity across M365, AWS/Azure, SaaS applications, and on\-premises infrastructure.
  
Experience implementing Active Directory governance models that enforce security policy and compliance requirements, including hybrid AD/Entra ID sync architecture, delegation and privilege\-escalation attack paths (e.g., resource\-based constrained delegation, Kerberos delegation), and tiered administrative models.
  
Track record of partnering with threat management, insider threat, and incident response teams to design identity\-aware detection capabilities.
  
Experience architecting identity for non\-person and machine\-to\-machine access such as service accounts, workload identity, and OAuth delegation patterns (client credentials, on\-behalf\-of/token exchange) for service integrations and automation.
  
Skills \& Abilities
  
Comprehensive knowledge of zero trust architecture principles and enterprise identity design patterns, including federation, SSO, OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, and PAM.
  
Strong command of security frameworks including NIST CSF, NIST 800\-63, ISO 27001, and MITRE ATT\&CK and CIS Controls v8, along with emerging OWASP guidance for AI/LLM and agentic systems (GenAI Security, LLM Top 10, AI Exchange) — and the ability to apply them practically, not just reference them.
  
Proven ability to develop sophisticated security architectures that address complex business requirements, regulatory obligations, and enterprise risk across multiple technology domains.
  
Exceptional communication and influencing skills — able to build alignment across engineering, product, and business stakeholders on complex architectural decisions.
  
Comfortable operating in ambiguity; able to define structure, set priorities, and drive progress in a fast\-moving, high\-change global environment.
  
Education \& Experience
  
10\+ years of technical cybersecurity experience, with at least 7 years focused on identity security architecture in large, complex enterprise environments.
  
Demonstrated success designing and maturing enterprise identity security programs — not just operating tools, but shaping strategy and standards at scale.

description:
**Technical Advisor, Identity Maturity Acceleration**

  

  

**About SailPoint:**

SailPoint is the leader in identity security for cloud enterprises. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job—no more, no less. Built on a foundation of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, our Identity Security Cloud Platform delivers the right level of access to the right identities and resources at the right time—matching the scale, velocity, and changing needs of today’s cloud\-oriented, modern enterprise.  



  

**About the role:**

As a Technical Advisor, you will serve as SailPoint's principal\-level identity security strategist for the enterprise. Your mission is to own the multi\-year platform adoption roadmap, architecting unified governance across human, machine, and AI agent identities. You will ensure that every deployment of SailPoint's Identity Security Cloud, Agentic Fabric, and adjacent capabilities translates into measurable business value—quantified as breach risk reduction, compliance efficiency, and operational cost avoidance.


You are a trusted technical strategist and a peer to customer CISOs, CIOs, and VP\-level engineering leaders. You possess an innate ability to translate complex technical realities into strategic business risk language that drives executive decision\-making. As a thought leader in the identity security space, you are driven by professional growth and learning agility. You demonstrate a continuous commitment to expanding your domain mastery, exploring emerging technologies, and engaging with industry developments across identity governance, AI agent security, and enterprise architecture. You are an authoritative voice whose insights shape customer decisions, product strategies, and industry standards.


In this principal\-level role, you will bridge the gap between technical architecture and business value. You will guide strategic enterprise accounts through complex identity governance transformations, addressing modern challenges that span human identities, machine identities, and emerging AI agents. You will partner closely with Customer Success Managers to align technical strategies with commercial outcomes, providing the architectural evidence and value quantification necessary to support renewals and expansions. Furthermore, you will identify cross\-account patterns and synthesize these into actionable frameworks that influence SailPoint's product roadmap and engineering efforts.  



**Responsibilities:**

* Platform Adoption Roadmap Ownership: Design and maintain multi\-year platform adoption roadmaps for strategic accounts, sequencing deployments across Identity Security Cloud, Agentic Fabric, Machine Identity Security, Data Access Security, and Harbor Pilot based on customer maturity and business priorities.
* Unified Identity Governance Architecture: Architect comprehensive identity governance models spanning human, machine, and AI agent identities, ensuring cohesive policy frameworks, consistent lifecycle management, and integrated access controls.
* Executive Technical Advisory: Act as the trusted technical advisor for C\-suite and VP\-level engineering leaders, engaging on identity security strategy, regulatory architecture, and technology investment prioritization.
* Value Realization Quantification: Define, implement, and maintain value measurement frameworks. Quantify identity security outcomes (breach risk reduction, compliance gains, cost avoidance) and present these in quarterly executive reviews.
* Agentic Identity Governance Advisory: Guide customers through the design and deployment of AI agent identity governance using SailPoint Agentic Fabric, including agent discovery, risk\-tier classification, and least\-privilege enforcement.
* Regulatory Compliance Translation: Translate regulatory requirements (DORA, NIS2, SEC cyber disclosure, SOX, HIPAA) into actionable identity governance architectures, ensuring compliance through platform capabilities.
* Cross\-Account Pattern Synthesis: Identify recurring governance challenges and architectural anti\-patterns across enterprise customers, distilling them into reusable frameworks and strategic intelligence for Product Management and Engineering.
* CSM Strategic Partnership: Partner with Customer Value Partners to align technical strategy with commercial outcomes, providing data that supports renewal justification and expansion business cases.
* Thought Leadership \& Knowledge Contribution: Author technical strategy content, present at customer advisory boards, contribute to SailPoint's body of knowledge, and mentor less senior advisors.

**Roadmap for success**

**30 days:**

Dive deep into SailPoint’s core identity security portfolio—including Identity Security Cloud (ISC), and emerging solutions like NERM and DAS—and the Atlas extensibility platform. You will shadow active customer engagements, learn organizational consulting best practices, and build strong foundational knowledge of our products, architectures, and internal cross\-functional team structures.  



**60 days:**

Collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Technical Leads to support initial customer engagements, joint Executive Business Reviews, and Business Value Realization touchpoints. You will begin performing initial maturity assessments, aligning customer business drivers with the SailPoint identity strategy, and designing integration roadmaps across technology alliances such as ServiceNow, SAP, AWS, ad Workday etc, where you could also work along with a technical advisor for initial engagements.  



**90 days:**  

Transition into serving as a trusted strategic advisor, leading vertical\-specific assessments and co\-creating forward\-looking success plans with key customer stakeholders. You will actively advocate for customer needs directly to Product and Engineering teams, represent common technical gaps to the Tech Council, mentor other architects, and drive customers toward standard out\-of\-the\-box features over complex custom code.  



**Requirements:**

Note: As specific educational requirements were not listed in the capability model, the following reflects standard industry expectations for a principal\-level advisory role in this domain.


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Extensive experience in identity and access management (IAM), identity governance and administration (IGA), and enterprise security architecture.
* Industry\-recognized cybersecurity and architecture certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, TOGAF, CISA) are highly preferred.
* Relevant SailPoint platform certifications are strongly desired.

  

Fluent in French and or German

We are a global dynamic, multicultural and multilingual team that thrives in a fast\-paced, ever\-evolving environment.


From technical experts to senior management, we collaborate closely to tackle any situation head\-on with a positive mindset. We are goal\-driven and solution\-focused, turning every challenge into an opportunity while supporting and learning from one another.


Our team is passionate, curious, and always ready to dive deep, bringing people together to solve anything unknown and deliver results with professionalism and care. title: Head of Operations — Switching, Billing & Cash Collection / energy retail experience
description:
Company Description
  
MET Retail is a new chapter for the group: bringing energy directly to households. We're building a technology\-driven retail platform for power and gas, with a digital, customer\-first model. One model, built to scale across Europe.


We're a small international team, and there's a lot to build. Join us on this exciting journey and you'll help shape how this company works, with real ownership from day one.


  
Job Description
  
We are building a digital retail platform for residential customers. The Head of Operations brings practical operational knowledge into digital delivery: understanding market, regulatory, commercial and process needs, designing the way we work, and making sure the operational engine behind the customer journey is accurate, compliant, scalable and AI\-enabled by design rather than by retrofit.


The role covers the transactional backbone of the end\-to\-end customer journey (from contracting to switching, first bill, invoicing and collection) across our billing, CRM and operational tooling. Spain at launch, followed by other markets such as France, Germany and Italy. The person in this role will own switching, billing and invoicing, and cash collection end to end, from process and procedure design through business ownership of the supporting tooling, team build\-up and day\-to\-day performance.


This is a build role, and an AI\-first one. The processes, the controls, the procedures and the team do not exist yet; you will create them. We expect the operating model to be designed around automation and AI from the first process map, with the manual path treated as the exception rather than the starting point.


**Key responsibilities**

* Act as the business reference point for switching, billing, invoicing and cash collection across the Spanish operation and, subsequently, the markets that follow.
* Design and own the end\-to\-end switching process (cambio de comercializadora), including ATR request management, SIPS data validation, contract activation and exception handling
* Define the operational interface with the distribution system operators (e\-distribución, i\-DE, UFD, e\-redes, Viesgo and regional DSOs)
* Manage the operational side of customer exits and win\-back, including debt\-related switching constraints
* Design the billing cycle end to end: meter data acquisition and validation, estimation logic, tariff application across residential structures (2\.0TD for electricity, RL and TUR bands for gas), rebilling and corrections. Cash Collection \& Credit Risk
* Design and run the collections’ function: SEPA Core direct debit cycles (Cuaderno 19 / 19\-14\), bank reconciliation (Cuaderno 43\), returns and unpaid handling, and alternative payment methods
* Write the operating model: process maps, standard operating procedures, RACI, control framework and an escalation model that holds up under regulatory and financial audit
* Hire, structure and lead the operations team
* Identify, prioritise and specify AI use cases across the meter\-to\-cash chain
* Set the target automation ratio per process and raise it every quarter
* Collaborate across Offering, Growth, Customer Service and Finance on the business side, and Product, Architecture, Engineering and Data on the delivery side.

  
Qualifications
  
* University degree
* At least 5 years of **experience in energy retail operations** , with direct, hands\-on ownership of switching, billing or cash collection in the Spanish market
* Solid command of the Spanish regulatory framework for residential electricity and/or gas retail: ATR processes, tariff structure, regulated charges, supply\-interruption rules and consumer protection obligations
* Proven experience setting up processes, procedures and teams from scratch
* Strong practical understanding of the meter\-to\-cash chain and of the operational, commercial and regulatory constraints that shape it in a B2C environment
* Demonstrable, practical understanding of AI and automation applied to operational problems
* Comfortable with SQL, data models, APIs and file\-based integrations
* Experience acting as business owner for a core operational platform — defining requirements, supporting vendor evaluation, driving UAT and business validation alongside an IT organisation
* Fluent Spanish and English, written and spoken. Italian, French or German language skills considered as a plus
* Experience in one or more other European retail energy markets — France, Germany or Italy in particular is highly appreciated
* Familiarity with a modern billing or CIS platform (SAP IS\-U or S/4HANA Utilities, Salesforce Energy \& Utilities Cloud, Gentrack, Hansen, Powercloud, Kraken or equivalent) is highly appreciated
* Experience in a start\-up or scale\-up environment, comfortable operating without an established playbook, is a plus
* Experience with collaboration and documentation tools such as Jira, Confluence, Miro, Visio, Signavio or BPMN tools is an advantage

**Pricing Actuary**

Provision of actuarial pricing and performance management support to European business under MRS\-GM, a stand\-alone division of Munich Re.


In addition to the day\-to\-day tasks, you will contribute to activities linked to the development and implementation of the strategy of different lines of business in the primary insurance.


This role will work closely with the underwriting team supporting the Chief of Underwriting, the Country Heads and the London and Munich Actuarial teams.

**Responsibilities**

* Pricing Strategy Development

* Support the development and enhancement of technical and commercial pricing capabilities for different Lines of Business in Europe.
* Assist underwriting teams with product design ensuring any changes are correctly priced.

* Data Analysis \& Modelling:

* Support underwriters with any ad\-hoc analysis or reporting requests.
* Utilise advanced actuarial techniques and predictive analytics to assess risk and model pricing scenarios.
* Case pricing of large or unusual accounts, including frequency severity simulations and/or experience based analysis.
* Conduct technical analyses, investigations (e.g. inflation) and independent deep dive reviews.
* Conduct actuarial analysis to support the onboarding of additional territories or new MGAs for different classes of business.
* Stakeholder Management

* Present results to a variety of stakeholders to provide insight and recommendations on pricing and performance related results.

* Ensure all pricing practices comply with relevant regulatory and industry standards.
* Stay informed on changes to regulatory frameworks and assess their impact on pricing strategies.

* Performance Monitoring

* Track price adequacy and performance and lead profitability exercises using modelling and reserving techniques, as required.
* Create Pricing Management Information for use by Underwriters and senior management, reporting on all pricing KPIs as defined by MRS\-GM Actuarial Pricing team.

* At least 2 years of experience in a pricing\-focused actuarial role ideally within commercial insurance.
* Ability to build and sustain strong working relationships with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.
* Proven experience with modelling and data.
* Good understanding of standard reserving methods.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with a proven ability to work collaboratively with underwriters.
* Good knowledge of commercial insurance products and the European market, insurance processes and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including report writing, presentations and ability to present complex analyses to senior management.

description:
**MOLINS**
----------


Con una experiencia con más de 90 años en el mundo de la industria cementera, Molins es una de las compañías más importantes del sector en nuestro país. Nacida como una empresa familiar, a lo largo de los años, ha desarrollado productos de reconocido prestigio en la industria de materiales de la construcción, manteniendo intactos sus valores tradicionales de integridad, mejora continua, eficiencia, pasión, sostenibilidad y protección ambiental.

  

Molins desarrolla su actividad en España, Argentina, Uruguay, México, Bolivia, Colombia, Túnez y Bangladesh. Además del cemento, participa en los negocios del cemento, el hormigón, los áridos, los prefabricados de hormigón, los morteros especiales, los cementos cola y los ecomateriales.


**Descripción de la oferta**
----------------------------


**We are Top Employer in Spain**


At our company, people come first. We have been certified by the **Top Employers Institute** as one of the best companies to work for in Spain, thanks to our strong commitment to professional development, employee well\-being, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and motivating work environment.

  

**MOLINS \| Imagine. Design. Build.**


Join a solid and financially sound company with a long history of continuous evolution, at a key moment of transformation and growth. Become part of a team where you will feel truly at home. People who work with passion and enthusiasm, two of the fundamental materials that make up the Molins team.


**Imagine, design and build** your own career path, continuously learning and growing professionally in a company whose purpose is to find sustainable and innovative solutions for the construction industry. A company that offers you the opportunity to lead projects, where your expertise and talent can make a positive impact on the business. A company focused on building a better future for all of us who will live in it.


***And speaking of the future, shall we talk about yours?***

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**


At **Molins**, we are committed to embracing technological transformation and leveraging advanced solutions to drive innovation and stay ahead of the market. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of our organization through innovative digital and technology strategies and solutions, while learning and developing in a dynamic, innovative, and global environment, within one of the company’s key strategic pillars.


We are seeking to recruit a **Category Manager for local categories** based in Spain. The role reports to the Head of Procurement Spain, while operating within a global category structure, working closely with the corresponding **Global Category Managers** to ensure alignment on strategy, tools and standards. The role is focused primarily on leading local category strategy development and execution across Molins Spain's plants and business units. You will be joining a dynamic team with high momentum within the organisation. A key part of the role is the ability to roll up your sleeves and lead from the front in the definition, implementation and optimisation of category strategies at local level.

  

**WHAT WILL YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES BE?**


Among other responsibilities, the following stand out:


* Understanding local business needs; Cooperating in setting up specification and tender documents; Supply market analysis; Identifying new potential suppliers and shortlisting for portfolio; Setting strategy implementation action plan; Leading RFI/RFP/RFQ processes; Planning, preparing and executing negotiations; Establishing contracts and updating the ERP system; Participating in continuous supplier performance evaluation; Actively contributing to the continuous improvement of procurement processes and systems.
* Creating and developing a strategic plan for the development of assigned local categories. Develops, implements and maintains local purchasing and supply management strategies to ensure supply management meets Molins Spain's business requirements, in line with global category guidelines. Ultimately accountable for material and service costs, delivery, sustainability, innovation and quality, and continuous assurance of supply.
* Leads the development and implementation of supply base strategies for assigned local categories, as an integral part of the local business strategy, balancing commercial aspects (volume \& price) and technical capabilities to improve cost effectiveness, delivery and quality.
* Responsible for managing the negotiation process for assigned local categories (suppliers), with a focus on total cost of ownership, supporting business profitability targets and the budgeting process.
* Leads local procurement initiatives, supporting plant and business unit level initiatives for cost optimisation, supplier management, and quality and supply performance improvement, in coordination with the global category framework.
* Develops and manages key local supplier relationships to ensure cost, flexibility, quality and delivery objectives are established and achieved for the long term.
* Responsible for the local category business review process with selected suppliers, to develop and nurture key supplier relationships and maintain stable and competitive supply.
* Optimises the local supply base through supplier consolidation. Develops an exit strategy for unsuccessful suppliers and/or products.
* Engages with multiple levels within the organisation, external partners and suppliers to troubleshoot problems, ensure risk mitigation and on\-time project implementation.
* Brings new thinking, innovation and best practice to drive value and efficiency across the local sourcing and procurement cycle.
  

**WHAT DO WE OFFER?**


* An excellent opportunity for professional growth within a company that is a benchmark in the construction industry and is guided by strong ethical values.
* A positive work environment built on collaboration, teamwork, and mutual support.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities provided by the company.
* Competitive compensation aligned with your experience, knowledge, and the value you bring.
* A flexible benefits package through Cobee, free telemedicine services with Savia, access to Wellhub, a pension plan, a hybrid working model, subsidized cafeteria services, flexible working hours, and discounts on products and services.
  
**Requisitos**
--------------


We are looking for a professional who meets the following requirements:


* Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Business, Business Administration/Management, Engineering or Supply Chain Management.
* Proven working experience (\>3 years) in Purchasing or Procurement. Knowledge of specific purchasing processes such as strategic planning, sourcing, supplier management, operating process management, measuring purchasing performance, and preparation/execution of effective negotiation strategies (products / raw materials / services). ERP system knowledge (e.g. SAP) is preferential.
* Experience in projects to improve direct/indirect procurement, strategic sourcing, category management and procure\-to\-pay. Understanding of the full, end\-to\-end Procurement lifecycle.
* Strong management skills, highly organised, with a demonstrated ability to drive change management and transformation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to influence and drive change across operational areas and business units.
* Resilient and enthusiastic, responding constructively to new ideas and inputs.
* Sound commercial awareness and business analytical skills, preferably including the use of business intelligence/analytics tools.
* Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g. SAP) relating to procurement, contract management and vendor management would be advantageous.
* Experience working within an international/matrixed procurement structure — team player, comfortable operating with cross\-cultural teams and within a global category framework.
* Fluency in Spanish and English required.

title: Director, Strategic Alliances EMEA
description:
**About The Role**



The Director, Strategic Alliances, EMEA will be responsible for defining and executing Diligent's partnerships strategy across the EMEA region as a senior individual contributor. This role will focus on identifying, structuring, and closing high\-impact strategic partner\-led deals that accelerate customer acquisition, expand Diligent's enterprise footprint, and drive revenue growth through partner resell and co\-sell motions — with a particular focus on advisory and consulting firms (Big 4 and Tier 2\) and large resellers/channel partners.



This senior leader will develop deep insight into regional market dynamics and build the foundational partner ecosystem across advisory/consulting firms, resellers, and channel partners at the pace needed to match Diligent's rapid growth. This is fundamentally a builder's role — the person in this seat will need to build and own the region and its relationships largely from the ground up. This role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams.



Success will be measured by partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced revenue, new logo acquisition, expansion of product usage through partners, and the establishment of scalable partnership models that can be operationalized as the business grows.

  


**Responsibilities**


**Partnership Strategy \& Execution**


* Execute the EMEA partner strategy in alignment with Diligent's global objectives and regional go\-to\-market plans.
* Identify, prioritize, and secure strategic partnerships across advisory/consulting firms (Big 4 and Tier 2\)
* Develop partner value propositions, commercial frameworks, and engagement models tailored to EMEA market needs.
* Establish repeatable partnership structures, playbooks, and success metrics that can scale over time as the region and partner base grow.

  


**Channel \& Revenue Impact**


* Drive partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline and revenue through direct execution of partner\-led deals.
* Work closely with regional and global Sales teams to integrate partners into account planning, co\-selling, and deal execution.
* Support partners in positioning, selling, and delivering Diligent's solutions, including joint value propositions and customer use cases.
* Own and report on partner\-related pipeline, deal progression, and revenue outcomes in the EMEA region.


**Strategic Business Development**


* Personally lead high\-value partnership discussions and complex commercial negotiations from inception through contract execution.
* Identify new routes\-to\-market and market entry opportunities via partnerships in both established and emerging EMEA geographies.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to represent partner and market feedback, influencing roadmap and integration priorities.
* Collaborate with Marketing to develop joint go\-to\-market initiatives, partner messaging, and demand\-generation activities.
* Work with Customer Success and Services teams to ensure successful partner\-led deployments and long\-term customer outcomes.


**Qualifications We Value**


* 12\+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, alliances, or enterprise sales within SaaS, risk, or enterprise software companies.
* Deep understanding of the GRC business, including how advisory and consulting firms structure and sell risk, audit, and compliance work; prior experience at a Big 4 firm is a strong plus.
* Proven track record of personally sourcing, structuring, and closing strategic partnerships that drive revenue.
* Experience operating as a senior individual contributor with high ownership and autonomy in fast\-growing or early\-stage environments.
* Strong understanding of partner\-led go\-to\-market models, including advisory/consulting alliances, resellers, and co\-sell motions.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with C\-level executives at partner and customer organizations.
* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate market insight into executable partnership initiatives.
* Highly self\-directed, hands\-on, and comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments — hustle and a willingness to roll up sleeves and do what it takes to build and own the region without formal team authority.

**About Us**



Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C\-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.



At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. Whether you're designing systems that leverage large language models or part of a team reimaging workflows with AI, you'll help us unlock entirely new ways of working and thinking. Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly \- those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you're not just building the future \- you're an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.

Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook

  


**What Diligent Offers You**


* **Creativity is ingrained in our culture.** We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients

**Title**
 Director, Marketing
   

  

***Launching Trinzic***
 KBR’s Mission Technology Solutions business is expected to spin off in January 2027 and will operate as Trinzic, an independent, publicly traded company with 18,000 employees, a global presence with more than 60 locations, and more than $5 billion in revenue. This is a once\-in\-a career opportunity to help launch a global brand and create a lasting impression for a modern, tech\-forward national security company with customers like NASA, the U.S. Department of War (DoW), and the intelligence community. This position will ultimately become part of that new organization. It’s a unique opportunity to help shape Trinzic’s foundation, built on KBR’s proven track record and resources, and to help build the new company’s vision, culture, and future success.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Director, Marketing you will lead the strategy, development, and execution of the Trinzic brand across all audiences, channels, and experiences. This role is responsible for defining, elevating, and safeguarding the company's brand identity while driving creative excellence that strengthens market presence, builds engagement, and supports business growth.
   

  

 Following the launch of the Trinzic name, logo, tagline, and visual identity in July 2026, this leader will play a pivotal role in transforming a newly established brand into a recognized force within the national security and space markets. This is a unique opportunity to shape how customers, employees, investors, and industry partners experience and connect with the Trinzic brand from day one.
   

  

 We are seeking a strategic brand builder and exceptional storyteller who can translate complex technical capabilities, from astronaut training and space domain awareness to high energy lasers and systems integration, into compelling narratives, impactful campaigns, and distinctive creative experiences. This leader will oversee all brand and creative execution across digital, print, events, executive communications, investor materials, social media, internal communications, advertising, and other corporate assets.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in brand strategy and creative leadership gained within a leading agency, Fortune 500 organization, top\-tier defense contractor, or similarly complex environment. Success will be measured through brand awareness, audience engagement, employee adoption, campaign performance, and overall contribution to corporate growth objectives.
   

  

**This role will be based out of the Arlington, VA office and will be a hybrid position.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Brand Strategy \& Governance**
* Lead the development and execution of the company's global brand strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and growth priorities.
* Drive brand adoption across global markets, balancing consistency in messaging and identity with the unique needs of local regions.
* Serve as one of the leaders responsible for establishing, scaling, and protecting the Trinzic brand during its first years as an independent public company.
* Establish and maintain brand governance, standards, guidelines, and approval processes across the organization.
* Drive the evolution of the brand positioning, voice, and value proposition to strengthen market differentiation and awareness.


**Creative Leadership \& Content Development**
* Lead and develop a high\-performing creative team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
* Oversee the development of creative assets and campaigns across digital, print, video, social media, events, executive communications, and other marketing channels.
* Ensure creative output reflects brand standards, business objectives, and audience needs.
* Direct creative strategy and execution for major campaigns, launches, internal and customer programs, leadership initiatives, and corporate events.
* Oversee all brand execution and deliverables from graphics, videos, tradeshow booths, PowerPoint presentations, digital brochures, swag, investor relations materials, the company website, newsletters, social media, executive communications, internal intranet sites, advertising, signage, and all other company assets.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Regularly interact with executive leadership, including providing strategic counsel to the CEO and senior leadership team on brand, reputation, and market positioning.
* Collaborate closely with communications, digital marketing, business development, human resources, and external partners to deliver integrated marketing programs.
* Partner with our People Partners and Talent Acquisition to strengthen employer branding, recruitment marketing, and employee engagement initiatives that enhance Trinzic's ability to attract and retain top talent.
* Present brand strategies, campaign recommendations, and creative concepts to executive leadership.
* Partner with Communications to support reputation management, issues preparedness, and stakeholder communications during critical business events.


**Agency \& Resource Management**
* Lead relationships with external vendors and production agencies.
* Manage budgets, agency performance, and resource allocation to ensure effective execution and return on investment.
* Evaluate and implement best practices, tools, and processes that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the creative function.


**Insights \& Performance Measurement**
* Leverage market research, competitive intelligence, and audience insights to inform branding and creative decisions.
* Establish key performance indicators and measurement frameworks to evaluate brand health and campaign effectiveness.
* Monitor performance metrics and recommend optimizations to strengthen engagement, awareness, and business impact.
* Stay informed on emerging marketing, branding, and design trends to continuously advance the organization's capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, Journalism, Design, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of progressive marketing, branding, advertising, or communications experience.
* 5\+ years of people leadership experience, including managing, developing, and mentoring creative, marketing, or brand teams in both in\-person and remote work environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise\-level brand strategy and creative development initiatives.
* Experience managing external agencies, creative partners, vendors, and production resources.
* Proven success developing and implementing brand frameworks, visual identity systems, and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Experience working within a complex, matrixed organization with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed to support business priorities, global brand initiatives, events, and stakeholder engagement activities.
* Must be a U.S. citizen


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Exceptional brand strategy and storytelling capabilities.
* Strong creative judgment with a demonstrated understanding of design principles, content development, and audience engagement.
* Outstanding leadership, coaching, mentoring, and team\-building skills.
* Ability to influence and build consensus across executive leadership and cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Strong strategic thinking, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to balance long\-term brand strategy with short\-term business priorities.
* Experience utilizing data, analytics, and customer insights to drive marketing decisions.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* High level of professionalism, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, evolving environment with ambiguity and change.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience in an advertising, branding, or integrated marketing agency environment.
* Experience supporting defense, aerospace, space, government services, national security, or other highly technical industries.

* Experience supporting publicly traded companies, IPOs, spin\-offs, mergers, acquisitions, or significant corporate transformation initiatives.
* Experience leading large\-scale change management, or organizational transformation efforts involving multiple stakeholder groups.

* Experience managing global brands across multiple geographies and markets.

* Experience collaborating with investor relations, executive communications, and corporate affairs functions.

description:
**Job title:** Innovation Manager


**Base:** Health Innovation Kent Surrey Sussex’s primary place of business is The Beehive, located in Gatwick/Crawley, West Sussex. We have further satellite / hot\-desking arrangements at sites located in Guildford and Brighton. Contractually, your normal place of work will be Health Innovation KSS’s primary place of business.

**Location:** The role is predominately remote, although Health Innovation KSS staff work on a hybrid basis. Post holders are expected to be based in, or be able to attend meetings in the Kent, Surrey, Sussex geography.

**Reports to:** Head of Portfolio \- Innovation \& Enterprise

**Direct reports:** Project delivery resource and access to a pool of team members if required.

**Salary:** £54,000 per annum

**Job Purpose**


Health Innovation Kent Surrey Sussex is commissioned by the Office for Life Sciences (OLS) and NHS England to deliver programmes of support to accelerate the creation and adoption of health innovations, delivering improved outcomes for the population and generating economic growth, regionally and nationally with supporting companies/innovators to scale and create new jobs and investment. Our focused Innovation Managers lead on Health Innovation KSS’s engagement with health technology companies (and other types of innovators including clinical and academic) and their networks across all technology sectors (digital, medical technology, diagnostics and pharmaceutical).


The Innovation \& Enterprise team lead on Health Innovation KSS’s engagement with health technology companies and their networks across all technology sectors (digital, medical technology, diagnostics and pharmaceutical) and with local health and care system partners to identify their priorities and find solutions to their problems.


The team works across our commissioned programmes to identify opportunities to build partnerships with the commercial sector and work within the NHS England Innovator Support programmes; and OLS Commission: Innovation Exchange framework, working in collaboration with our wider team to provide advice on commercialisation, market access and real\-world validation.


The team partners with Health Innovation KSS’s wider programme delivery function to provide a focus on building partnerships between the NHS and commercial sector to accelerate the adoption and spread of solutions that improve the health and economy of our region.


The purpose of this role includes:

* Working as part of the delivery resource team within Health Innovation KSS, taking a leadership role for a portfolio of products/innovation needs areas.
* Managing a portfolio of products and initiatives which may include some with other colleagues direct or indirect involvement.
* Supporting delivery of tailored support packages of support to industry and innovators in line with the Health Innovation Network Universal, Enhanced and Distinctive offers to innovators including 1:1 and 1:many offerings.
* Making contributions to income and the income generation pipeline to generate income for Health Innovation Network to ensure long\-term sustainability by:
* Contributing to bids or grant applications for funding to support services offered by Health Innovation KSS.
* Supporting the identification and securing of contracts of tailored packages of support to industry.
* Delivering tailored packages of support to industry according to the agreed contract and reporting via ‘consultancy timesheet approach’.
* Supporting the development of new service offerings with clear customer focus.
* Supporting the cultivation of existing customer demand through marketing of existing service provision.
* Supporting the cultivation of new customers through service development opportunities.
* Supporting links between innovators and a range of health and care organisations to deliver the spread and adoption of innovation into practice, developing the innovation eco\-system and innovation pipeline.
* Supporting innovators to grow and generate economic growth.

The specific area of responsibility for the role (at appointment) is outlined at Appendix A. Please note that this specific area of responsibility is subject to change, according to future programme delivery requirements.

**Key duties and responsibilities**

* To support the Director of Innovation \& Enterprise and Heads of Portfolio with the management and delivery of industry and innovator support across Kent Surrey and Sussex and the wider Health Innovation Network.
* To make a contribution to income and the income generation pipeline through projects and programmes for Health Innovation KSS to ensure long\-term sustainability.
* To work with a wide range of stakeholders, particularly between innovator partners, the health and care system, business support organisations and academic institutions.
* To improve health and generate economic growth through the adoption and spread of innovation.
* Working across the whole Kent, Surrey, Sussex geography \- a requirement of the role is to travel to satellite offices across the region.
* Directly supporting innovators to access health and social care, providing support, advice and guidance to generate jobs and leverage funding (private and public) for the companies we support as well as leading to innovation adoption.
* Providing support to a pipeline of innovations with the potential to help respond to the challenges in our regional health and care system.
* Providing support to innovators to further develop solutions to unmet needs by providing advice on commercialisation, market access and real\-world validation.
* Reviewing companies and triaging them for support which Health Innovation KSS can provide including, but not limited to, engagement with the national process for company review and engaging with individual HIN’s and other KSS colleagues.
* To design, plan and implement additional programmes of activity to address desired business support outcomes (jobs created, investment leveraged and exports) within the region.
* To provide ongoing innovator support in helping companies to navigate health and social care.
* Supporting with the sharing of case studies, lessons learnt, marketing and communication of successful innovation implementations.
* Identifying and working with sub\-contractors as may be appropriate to fulfil the demands of the OLS and NHSE commission (s).
* To be responsible for contributing to the production of and input to monthly informal and quarterly formal reports; working alongside the Innovation \& Enterprise team and wider delivery team (s).
* To support the horizon scan for examples of innovation within the project areas that can be spread and adopted or for co\-design or spread support with KSS system partners.
* To signpost innovators to other support bodies and other companies and agencies relevant to their business and product needs.
* To continue to develop the existing signposting directory with new and relevant support for innovators coming through the HIN.
* To ensure that any risks relating to the delivery of programmes of work (including risks to the programme delivering within budget) are managed wherever possible and proactively alerted to the appropriate Heads of Portfolio, Director of Innovation \& Enterprise and/or Chief Operating Officer.
* To prepare and deliver reports, information seminars and workshops as required and present at meetings and conferences both in person and virtually to a range of stakeholders including innovators.
* To interpret relevant national policy with regard to advice and guidance to innovators on the development and market approach for their products and their relevance to health and care.
* To represent Health Innovation KSS at meetings with other HIN’s and any other meetings as requested by Director of Innovation \& Enterprise or Heads of Portfolio.
* To work closely with commissioners to support the implementation of HIN objectives with specific focus on the Office of Life Science Commission and the NHSE National Innovator Service.

The job description is not intended to be exhaustive, and it is likely that duties may be altered from time to time in the light of changing circumstances and after consultation with the postholder.

**General responsibilities**

* To act as part of 'one team'.
* To promote the values of Health Innovation KSS.
* To ensure effective communications within and between project teams, be involved in and participate in meetings, team briefings, development days, corporate events etc.
* To engage with line manager in regular performance and development reviews against agreed objectives. To be responsible for actively identifying own development needs and committing to a personal development plan based on continuous learning.

**Person Specification: Innovation Manager**

**Education, Qualifications \& Training**

**Essential**

* Educated to degree standard or equivalent in a relevant discipline.
* Project or portfolio management qualification or equivalent experience.
* Evidence of continuous professional development; record of CPD shows strong self\-development ethos and learning.
* Experience of supporting industry either within a company of through business support and accelerators with emphasis on business growth.
**Desirable**

* Experience supporting or working within health\-tech company/innovation landscape.
* Health and care experience either clinical or managerial.

**Knowledge \& Experience**

**Essential**

* Significant recent management experience in the NHS, in industry/supporting innovators or another organisation in a relevant sector.
* Evidence of effective partnership working.
* Proven experience of managing a range of projects or companies, concurrently.
* Managing resources to support the delivery of projects / programmes.
* Financial and performance management experience.
* Experience of working with a range of staff at all levels.
* Knowledge of the health and/or social care sectors.
**Desirable**

* Experience of providing business case advice to health\-tech companies.
* Experience of providing advice to senior managers and consultants.
* Experience of clinical transformation projects and working with health and care in the UK.

**Other requirements**

**Appendix A**

**Industry focused: Innovation Manager**

**Specific responsibilities of this role**


In addition to the main Innovation Manager Job Description, outlined below are specific responsibilities and key skills required that are related to the focus of the role within our Innovation and Enterprise team.


As outlined in the generic Innovation Manager Job Description, these are initial specific responsibilities of the role (i.e. upon appointment) and are subject to change, according to business delivery requirements.

**Job purpose**


Health Innovation Kent Surrey Sussex is commissioned by the Office for Life Sciences (OLS) and NHS England to deliver programmes of support to accelerate the creation and adoption of health innovations, delivering improved outcomes for the population and generating economic growth, regionally and nationally with supporting companies/innovators to scale and create new jobs and investment. Our focused Innovation Managers lead on Health Innovation KSS’s engagement with health technology companies (and other types of innovators including clinical and academic) and their networks across all technology sectors (digital, medical technology, diagnostics and pharmaceutical).


The Innovation \& Enterprise team lead on Health Innovation KSS’s engagement with health technology companies and their networks across all technology sectors (digital, medical technology, diagnostics and pharmaceutical) and with local health and care system partners to identify their priorities and find solutions to their problems.


The team works across our commissioned programmes to identify opportunities to build partnerships with the commercial sector and work within the NHS England Innovator Support programmes; and OLS Commission: Innovation Exchange framework, working in collaboration with our wider team to provide advice on commercialisation, market access and real\-world validation.


The team partners with Health Innovation KSS’s wider programme delivery function to provide a focus on building partnerships between the NHS and commercial sector to accelerate the adoption and spread of solutions that improve the health and economy of our region.

* Working across the whole Kent, Surrey, Sussex geography a requirement of the role is to travel to satellite offices across the region, as required.
* Directly supporting small and medium\-sized enterprises (SMEs) innovators and other types of companies to access the NHS, providing support, advice and guidance.
* Development, market access, commercialisation and growth, relevant to local system needs, value proposition and alike to generate jobs and leverage funding for the companies we support.
* Providing support to a pipeline of commercial sector innovations with the potential to help respond to the challenges in our regional health and care system.
* Interpreting and applying relevant national policy with regard to digital health, med\-tech, life sciences industry, regulation and innovation.

* To design, plan and implement additional programmes of activity to address desired business support outcomes (jobs created, investment leveraged and exports) within the region.
* Preparing reports, briefings and presentations as required and present at meetings and conferences.
* To provide ongoing commercial support in parallel to other colleagues’ support in helping companies to navigate health and social care.
* To be the front door companies and innovators seeking guidance from Health Innovation KSS and triaging companies accordingly.
* Developing and delivering virtual and face to face workshops for innovators/industry on topics relevant to their growth and development.
* Working with sub\-contractors as may be appropriate to build robust plans for how we will understand the impact of our support for commercial sector organisations.
* To be responsible for contributing to the production of and input to monthly informal and quarterly formal reports; working alongside the Director of Innovation \& Enterprise, Heads of Portfolio, other Innovation/Programme Manager(s), and Innovation/Programme Co\-ordinator(s).
* Contributing to trackers and reporting stages of innovation adoption per each technology, or company.

**Key skills, experience and personal style**

* Experience of interaction with clinicians, innovators and health \& social care systems, due to the specific focus on clinical innovations and clinical engagement.
* Ideally experience, or some understanding of, the investment landscape from; public body grants to angel and VC investment within innovation.
* An understanding of the barriers and challenges faced by SME’s as they scale their business, including and not limited to; research and development, strategy development, recruitment and finance management.
* An existing network of industry beneficial stakeholders, for signposting and guidance, is also desirable.
* Effective partnership working and stakeholder management.
* Experience in presenting to senior stakeholders and senior colleagues, with a track record of influencing stakeholders and an ability to change their perspectives.

title: Lead Character Artist
description:
Abstraction is a Dutch game co\-development studio aiming to deliver cutting\-edge game experiences. Specializing in technically demanding projects, we have collaborated on renowned IPs like *Halo, Dune, Mass Effect,* and *Baldur’s Gate*. Our portfolio contains over 60 titles, reflecting our commitment to quality and technical prowess. We're not just partners with industry giants such as *BioWare/EA, 343/Microsoft, Funcom, Sega*, and others; we're innovators in our field.


We are looking for a visionary and experienced **Character** **Art Lead** to lead the artistic vision of our co\-development projects from concept to final delivery, creating key assets, overseeing the planning, coordination, and delivery of art production across our exciting AAA co\-development projects.


As a key creative contributor, you will execute and drive the development of iconic visuals, collaborate with leadership across disciplines and clients, and provide high\-level guidance to the project team and be part of the project’s decision\-making leadership.


This role is ideal for a seasoned artist who combines hands\-on expertise with long\-term thinking, and you will partner with creative and technical leads to ensure that artistic vision is met while staying on schedule and within scope. You’ll be responsible for creating key assets, supporting and enabling team workflows, ensuring consistent communication among project disciplines and external partners.
  

  

We value diverse perspectives and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to help us push the boundaries of our amazing game projects.

 **Impact**


In this role, you'll be much more than your job title. You will:

* **Cultivate Collaboration**: Enhance our team culture through active participation and open communication.
* **Ignite Innovation**: Bring fresh, creative ideas that challenge conventional thinking.
* **Embody Our Values**: Live our core values and inspire others by example.
* **Encourage Growth**: Share your knowledge, fostering both individual and team development.
* **Champion Positive Change**: Help steer our company towards impactful, industry\-leading initiatives.
* Your contribution will extend beyond tasks and targets; it's about making a lasting, positive difference in our workplace and community.

**Responsibilities**

* Translate concept art and key art into high\-quality, production\-ready character and creature assets, including high\-poly sculpts, game\-ready meshes, UVs, and PBR textures.
* Create key character assets that set the quality bar and visual benchmark for the character team.
* Work closely with the client\-side Art Director and concept artists to faithfully interpret the visual direction and style, and raise any feasibility concerns early.
* Comfortable working under ambiguity, with a proactive, problem\-solving mindset and sound artistic judgment when references or direction are incomplete.
* Implement character assets in engine (Unreal Engine), including material and shader setup, LODs, and asset configuration, making sure they look and perform as intended in\-game.
* Guide and support the character art team through regular reviews, clear feedback, and hands\-on help, ensuring consistency in quality and style across all character deliverables.
* Collaborate with tech art, rigging, and animation to ensure assets meet technical specifications and deform well.
* Establish and maintain character art workflows, best practices, and documentation for the team.
* Provide task estimates and progress updates to Production for character art deliverables.
* Support character team recruitment as needed, including portfolio reviews and art tests.

 **Knowledge \& Experience**

* 7\+ years of experience as a Character Artist in game development, including experience in a Lead or Senior role on shipped AAA titles.
* An outstanding portfolio demonstrating realistic human anatomy and creature work, with a strong grasp of form, proportion, and surface detail.
* Proven ability to take a concept from 2D to a finished, game\-ready 3D asset while staying true to the original design.
* Expert knowledge of sculpting, modelling, and texturing tools such as ZBrush, Maya, Blender or 3ds Max, and Substance 3D Painter.
* Strong understanding of real\-time character pipelines, including retopology, UVs, baking, PBR texturing, and optimisation for performance.
* Solid experience implementing and setting up character assets in Unreal Engine.
* Versatility across other styles (stylized, cartoony) is a plus, though this project calls for a grounded, realistic approach.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to give and receive constructive feedback.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.
* Bonus: Able to concept and ideate through rough sculpting and 2d techniques.
* Bonus: Knowledge of clothing, hair, and scan\-based workflows (e.g., Marvellous Designer, hair cards or grooms, Wrap).

**What We Offer:**

* An autonomous job within a professional and informally organised company
* A competitive salary
* A lot of room for personal development and ownership
* Possibility to work hybrid/onsite, or fully remote
* An employment contract if you live in the Netherlands, Germany, or the UK, or a freelancer contract if you live within one of our approved countries.


	+ Abstraction cannot currently hire remote freelance contractors from Germany, Spain, Italy, France, or the USA.

*We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and equitable work environment where all individuals, regardless of their background, are encouraged to thrive, and we empower all team members to bring their unique perspectives to the table.*

title: Brand Systems Designer (Fixed Term Three-Month Contract)
description:
Aareon is Europe’s established provider of SaaS solutions for the real estate industry and a pioneer of the sector’s digital future.
  

With its software solutions, Aareon connects people, processes, and properties—bringing the industry closer together. With the Aareon Property Management System, based on intelligent software solutions, the company enables the efficient management and maintenance of residential and commercial properties and creates digital experiences for all stakeholders.
  

As a reliable and innovative partner, Aareon is committed to progress, positive change, and sustainable living and working spaces for everyone.


We value a working environment in which diversity and flexibility are appreciated, cooperation in partnership and mutual support in the team are a matter of course and learning is perceived as an opportunity.


Become part of our international team! Become part of \#OneAareon! We are looking forward to meeting YOU!


**Location:** Remote UK
  

**Hours:** Monday \- Friday 9am \- 5\.30pm
  

**Contract:** Three\-month contract, full time
  

**Total contract rate for 3 months:** Up to £27,000 depending on experience
  

**Reports to:** Marketing Director


**About Aareon**  

Aareon is helping housing providers, property managers and landlords operate more efficiently through technology, data and AI\-powered innovation.  



  

As Aareon continues its transformation from a collection of acquired businesses into a unified market\-facing organisation, one of the most important challenges facing the business is the move from a house of brands to a branded house. Over the coming transformation period, multiple legacy product and business identities will be consolidated into a more coherent Aareon architecture, supported by a common visual language, design system and governance framework. This programme sits alongside the launch of Aareon Intelligence and a wider effort to strengthen consistency, recognition and trust across every customer touchpoint.  



  

To help accelerate this transformation, Aareon is engaging specialist Brand Systems Designers to help build the foundations that will allow the brand to scale consistently across marketing, product, sales and customer\-facing teams.  



  

**The Opportunity**  

We're looking for an experienced Brand Systems Designer to build Aareon's Canva ecosystem from the ground up.  



  

Your primary objective is to create the design infrastructure that allows a growing organisation to produce high\-quality, on\-brand collateral at scale. You will translate Aareon's evolving design system into Canva, creating governed templates, component libraries, workflows and brand controls that enable teams across the business to create assets independently.  



  

Today, Marketing sits in the path of a significant volume of collateral requests. This role helps solve that problem by creating the systems that make self\-service possible whilst maintaining brand consistency during one of the largest brand transitions in the company's history.  



  

You will work closely with the team to create a scalable Canva environment that supports the branded\-house rollout, reduces operational friction and establishes the foundation for future growth.  



  

This role is ideal for someone who thinks in systems rather than individual assets and enjoys designing frameworks that make entire organisations more effective.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**  

Canva Brand System Architecture


* Design and build Aareon's Canva enterprise environment.
* Establish the structure, governance and taxonomy behind the Canva workspace.
* Configure brand controls, locked elements, approved assets and reusable components.
* Create a scalable framework that supports both current and future brand requirements.
* Develop standards that enable self\-service without sacrificing consistency.

Template Library Development


* Create a comprehensive library of Canva templates for marketing, sales, customer success and corporate communications.
* Develop templates for social media, presentations, case studies, product sheets, event assets, email graphics and internal communications.
* Build modular template systems that can be used across multiple products and audiences.
* Ensure templates are intuitive for non\-design users.
* Reduce the volume of routine asset requests flowing into the marketing team.

Branded House Rollout Support


* Support the rollout of the One Aareon identity and evolving product architecture.
* Translate brand standards into practical, repeatable Canva assets and workflows.
* Ensure newly launched products and initiatives can be supported within the system.
* Help maintain consistency across legacy brands transitioning into the new architecture.
* Support adoption of Aareon Intelligence and future product launches through scalable branded assets.

Governance \& Enablement


* Develop Canva governance guidelines and usage standards.
* Create training materials and documentation for internal users.
* Enable teams to create their own collateral safely and consistently.
* Establish approval routes and governance controls where required.
* Work with stakeholders to improve adoption and utilisation across the organisation.

Design Systems \& Asset Management


* Translate Aareon's visual identity into a structured design system.
* Ensure design assets, components and templates remain current and organised.
* Create processes for maintaining and evolving the Canva environment.
* Work closely with Designers and the Creative Lead to ensure alignment with broader brand standards.
* Leave behind a sustainable system that can be maintained internally after the contract concludes.

**Skills \& Experience**  

Required


* Extensive experience building Canva environments, brand hubs or enterprise Canva implementations.
* Advanced Canva expertise, including Brand Kits, template governance, permissions and workspace architecture.
* Experience designing self\-service template ecosystems for non\-design users.
* Strong graphic design capability and understanding of visual identity systems.
* Experience translating brand guidelines into scalable workflows and reusable assets.
* Experience supporting brand transitions, identity rollouts or organisational transformation.
* Ability to balance governance with usability.

Desirable


* Experience implementing Canva across large or distributed organisations.
* Experience supporting acquisition integration or multi\-brand consolidation.
* Experience within technology, SaaS, PropTech or B2B organisations.
* Familiarity with Figma component systems and design\-system methodologies.
* Experience creating training programmes and adoption frameworks.

**What We're Looking For**

* Someone who designs for the person who will use the template, not for the portfolio
* Discipline about governance, since the whole value of this is that it holds after you leave
* Comfort finishing and handing over rather than staying attached to the work
* Interest in the unglamorous problem, because the payoff is a business that stops waiting on marketing

**What Success Looks Like**  

During the engagement you will:


* Establish Aareon's Canva environment as the single source of truth for branded collateral.
* Create a template ecosystem that supports self\-service across the organisation.
* Significantly reduce the volume of routine design requests entering the marketing team.
* Improve brand consistency across Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.
* Successfully support the branded\-house transition through scalable design infrastructure.
* Introduce governance processes that protect quality whilst increasing speed.
* Enable colleagues across the business to create on\-brand collateral independently.
* Leave behind a sustainable system that continues delivering value long after the engagement ends.

**Why Join Aareon?**  

This is an opportunity to build the brand operating system that will support Aareon's next phase of growth.  



  

Rather than creating individual assets, you'll create the infrastructure behind thousands of future assets. Your work will shape how Marketing, Sales and Customer Success communicate for years to come, whilst supporting one of the most ambitious brand transformation programmes currently underway in UK property technology.

The Director leads the college’s efforts to infuse life design and career development perspectives throughout the curriculum and co\-curriculum while expanding opportunities for multiple forms of work\-based learning.
