title: Manager, DTC Analytics
description:
**About Harry’s**



Harry’s is a men’s grooming brand that offers high quality shave, body, hair, and skin care products at an exceptional value. Launched in 2013, Harry’s redefined the shaving experience and helped pioneer the earliest era of direct to consumer in the process. Since then, the brand has become the \#2 shave brand globally and expanded to offer products for every step in its customer’s routine. Harry’s is also on a mission to ensure guys have access to quality mental health care. To date, the brand has helped connect over 2 million men to quality mental health resources.



Harry’s is part of Mammoth Brands, the modern CPG company behind category\-leading brands Harry’s, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. Driven by a mission to “Create Things People Like More,” the company is creating a new model—and home—for brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples’ lives and ultimately change the status quo. Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community. Mammoth Brands is committed to making a positive impact and donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date.



We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day\-to\-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it.



  

### **About the Team**



The Centralized Insights \& Analytics (CIA) team is a critical function that drives proactive insights\-to\-action within the US Personal Care organization. The CIA organization unites capabilities across data science, analytics, insights, and category management into an integrated function to translate insights into action for everyday decisions and more complex business questions, helping shape the future of our business strategy and enabling us to best serve our customers. Capabilities built by this team will meaningfully impact the business through marketing optimization, channel strategy, site optimization, selling stories, thought leadership, innovation, and overall consumer/shopper experience.

  


**About the Role**



As the Analytics Manager for DTC, you'll build and drive the reporting and diagnostic analytics that advance our strategy \- and turn that analysis into a point of view. You'll design and report on DTC KPIs and analyses spanning the user journey from acquisition through conversion, post\-purchase engagement and retention, subscriptions, distribution, and site experimentation. When a stakeholder brings you a question, they should walk away with a recommendation, not just a chart or data point \- that means connecting the dots across data sources, business priorities, and customer signal, and knowing which questions are worth chasing and which aren't. We need someone with strong business acumen, excellent storytelling skills, a passion for consumer empathy, a robust technical toolkit, and the confidence to share a strong point of view, even with people more senior than you. You'll work with key decision\-makers throughout the DTC organization, and share your insights and recommendations \- and defend them \- with all levels of the business.

  


**Here's what you'll accomplish:**


* Synthesizing data on a regular basis to provide the DTC team with brand\-level insights on business health \- and a clear recommendation on what to do about it, not just the numbers
* + Leverage our BI tool Omni to build, maintain, and own dashboards that empower the business to interpret and act quickly. (e.g., track inventory issues across retailers and build actionable alerting.)
	+ Become an expert on existing DTC reporting and drive towards improvement
* Plan, design, and implement reports that highlight key performance indicators
* + Enhance our A/B testing reporting suite
	+ Track new feature launches by Product \& Engagement teams and build/manage the reporting for how they perform
* Work closely with the teams in our DTC Org to drive value for the business
* + Gain a strong understanding of their data problems and use our Analytics toolkit to find a solution (What data do we need, how can we get it, and how can we automate reporting?)
	+ Driving deep analysis of the whats and whys of key drivers to surface hypotheses for action
* Be a strong, trusted voice and thought leader for the brands you support \- bringing a well\-reasoned point of view to the table, and comfortable sharing it with stakeholders at all levels
* + Enable your stakeholders and leaders to get sharper and smarter on the data, the business, and how we tackle our biggest questions just by working alongside you
	+ Bring a strong, well\-reasoned point of view and advocate for the brands you support, comfortable doing so with people more senior than you
	+ Your impact and influence comes from how much smarter you make the people around you and your strong perspective
* Help define how we measure and report out on performance on ecommerce across key KPIs, set up dashboarding capability, and regularly track and share the overall performance of the business to drive strategic planning
* Identify analytics pain points and inefficiencies, and develop new tools and automated processes to optimize and streamline. AI is integral to the work, not an afterthought.
* Be a data\-evangelist and sparring partner across the organization, sharing best practices and insights and willing to challenge the status quo with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders at every level

  


### **This may describe you:**


* 5\+ years in data analytics or a similarly analytical field, using data to drive decision\-making and narrative development in a fast\-moving, cross\-functional environment, with a strong understanding of the role analytics plays in a cross\-disciplinary digital product development lifecycle.
* Proficient Technical Skill – Fluent in SQL (Python or R a plus), with the ability to query, manipulate, and analyze data end\-to\-end to accelerate the business.
* BI Tool Fluency – Hands\-on experience building and maintaining dashboards and models in a modern BI platform. We currently run in Omni; prior experience with Looker, Tableau, or Power BI will be an enabler.
* AI\-Forward – You use AI tools to speed up your own analysis, and you're comfortable helping others on the team build that same fluency.
* Business Acumen \& Judgment – You connect the dots across data sources, business priorities, and customer signal, and you have a nose for which questions are worth chasing \- so you spend your time on the highest\-impact problems, not just the interesting ones.
* Engaged Thought Partner – When someone brings you a question, they leave with a recommendation and a point of view, not just an analysis plan. You can point to specific insights that changed a real decision, not just reports you've shipped.
* Clear, Confident Communicator – You explain complex ideas simply, and you're as comfortable challenging a room full of senior stakeholders as you are presenting to them.
* You thrive on direct, honest, and supportive communication and feedback
* You are infectiously optimistic and curious \- To you, there’s nothing more exciting than a new challenge. Hard things are hard, but you don’t let that get in the way

  


**Who you will work with:**


* You will report to the Sr. Director of Omnichannel Analytics, with a dotted line to our VP of DTC
* Within the broader CIA org, you'll work most closely with the other data analysts and analytics engineers on the team.
* Within the larger Digital org, you’ll work closely with our DTC team (Product/Engagement/CX) as well as Distribution and Finance.

* **401k match**
* **Equity in Mammoth Brands**
* **Flexible time off and working hours**
* **L\&D stipend**
* **4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years, 6 weeks after 10 years, and 8 weeks after 15 years**

* **Fun IRL and virtual events including happy hours, team building events, and parties on our rooftop**
* **Free products from our family of brands**

Our beautiful* *70,000 square foot SoHo office* *is decked out with bagels on Wednesdays and lunch on Thursdays, and fully stocked kitchens with snacks, coffee, and drinks everyday. Can’t forget the free products and the opportunity to have some meetings without Zoom!*



We can’t quantify all of the intangible things we think you’ll love about working at Mammoth Brands, like the exciting challenges we tackle, the smart and humble team you’ll get to work with, and our supportive and inclusive culture. title: Program Director, Media
description:
#### **Join Our Team as a Program Director, Media at the International Republican Institute (IRI)!**

  


**ABOUT IRI**



The International Republican Institute (IRI) advances democracy and freedom. We link people with their governments, support politicians to be responsive to citizens, and motivate those citizens to engage in the political process.



At IRI, every employee plays a crucial role in advancing our mission across the globe. We’re looking for passionate individuals who embody our Core Values and are eager to contribute to our dynamic team. Our values include:


* **Respect:** We lead with trust, empathy, and dignity; empowering colleagues and partners.
* **Teamwork:** We collaborate across teams; solve problems together; are humble and ready to learn.
* **Ownership:** We take initiative; champion solutions; deliver results for IRI’s mission.
* **Excellence through Execution:** We balance thoughtfulness with timeliness; learn from results; prioritize progress over perfection.
* **Transparency:** We share information openly; give direct feedback; build trust through honest communication.
* **Freedom:** We are empowered to make decisions, try new approaches, and adapt as needed.

  


**ABOUT THE ROLE:** PROGRAM DIRECTOR, MEDIA



The Program Director (PD), Media oversees the day\-to\-day implementation, coordination, and administration of a global program that will strengthen the resilience of independent media outlets to foreign state propaganda and coercive influence through expanded access to credible content, technical assistance, training, and support for media business sustainability across multiple regions and languages.



The Program Director serves as the primary operational lead responsible for managing program activities, coordinating partner and participant engagement, overseeing media outlet recruitment and onboarding, monitoring implementation progress, managing consultants and service providers, and ensuring timely delivery of program outputs and deliverables. The PD coordinates closely with participating media outlets, content providers, trainers, consultants, and strategic partners to support effective implementation across all program activities and regions.



In addition, the Program Director serves as the primary point of contact for participating media outlets and platform users — responding to participant inquiries, supporting onboarding and engagement activities, coordinating with technical support providers, facilitating communications among project stakeholders, and helping ensure participating organizations effectively utilize program resources and services. The PD also supports routine monitoring and reporting functions and provides human oversight of automated platform processes by reviewing disputed or questionable AI\-generated determinations and coordinating with technical experts when necessary. This position helps ensure responsive participant support, strong partner engagement, and effective coordination across the program’s content access, technical assistance, training, and media sustainability components.


*This position is located in Washington, DC. The Program Director, Media is expected to work in\-office at least three days per week.*


*This position is contingent upon award of funding.*

  


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Program Implementation \& Oversight**


* Serve as the primary operational lead for a global project, overseeing day\-to\-day implementation, coordination, and administration of all program activities across regions and languages.
* Develop and maintain detailed work plans, activity calendars, and implementation trackers; monitor progress against milestones and flag risks, delays, and resource constraints to program leadership.
* Ensure the timely delivery of program outputs and deliverables, coordinating inputs from staff, partners, consultants, and service providers.
* Plan and execute program activities, including trainings, workshops, convenings, and virtual events, overseeing or carrying out logistical arrangements as required.
* Ensure that program activities are technically sound, appropriate to each media market, and compliant with IRI policy, donor requirements, and applicable U.S. and local laws and regulations.
* Maintain awareness of political, media ecosystem, and security developments in program countries to inform programmatic and operational decisions, and ensure that program activities and participating organizations are handled with appropriate attention to participant safety and information security.


**Participant Support \& Media Outlet Engagement**


* Serve as the primary point of contact for participating media outlets and platform users, responding to participant inquiries promptly and professionally.
* Oversee media outlet recruitment, vetting, and onboarding, including outreach, application processing, eligibility review, orientation, and account setup.
* Design and deliver engagement activities that help participating organizations effectively utilize program resources and services, including a media resilience portal, content access, technical assistance, and training offerings.
* Track participant engagement and utilization, identify outlets requiring additional support, and coordinate follow\-up.
* Coordinate with technical support providers to resolve user issues, and escalate unresolved or systemic problems to the appropriate technical or program leads.
* Facilitate communications among project stakeholders, including regular updates, guidance materials, and user\-facing documentation in coordination with communications staff.


**Platform Oversight \& Human Review of Automated Processes**


* Provide human oversight of automated platform processes.
* Apply established review criteria consistently, document review decisions and rationale, and communicate outcomes to affected participants.
* Coordinate with technical experts, the Senior Media Advisor, and platform providers when a determination requires specialized judgment or indicates a systemic issue, and recommend refinements to review criteria and platform processes based on patterns observed.


**Partner, Consultant, \& Service Provider Management**


* Coordinate closely with content providers, trainers, consultants, strategic partners, and subawardees to support effective implementation across all program components.
* Manage consultants and service providers, including developing scopes of work, supporting procurement processes, overseeing deliverables and timelines, and reviewing work products for quality and compliance.
* Support the negotiation and administration of partnership agreements and content arrangements in coordination with IRI program, grants, and contracts staff.
* Maintain regular communication with partners to resolve implementation issues and ensure coherent, non\-duplicative delivery.


**Monitoring, Reporting, \& Adaptive Management**


* Support the Senior MEL Specialist in routine monitoring functions, including data collection, participant feedback, indicator tracking, and maintenance of program records and databases.
* Work with the Senior MEL Specialist to draft and compile internal and donor reports, activity summaries, and success stories, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely submission.
* Analyze implementation and engagement data to identify trends and challenges, and contribute recommendations for adaptive management and course correction.
* Coordinate with monitoring, evaluation, and learning colleagues on assessments, evaluations, and learning activities.


**Financial \& Compliance Oversight**


* Support program budgeting, spending projections, and financial reconciliations in coordination with headquarters\-based program and finance staff.
* Ensure that donor funds are used appropriately and in accordance with IRI policy, donor regulations, and applicable laws.
* Maintain an understanding of donor and IRI policies and procedures and help ensure grant compliance across program activities, procurements, and partner agreements.


**Internal \& External Collaboration**


* Build and maintain productive working relationships with colleagues across IRI, including Regional Divisions, technical practices, grants and contracts, finance, and communications.
* Support IRI’s coordination with the donor and partners, including preparation of materials for donor meetings and responses to donor requests.
* Coordinate with the Senior Media Advisor and other technical advisors to ensure that implementation reflects the program’s technical direction.
* Represent IRI and the global project effectively to participating organizations, partners, and external audiences as requested.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Note:** This post is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required in this role. Further details of the role will be shared during the recruitment process.

  


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**



We seek a passionate, experienced, and technically fluent individual with:


* Undergraduate degree in journalism, communications, international relations, political science, or a related field. Graduate degree preferred.
* Minimum eight years of relevant work experience, with a strong preference for experience in independent media development, media support, or the democracy, rights, and governance sector.
* Demonstrated experience managing the day\-to\-day implementation of international programs, including work planning, activity execution, monitoring, reporting, and close out.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple partners, consultants, and service providers, including developing scopes of work and overseeing deliverables.
* Experience in a participant\-facing or user support role, with a proven ability to manage a high volume of inquiries and deliver responsive, service\-oriented support to diverse users.
* Experience supporting recruitment, onboarding, and engagement of participating organizations, grantees, or platform users.
* Familiarity with digital platforms and content delivery systems, and comfort providing human review of automated or AI\-generated determinations; capacity to apply review criteria consistently and document decisions.
* Proven knowledge of U.S. Government donor requirements, regulations, and reporting for international programs
* Demonstrated experience with results\-based program design and performance management, including monitoring data collection and donor reporting.
* Strong written and oral communications and editing skills in English. Proficiency in an additional language relevant to the program’s target regions preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing deadlines across multiple regions, languages, and time zones.
* Strong ability to initiate, foster, and maintain relationships with contacts and stakeholders in a diverse and multicultural environment, with sensitivity, respect, discretion, tact, and professionalism.
* Experience identifying complex problems and developing creative solutions; ability to exercise sound judgment on sensitive participant, security, and partner matters.
* Ability to work well under pressure, adapt to shifting priorities, and work both independently and as a member of a team.
* Experienced user of Microsoft Office; familiarity with project management, CRM, or learning platform tools preferred.
* Experience living, working, or traveling internationally; willingness to travel internationally, including to remote and sometimes challenging environments.

  


**IRI TOTAL COMPENSATION**


*The anticipated compensation range for this position is $125,000 to $145,000 USD.*



The salary for this position is determined based on a wide variety of factors including but not limited to an individual’s professional experience, qualifications, education and other business needs along with internal equity considerations. Employees are not typically hired at the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are made based on the aforementioned considerations.

  


**WE OFFER**



An empathetic and dedicated work environment with generous benefits that demonstrates IRI’s commitment to all dimensions of employee wellness, including:


* **Health and Wellness Support**: Significant coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance costs. Meaningful assistance programs through an Employee Assistance Plan (EAP) and Rula (access to mental health experts).
* **Long\-term Financial Health:** Retirement plan with generous employer contribution (vested after 12 months).
* **Hybrid Work:** Employees typically work in\-office three days per week and telework two days per week.
* **Time Off:** Company\-paid holidays, parental leave, generous vacation, sick, and personal leave days.
* **Family Support**: Dependent Care FSA
* **Learning and Development Opportunities:** Annual allowance for professional development courses and seminars along with access to world\-class e\-learning via eCornell.
* **Compensation Equity:** Regular competitive review of internal and external equity to ensure fairness in pay for employees working in similar jobs requiring comparable knowledge, skills, and experience.


*Benefits, professional development, and flexibility offerings may vary based on employment classification and location.*

  


**APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS – RESUME, COVER LETTER, REFERENCES**


**In your application, please include a copy of your most up\-to\-date resume along with a cover letter that outlines your background and explains why you are interested in this opportunity. Additionally, please include the contact details of at least 2\-3 professional references. If you are selected for an interview, we will contact your references before the final interview.**


Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities  

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

description:
**Your camera roll is already a portfolio. Let's get you paid for it.** 

If your For You Page is basically a mood board, you can't scroll past a badly lit video without cringing, and you've caught yourself rewriting someone else's caption in your head... we should talk.

We're looking for someone with *the eye*. Someone who knows the difference between content that gets scrolled past and content that stops the thumb. Someone who can shoot it, edit it, post it, and tell us exactly why it worked.

**About Us**

Who Shot That Media? is a full\-service video production and digital marketing agency based in New Orleans. We serve clients in person across Louisiana, with occasional work in Houston and Beaumont, TX, and Hattiesburg, MS. We tell stories for roofers, pool builders, contractors, faith\-based organizations, and local businesses across the Gulf South. We're FAA Part 107 certified and have been featured in The Wall Street Journal. We move fast, we shoot a lot, and we care about results.

**The Role**

You'll work directly alongside our Creative Director on strategy, shooting, editing, and posting. This isn't a "make coffee and watch" position. You'll be trusted with real client accounts, real deadlines, and real creative input from day one.

**A Day Might Look Like**

* Morning shoot on a job site with the Sony, dialing in exposure and chasing good light
* Afternoon cranking out graphics in Canva and cutting reels in CapCut or Premiere
* Pulling analytics to see what hit and what flopped, then pitching what we try next
* Writing captions that actually sound like a human
* Golden hour shoot to close it out

**What You'll Do**

* Assist the Creative Director with content strategy and monthly content plans for client accounts
* Operate Sony cameras on shoots, handling lighting, exposure, and framing
* Edit high volumes of content quickly, which can mean up to 30 graphics and 5 to 8 videos in a day
* Check work of other team members
* Assist the creative director in operations
* Schedule and publish content across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and Google Business Profiles
* Pull and interpret analytics, spot trends, and recommend what to do next
* Write short, sharp captions that fit each client's voice
* Pitch your own ideas for content, campaigns, and creative direction
* Communicate with clients on set and represent the agency professionally
* Travel to client job sites and shoot locations, mostly across Louisiana, with occasional trips to Houston, Beaumont, and Hattiesburg
* Stay on top of platform changes and algorithm shifts across Meta, TikTok, and Google

**You're Our Person If You Have**

* **The eye.** You know a good shot when you see one, and you can tell when something is off.
* **Sony camera skills.** Comfortable with menus, settings, picture profiles, codecs, and lenses without needing a walkthrough.
* **Lighting and exposure knowledge.** ISO, shutter, aperture, white balance, and lighting a scene on location all make sense to you.
* **Fast editing chops.** Skilled in Canva and CapCut, plus at least one of Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro. Quick turnaround without cutting corners.
* **An analytics brain.** You can read Meta Business Suite, TikTok Analytics, and Google Business insights and turn numbers into decisions.
* **Platform know\-how.** You understand how TikTok, Meta, and Google work behind the scenes: reach, engagement, ads, and local search.
* **Marketing sense.** You get audience, funnels, offers, and what makes someone stop scrolling and take action.
* **AI fluency.** You use AI tools daily and know how to prompt them well: clear direction, good context, and refining until the output is right.
* **Clean writing.** Strong spelling and grammar. Nothing goes out with a typo.
* **Ideas, and the confidence to share them.** You don't wait to be told what to make.
* **Client charm.** You're comfortable talking with business owners on set, explaining your ideas, and representing the agency with a smile.
* **A memory like a steel trap.** You remember client details, brand guidelines, and past feedback so clients don't have to repeat themselves.
* **Calm in the chaos.** Shoot days move fast and plans change. You adapt and keep the work sharp.
* **Ownership.** You're ready for real responsibility and you follow through.

**Requirements**

* Reliable vehicle with a valid driver's license and insurance
* Flexibility for occasional out\-of\-state shoots
* Availability until 7:30 PM on workdays for shoots, golden hour, and posting windows
* Proficiency in Canva, CapCut, and Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools for content creation and copywriting

* Ability to lift and carry camera gear on job sites (up to \[XX] lbs)

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with GoHighLevel or other CRM/marketing platforms

Mission Inbox is the infrastructure layer for B2B email at scale. We provide dedicated\-IP sending infrastructure, automated DNS authentication, pre\-send compliance scanning, and reputation management for B2B sales teams, agencies, and SaaS companies that depend on email deliverability as a core business function.
   

  

 We are at an inflection point. The product is built, revenue is growing, and the customer base is expanding. What we don't have yet is a marketing engine. That's the gap this role is hired to close — from zero.
   

  

**This is not a "run our marketing" role.** 
 There is no existing playbook to execute, no team to manage, and no agency doing the heavy lifting. You will be the first dedicated marketing hire at Mission Inbox. You will build the strategy, own the execution, and eventually manage the team as channels mature and headcount follows performance.
   

  

**The right person sees this as the defining chapter of their career — a rare chance to build a full marketing function at a technical infrastructure company with real revenue, real customers, and real upside.**
 Our Team is distributed all over the world, we welcome talent, no matter their geography, ethnicity or religion.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
**Demand Generation \& Paid Media** 
 Own paid acquisition across LinkedIn, Google, and relevant niche channels. Build and iterate on audience targeting, creative, and bidding strategy — no agency dependency. Define and hit a monthly pipeline contribution target. Manage budget allocation across channels based on CAC and payback period data.
   

  

**Organic Content Engine** 
 Build a consistent content operation: blog, LinkedIn, newsletter, thought leadership. Develop and execute an SEO strategy targeting deliverability, cold email, and outbound infrastructure keywords. Write or directly manage 80%\+ of content output in the first 12 months.
   

  

**Website \& Conversion Optimization** 
 Own the Mission Inbox website end\-to\-end: messaging, structure, and conversion performance. Run continuous CRO experiments across landing pages, CTAs, pricing page, and sign\-up flow. Implement and maintain tracking, attribution, and analytics infrastructure.
   

  

**Product\-Led Growth (PLG)** 
 Design and execute in\-product marketing and activation flows for self\-serve users. Build onboarding email sequences that drive feature adoption and time\-to\-value. Define PQL criteria and build the handoff motion to sales.
   

  

**Webinars \& Events** 
 Launch and run a recurring webinar program targeting B2B sales leaders, RevOps, and agency operators. Identify and manage presence at relevant industry events. Build event follow\-up nurture workflows that convert attendance to pipeline.
   

  

**Nurture \& Lifecycle Campaigns** 
 Design and execute multi\-touch nurture programs for MQLs, trial users, and churned accounts. Build behavioral email workflows triggered by product activity and sales signals. Own HubSpot (or equivalent) — setup, segmentation, automation, and reporting.
   

  

**Your First 60 Days**
 Days 1\-10: Deep\-dive into the product, ICP, and existing customers. Audit the website, CRM, current content, and any existing paid spend. Deliver a written State of Marketing assessment and a prioritized plan with proposed KPI targets.
   

  

 Days 11\-30: Launch core infrastructure — Attio setup, website messaging alignment, attribution tracking, first paid test campaigns. Shipping content, launching new ads and setting up new marketing content production engine.
   

  

 Days 31\-60: First webinar live. First nurture sequence running. Paid campaigns optimized with real data. First pipeline attribution report presented to CEO.

* 3\+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 2 years operating as an IC or small\-team lead
* Proven track record building pipeline from scratch — not inheriting a mature funnel
* You have owned a pipeline or revenue number directly, not just an MQL target
* Fluent in the full marketing stack: Attio/Hubspot, Google/LinkedIn Ads, SEO tooling (Ahrefs/Semrush), analytics (GA4, Mixpanel or equivalent)
* Strong copywriter — content output is not outsourced in this role
* Comfortable with technical products: you understand DNS records, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and why deliverability matters to a sales team
* PLG experience: you have built or contributed to product\-led onboarding or activation flows
* Native or near\-native English — written communication is a core output of this role
* Comfortable being the only marketer for 12\+ months before building a team
* Talks in CAC, payback period, and pipeline velocity — not impressions and follower counts

title: Producer / Production Coordinator
description:
BENO is a Dubai\-based luxury lifestyle experiences company, expanding its in\-house media team across yacht and watersports, automotive, desert experiences, and lifestyle production. We're hiring a Producer / Production Coordinator to bridge the Head of Media's creative direction with on\-the\-ground execution.  

  

**Role Overview**  

This role plans and runs production logistics, including locations, scheduling, crew, and preparation, across everything from a simple single\-location asset shoot to a full campaign with talent and a larger crew. It also maintains vendor relationships and, over time, builds the client pipeline that supports BENO's move into outsourced production work.  

  

**Responsibilities*** Plan and coordinate pre\-production logistics, including locations, scheduling, crew, and other preparations, across video and photo shoots ranging from simple asset videos to full campaigns with talent and larger crews, working closely with the in\-house videographer, photographer, and social media team
* Arrange transport and logistics for crew, talent, and equipment on larger productions
* Hands\-on experience producing a range of shoot types with a small in\-house crew: automotive, watersports, yacht, desert buggy, events, lifestyle, and brand promotion content
* Comfortable adapting on the ground to changing conditions, staying solution\-oriented while protecting brand identity, safety, and efficient use of time and resources
* Execute standard\-format shoots (single\-subject assets, walkthroughs, simple brand pieces) independently with the in\-house videographer and photographer, briefed and guided by the Head of Media / Creative Director and using BENO's documented visual guide for framing, pacing, and shot selection
* Refer anything involving narrative direction, talent, or new visual concepts to the Head of Media / Creative Director
* Support the Head of Media in shaping and preparing new concepts and upcoming projects
* Brief in\-house and remote editors on delivery specs and follow up against the Creative Director's notes to keep post\-production on schedule
* Maintain and grow vendor and crew relationships as needed, including equipment rental, freelance crew, talent agencies, and drone operators, alongside BENO's existing network, keeping rates, reliability notes, and booking history up to date
* Maintain the production log and tracker, flagging missing deliverables or specs
* Continuously refine the production workflow from pre\- through post\-production, drawing on lessons from past shoots, personal experience, and team feedback to keep timelines and efficiency improving
* On weeks without a scheduled shoot, originate simple, repeatable content pieces using the visual guide and available assets or locations, keeping output continuous
* **Bonus:** Maintain working knowledge of Dubai's filming permit landscape, including Dubai Film \& TV Commission (DFTC) approvals, RTA road permits, and marina or private\-property access, and advise on feasibility before a shoot is booked
* **Bonus:** Knowledgeable in finding or suggesting filming locations suited to specific concepts
* Flexible to work outside standard hours or on weekends for specific shoots or events
* **Bonus:** Capture clean, on\-brand behind\-the\-scenes phone content during shoots, giving the marketing and social team ready\-to\-use footage without pulling focus from logistics or crew management.

  

**Qualifications*** Minimum 5 years of production coordination or producing experience in the UAE, particularly Dubai
* Knowledgeable in standard production tools and platforms (Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Google Meet, Trello, and other tools relevant to the role)
* Familiar with core media production software (Adobe Creative Suite, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve), enough to understand the team's workload and help streamline it
* Strong AI literacy: comfortable using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Higgsfield to support production planning and enhance department efficiency. This is a core requirement, not a bonus skill
* Familiar with social media platforms and their content requirements (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn)
* Comfortable working in physically demanding conditions when required, for example aboard boats or in the desert, given the range of environments across BENO's productions
* Comfortable running a small shoot independently within a defined creative framework
* Organized, calm under logistics pressure, confident communicating with talent, crew, and vendors
* Presentable, professional, and clear in communication with the in\-house team, partners, and anyone else involved in the department's productions
* Fluent in English, written and spoken, able to communicate and understand everything related to the scope of the work
* Experience in luxury lifestyle, automotive, maritime, brand promotional, or documentary\-style content
* Understanding of visual storytelling, shot composition, and Dubai's visual identity
* Comfortable working under tight deadlines across multiple assignments
* A relevant academic degree in media, art, marketing, or a related field

  

**Preferred Qualifications*** Existing vendor and crew network in Dubai
* Prior exposure to business development, client services, or partnerships
* UAE driving license, with driving experience (owning a car is a plus)

  

**Working Hours**  

9:00 to 18:00 (Dubai time), in\-office; flexible on shoot days.

title: DIRECTOR, MARKETING & CREATIVE SERVICES
description:
**ABOUT US:**



Scripps Research is a nonprofit biomedical institute ranked as one of the most influential in the world for its impact on innovation. We celebrated our 100\-year legacy in 2024\. This significant milestone marks a century of seminal discoveries in immunology, infectious diseases (such as COVID\-19, flu, HIV), neuroscience, heart disease, cancer, and more. Located in La Jolla, California, the institute houses six research departments, multiple Nobel laureates, a top\-ranked graduate school and a leading postdoctoral training program. Scripps Research encompasses two elite and highly innovative institutes, the Calibr\-Skaggs Institute for Innovative Medicines and Scripps Research Translational Institute, which merge foundational studies in biology, chemistry and computer science with translational science to produce pioneering drugs and advances in digital and precision medicine. Together, we cultivate new scientific leaders and expand the frontiers of knowledge to deliver medical breakthroughs impacting human health around the globe. If you have a passion for making a difference, this could be your opportunity to join our transformative team.

  


**POSITION TITL****E****:**Director, Marketing \& Creative Services

  


**POSITION SUMMARY:**



We are seeking a highly creative, strategic and collaborative Director of Marketing \& Creative Services, to lead and advance the organization’s integrated marketing and communications efforts and help shape how the organization’s brand is expressed creatively across audiences and channels. Reporting to the Associate Vice President of Marketing \& Communications, this role will oversee key functions spanning traditional and digital marketing, constituent engagement and database management, audience development, brand and creative services, analytics and cross\-functional project management.



The Director will play a central role in translating institutional priorities into coordinated marketing and communications strategies and ensuring their effective execution across channels. The position will oversee integrated marketing campaigns, audience growth, segmentation and engagement strategies, marketing data and performance reporting, and provide brand stewardship and creative direction for institutional and philanthropy communications.



Serving as a key liaison between Marketing \& Communications and the Office of Philanthropy, the Director will provide strategic and creative oversight and direction for philanthropy communications, donor\-facing materials, and campaigns, ensuring compelling storytelling, cohesive visual expression and alignment with the institutional brand. This position will serve as a critical extension of the AVP and coordinate closely with internal stakeholders, external agencies and vendors to ensure initiatives are strategically aligned, high quality, and delivered on schedule and within budget.

  


**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:**


* Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies and campaigns that advance institutional priorities and strengthen awareness, engagement and reputation among key audiences.
* Lead and execute marketing initiatives across traditional and digital channels, including print, radio, out\-of\-home, paid social, search, display, email, web and other emerging platforms.
* Lead project management for integrated marketing and communications initiatives, including development of project plans, timelines, milestones, resources and budgets.
* Oversee email marketing and marketing automation, including campaign strategy and execution, audience segmentation, subscriptions, testing, optimization and performance.
* Lead creative concept development from brief through execution, translating strategic objectives into compelling visual identities, campaign concepts, messaging frameworks and creative assets across channels.
* Manage the marketing and constituent database, ensuring data integrity, governance and effective segmentation while developing strategies to drive audience acquisition, growth, engagement, retention and re\-engagement.
* Develop and optimize audience journeys across channels to strengthen relationships with key institutional and philanthropic audiences.
* Oversee marketing analytics, dashboards and campaign reporting, establishing KPIs and translating performance data into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Serve as a steward of the institutional brand, ensuring consistent, distinct and compelling application of brand standards, messaging and visual identity across marketing and communications channels…
* Provide creative direction, oversight and project management for institutional marketing and communications, including print, digital, advertising, campaign branding and institutional collateral.
* Supervise the staff graphic designer, providing creative direction, design feedback, professional development and strategic context while overseeing creative and production workflows, priorities and resources.
* Support the management of external creative contractors and marketing agencies.
* Provide strategic and creative oversight for philanthropic communications and collateral including marketing materials, annual reports, campaign materials and other donor\-facing communications and collateral.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners to develop and execute communications and marketing plans supporting institutional priorities.
* Develop and champion visual storytelling approaches that bring institutional priorities, programs, people and impact to life across marketing, communications and philanthropy channels.
* Oversee the organization and maintenance of institutional content, creative assets, content libraries and digital asset management systems.
* Establish and maintain efficient workflows, standards and processes that improve coordination, production and delivery across Marketing \& Communications.
* Manage assigned marketing budgets and monitor expenditures and performance to maximize effectiveness and return on investment.
* Support the Associate Vice President of Marketing \& Communications on additional strategic, operational and department\-wide priorities as assigned.

Details of established essential functions for this position will be addressed/discussed during the interview process.  
* 

**REQUIREMENTS:**


**Education \& Experience**


* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, advertising, public relations, business or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience considered.
* Minimum of 7–10 years of progressively responsible experience in marketing, communications, advertising, creative services, or a related field, including experience managing integrated marketing campaigns and complex, cross\-functional projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing creative staff, including providing creative direction, setting priorities, managing workloads and providing feedback on creative work.
* Experience developing and executing marketing strategies across traditional and digital channels.
* Experience managing staff, agencies, vendors and external partners.
* Experience working in a complex organization with multiple stakeholders; experience in higher education, research, healthcare, nonprofit or mission\-driven organizations preferred.
* Portfolio demonstrating strong creative judgment, visual storytelling, conceptual development, brand application and execution across multiple formats and channels.


**Technical \& Functional Skills**


* Demonstrated experience with email marketing and marketing automation platforms such as Klaviyo, Mailchimp or similar platforms.
* Strong experience managing marketing or constituent databases, including data integrity, segmentation, audience development, list growth and engagement strategies.
* Experience developing audience journeys and using behavioral and engagement data to inform marketing strategy.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, including paid social, email and web marketing.
* Experience planning and managing traditional marketing, including print, radio and other advertising channels.
* Strong understanding of marketing analytics, campaign measurement, KPIs and performance reporting; experience using web analytics and reporting platforms.
* Proficiency with creative and design platforms such as Adobe Creative Cloud (including Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign) and Canva, with the ability to provide informed creative direction and evaluate work against brand standards.
* Excellent proficiency with Microsoft 365, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook and Teams.
* Experience with project management and workflow platforms such as Asana, Monday.com, or similar systems.
* Experience working with content management systems and digital asset management platforms.
* Strong understanding of brand management, visual identity and creative production across print and digital channels.
* Experience developing campaign identities, creative concepts, visual systems and brand applications.
* Experience producing collateral for both print and digital environments.


**Leadership \& Professional Skills**


* Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects, competing priorities and deadlines.
* Strong strategic thinking and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate organizational priorities into actionable, marketing strategies.
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong creative judgment and ability to provide clear, constructive creative direction.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze data and translate insights into recommendations and decisions.
* Ability to build effective relationships and work collaboratively with senior leaders, colleagues, external partners and stakeholders across an organization.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, quality and brand consistency.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment and take ownership of projects from strategy through execution.
* Excellent visual and creative judgment, with the ability to translate strategy into compelling creative concepts and experiences.


**Additional Requirements**

* Only local candidates will be considered for this role.
* Cover letter required
* While subject to change based on business needs, this is an on\-campus position requiring a minimum of 4 days per week working onsite from our La Jolla campus, with flexibility to work 1 day per week remotely from home.

  

**COMPENSATION:**



The expected hiring range for this position is $169,000 to $190,000/annually, commensurate with experience. Consideration will be given to experience that exceeds the listed requirements.

  


**COMPREHENSIVE BENEFITS INCLUDE:**

title: Design & Construction Division Director
description:
**ATTENTION ALL APPLICANTS!**  

  

  

  

  

**Lead Design and Construction Delivery Where Standard Solutions Are Not Enough**  

  

Alaska is not a typical infrastructure environment, and this is not a typical project delivery role.
From highways built on permafrost and rural airports accessible only by air or barge to coastal marine facilities, major bridges, and growing urban corridors, Alaska presents some of the most complex transportation challenges in North America. The Design and Construction Division Director is the department's statewide engineering leader responsible for guiding the design, construction, and delivery of safe, resilient, and constructable transportation projects across this vast and diverse landscape.  

  

  

If you are motivated by purpose, complexity, and lasting public impact, this is a rare opportunity to lead one of the nation’s most distinctive transportation infrastructure programs. You will guide statewide project delivery, align regional teams and technical resources, strengthen accountability, and help modernize how DOT\&PF plans, designs, procures, and constructs infrastructure for Alaska.  

  

  

  

  

**Depending on the selected applicant, this position may be located in Fairbanks, Anchorage, or Juneau. Salary will be determined based on the selected applicant’s qualifications and experience and will be paid according to the applicable Range 27 salary schedule for the assigned duty station.**
  

  

**Fairbanks:** Unit Designation XE \- Partially Exempt and Exempt Executive Branch Employees
  

**Anchorage:** Unit Designation XE \- Partially Exempt and Exempt Executive Branch Employees
  

**Juneau:** Unit Designation XE \- Partially Exempt and Exempt Executive Branch Employees  

  

**What you will be doing:**
  

As the Design and Construction Division Director, you will lead DOT\&PF's statewide engineering, design, construction, and capital project delivery program. You will oversee projects from development and design through procurement, construction, operational integration, and final handoff.  

  

  

You will lead a geographically dispersed organization responsible for delivering highways, bridges, airports, marine facilities, and other transportation improvements in some of the nation’s most technically and logistically demanding conditions. Success will depend on building high\-performing teams, establishing clear delivery expectations, aligning resources with priorities, managing risk, and strengthening accountability for schedule, budget, quality, and results.  

  

  

The position directly supervises the regional Preconstruction and Construction Engineers and the Division Operations Manager responsible for budget, finance, fund management, administration, and safety. You will provide executive engineering leadership and work closely with planning, environmental, right\-of\-way, utilities, procurement, operations, and department leadership to ensure projects are technically sound, practical, constructable, financially responsible, and responsive to Alaska's transportation needs.  

  

**In this role, you will:*** Lead statewide engineering, design, construction, and project delivery functions across DOT\&PF's capital program
* Establish consistent statewide engineering standards, technical decision\-making practices, design quality expectations, constructability requirements, and performance measures
* Guide capital program execution, project readiness, resource alignment, risk management, and delivery accountability
* Strengthen coordination across planning, environmental, design, right\-of\-way, utilities, procurement, construction, and property management functions
* Support clear, constructable solicitations and improve procurement readiness, consultant utilization, and delivery reliability
* Oversee division operations, including budgeting, fund management, administration, safety coordination, reporting, and organizational performance
* Coordinate staffing, technical resources, consultant capacity, and delivery needs across regional teams
* Partner with Maintenance \& Operations leadership to ensure infrastructure investments support long\-term maintainability, resilience, and lifecycle performance
* Advance data\-informed project delivery, performance metrics, forecasting, reporting, and modernization of project management systems
* Represent DOT\&PF before the Legislature, local governments, Tribal organizations, industry partners, regulatory agencies, and community stakeholders
* Serve as a key member of the department's leadership team, advising on statewide engineering, design and construction strategy, technical and delivery risks, organizational coordination, and long\-term transportation priorities
  

  

**Our organization, mission, and culture:**
  

DOT\&PF is modernizing how transportation design, construction and services are delivered across Alaska. Under the department’s evolving organizational model, statewide functional leaders establish strategy, policy, standards, and performance expectations, while regional teams continue to deliver projects and services based on local conditions and community needs.  

  

  

The Design and Construction Division Director will be central to this evolution. The Director will bring regional project delivery teams together under a coordinated statewide framework, improve the consistency and predictability of capital delivery, and strengthen accountability for schedule, budget, quality, and outcomes.  

  

  

This position will help create stronger connections among planning, engineering, construction, procurement, operations, and asset stewardship so that infrastructure decisions consider the full lifecycle of each investment. The Director will also foster a culture that values collaboration, professional judgment, innovation, safety, and practical problem\-solving.  

  

  

This is an opportunity to shape the future of design and construction delivery in a state where transportation is more than mobility; it is a lifeline connecting people to essential services, employment, education, commerce, and one another.  

  

**The benefits of joining our team:**
Working for Alaska DOT\&PF means leading design and construction delivery at a scale and level of complexity few organizations can offer. Our projects connect communities, strengthen public safety, support economic development, and provide access to essential services across one of the nation’s largest and most geographically diverse states.  

  

This role offers:
* Executive leadership responsibility with meaningful statewide impact.
* The opportunity to modernize and strengthen capital project delivery.
* Leadership of complex projects across Arctic, coastal, rural, and urban environments.
* The ability to shape how transportation investments are planned, designed, constructed, and transitioned into operation.
* Collaboration with experienced professionals committed to serving Alaska.
Few places offer the opportunity to lead projects across terrain ranging from Arctic tundra and mountain passes to coastal rainforests and remote island communities—while delivering infrastructure that directly affects the safety, connectivity, and economic future of an entire state.  

  

  

Join DOT\&PF as we build a modern, resilient, and agile transportation organization capable of meeting today’s challenges and tomorrow’s demands.  

  

We are looking for a leader ready to help guide that future. If you are motivated by mission, leadership, and the opportunity to leave a lasting impact across Alaska, we encourage you to apply.  

  

**The working environment you can expect:**
This position may be based in an Alaska DOT\&PF regional office, with the final duty station determined in consideration of the selected candidate and the department’s operational needs. The position leads a statewide program and requires regular coordination across all regions.  

  

  

Travel throughout Alaska is expected, including visits to regional offices, construction sites, rural airports, marine facilities, remote communities, and other project locations. Travel may involve small aircraft, ferries, extended road travel, and changing weather conditions.  

  

  

The working environment combines executive leadership, strategic planning, virtual coordination, public engagement, and direct field involvement. You will work closely with department executives, regional and statewide teams, federal partners, elected officials, Tribal organizations, local governments, consultants, contractors, industry representatives, and community stakeholders.  

  

  

Although the position’s regular work is structured, flexibility and responsiveness are essential when critical project issues, infrastructure emergencies, legislative priorities, or other statewide needs arise.
**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


Positions in this job class are in the Partially Exempt Service under AS 39\.25\.120(c)(2\).
  

  

**Special Note:**
  

Departments are authorized by Personnel Rule 2 AAC 07\.015 to identify Division Directors by their specific division titles.  

  

  



**Who we are looking for:**
We are seeking a strategic, collaborative, and results\-oriented engineering executive with demonstrated success leading complex transportation design, engineering, construction, and capital project delivery programs in geographically dispersed and operationally demanding environments.  

  

  

The ideal candidate will bring significant professional engineering and executive leadership experience involving transportation infrastructure, design, construction, capital program management, fiscal stewardship, organizational performance, and multidisciplinary coordination.  

  

  

Successful candidates will demonstrate the ability to:
* Lead large, geographically dispersed professional and technical organizations.
* Translate strategic priorities into clear expectations, accountable execution, and measurable results.
* Balance ambitious capital programs with available workforce, funding, consultant capacity, and realistic delivery schedules.
* Build alignment across planning, engineering, construction, procurement, finance, and operational functions.
* Strengthen organizational accountability while empowering regional leaders and technical professionals.
* Make sound, timely decisions involving complex technical, financial, regulatory, and public considerations.
* Lead organizational change while sustaining project delivery and workforce engagement.
* Communicate effectively in highly visible settings involving executive leadership, legislators, federal agencies, communities, and industry partners.
* Develop high\-performing teams and support workforce development, succession planning, and professional growth.
* Promote safety, innovation, quality, integrity, and responsible stewardship of public resources.
Candidates may come from senior public\- or private\-sector engineering leadership roles, including transportation agencies, engineering consulting firms, design and construction organizations, major capital delivery programs, military infrastructure programs, utilities, or other large\-scale infrastructure environments. The Director of Design \& Style is responsible for shaping and elevating the visual expression of our food, hospitality and retail experiences. With a strong point of view and an exceptional eye for detail, this role translates culinary and hospitality concepts into cohesive, compelling environments that feel thoughtful, relevant and distinctive. The position reports to the Senior Vice President of Creative and Strategy.

  

From initial concept development and mood boarding through space planning, tabletop, service wares, uniforms, merchandising and final styling, the Director of Design \& Style ensures every visual touchpoint contributes to the guest experience and brings the concept to life. Highly collaborative, this position works closely with Culinary, Marketing, Operations, and Design \& Construction to develop concepts that are creatively compelling and operationally sound.

  

The ideal candidate is a tastemaker and highly collaborative creative thinker who understands that memorable hospitality is created through hundreds of intentional details — the shape of the plate, the height of the display, the texture of a uniform, the placement of a product, and how those choices work together. They have a keen sense of style and an instinct for what feels current without being overly trend\-driven, creating environments that feel considered rather than decorated.

 **Key Responsibilities**

  

Lead visual development of new and evolving food, beverage and hospitality concepts, from mood boards and material palettes through final styling.  

Translate brand, culinary and hospitality strategies into a clear, cohesive visual language, with hands\-on responsibility for set\-ups of new units, refreshes and renovations.  

Identify emerging trends in hospitality, restaurants, retail, fashion and interiors, translating relevant ideas into fresh approaches for the business.  

Help shape servery, café, restaurant, marketplace and amenity environments from planning through opening, participating in reviews, mock\-ups, installations and openings to carry design intent through execution.  

Lead selection of tabletop, china, glassware, flatware, serving pieces, display vessels and smallwares, and develop uniform programs, balancing aesthetics with durability, functionality, inclusivity, cost and operational needs.  

Develop merchandising strategies and visual standards for cafés, markets and grab\-and\-go environments, and style food displays, buffets, counters and catering presentations to support navigation, storytelling and sales.  

Partner with Culinary on food presentation, Marketing and Creative on brand storytelling, and Operations to keep concepts practical and executable.  

Coordinate with vendor partners on sourcing, logistics and deliveries, and present concepts to leadership and clients with clarity and confidence.

**Qualifications**
------------------


**Qualifications \& Experience**

  

Strong background in interior design, hospitality design, retail design, visual merchandising, experiential design, styling or a related discipline, with experience developing concepts from inspiration through execution.  

Exceptional visual sensibility — a sophisticated understanding of color, material, proportion, composition, texture and presentation, and how design influences the guest experience.  

Experience with tabletop, service wares, merchandising, uniforms and/or food presentation strongly preferred.  

Ability to read and respond thoughtfully to architectural plans, elevations and design documentation.  

Strong knowledge of current hospitality, retail, interiors, fashion and lifestyle trends.  

Highly detail\-oriented, able to see both the overall concept and the smallest details that complete it.  

Strong presentation, communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable managing multiple projects at once.  

Portfolio demonstrating a strong visual point of view and relevant design work required

description:
**Construction Superintendent**

**Company Overview**


ENERGYneering Solutions (ESI), a division of TransTech Energy, provides exceptional technical expertise in engineering and operations for the biogas utilization and management industries. Since 2007, ESI has specialized in design, construction, and operations for biogas projects that collectively produce over one million MWh of renewable electricity and over 50 million gallons of renewable vehicle fuel every year. ESI is built upon the principle of providing our clients with unmatched experience, flexibility, and follow\-through.

**Job Overview**


The Construction Superintendent will work closely with project managers, engineers, subcontractors, craft personnel and ESI’s commissioning and O\&M teams to ensure seamless daily operations and successful completion of our construction projects. The position requires implementing sound construction management principles to ensure our EPC projects are executed flawlessly, driving on time and in budget delivery. An ability to work independently, self\-motivate, and communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders is of the utmost importance to this position. ESI values both continuous improvement and feedback from its employees. Consequently, the Construction Superintendent will be expected to provide feedback to department leadership on ways that processes and designs can be optimized.

**Reports To**


The Construction Superintendent will report to the Director of Projects.

**Work Location**


This is a remote position, based primarily at our active construction sites.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Supervise and manage all on\-site construction activities to ensure they align with project plans and specifications.
* Reach substantial project completion/final completion and create a punch list.
* Responsible for site equipment rental and related monthly cost tracking.
* Execute mobilization and demobilization of jobsite.
* Ensure that the site is kept clean during construction.
* Track major equipment delivery and valves and parts delivery.
* Scheduling of cranes as required for the offloading of major equipment.
* Monitor weather and how it affects the craft (rain delays, lightning stand downs).
* Participate in constructability reviews with engineering team.
* Work in alignment with process, electrical, controls, SCADA, and project management teams as well as outside civil, structural, and geotechnical engineering partners to ensure project goals are met.
* Develop and maintain construction schedules, ensuring that milestones are met within the stipulated time frame.
* Allocate resources efficiently, including labor, materials, and equipment.
* Enforce adherence to safety regulations and building codes.
* Conduct regular site inspections to ensure compliance with safety standards and ensure completion of daily Job Safety Analysis (JSAs).
* Facilitate effective communication between all parties involved in the project, including subcontractors and suppliers.
* Maintain detailed records of construction activities, including daily logs, progress reports, and cost tracking.
* Assist with commissioning and start\-up.
* Facilitate communication within the company to share lessons learned and foster an environment that rewards open discussion about mistakes and near\-misses.
* Communicate and collaborate with cross\-functional partners such as Operations, Business Development, Project Management, HR, and IT.
* Apply RACI principals to support an accountability framework for special projects.
* Seek ways to improve and promote quality, demonstrating accuracy and thoroughness in all work.
* Willingness and ability to respond to urgent issues outside normal business hours.
* Remote position but requiring 100% travel each month.
* Other responsibilities as assigned.
 **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8 years of Construction project experience including a minimum of 2 years of onsite construction management experience.
* Valid driver’s license for the state of residence.
* Working knowledge of construction site hazard assessment.
* Working knowledge of OSHA Part 1926 – Safety and Health Regulations for Construction.
* Proficient with the Microsoft Office suite of software. (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency in MS Project, Procore or other project management/scheduling software.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management or equivalent.
